--[[
	EditMode mixin: the ghost and hover tooltip, the action toast, the keypoint edit panel and its
	inputs (time, value, envelope, range, segments, Env +), the panel scale and the panel drag.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

return function(GraphEditor)


function GraphEditor:_updateGhost()
	self._ghostDot.Visible = false
	self._ghostLineL.Visible = false
	self._ghostLineR.Visible = false
	self._tooltip.Visible = false
	-- Last frame's bezier ghost segments go first; the early exits below would leave them up.
	U.poolReleaseAll(self._ghostLinePool)

	if not self._panel.Visible or not self:_mouseInGraph() or self:_isMouseOverUI() then return end
	self._uiScale = self:_getUIScale()
	local s = self._state
	if #s.keypoints < 2 then return end
	local ht, hi = self:_findNearest()

	-- Tooltip on the hovered keypoint.
	if ht == "kp" and hi then
		local kp = s.keypoints[hi]
		if kp then
			local knx, kny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
			local tipText = string.format("Time: %.3f  Value: %.3f", kp.time, kp.value)
			if s.envelopeEnabled and kp.envelope > 0 then
				tipText = tipText .. string.format("  Env: %.3f", kp.envelope)
			end
			self._tipLabel.Text = tipText
			self._tooltip.Position = UDim2.new(knx, 0, kny, -14)
			self._tooltip.Visible = true
		end
		return
	end

	if ht then return end

	-- Ghost of the keypoint a click would add.
	local nx, ny = self:_mouseNorm()
	local gTime, gValue = self:_normToData(nx, ny)
	gTime = U.clamp(gTime, 0, 1)
	local gnx, gny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, gTime, gValue, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
	gnx = U.clamp(gnx, 0, 1)
	gny = U.clamp(gny, 0, 1)

	local kps = s.keypoints; local gf = self._ghostFrame
	local absW, absH = gf.AbsoluteSize.X, gf.AbsoluteSize.Y
	if absW < 1 or absH < 1 then return end

	-- Neighbours by binary search.
	local li, ri
	local lo, hi2 = 1, #kps
	while lo <= hi2 do
		local mid = math.floor((lo + hi2) / 2)
		if kps[mid].time <= gTime then li = mid; lo = mid + 1
		else hi2 = mid - 1 end
	end
	lo, hi2 = 1, #kps
	while lo <= hi2 do
		local mid = math.floor((lo + hi2) / 2)
		if kps[mid].time >= gTime then ri = mid; hi2 = mid - 1
		else lo = mid + 1 end
	end

	if not li then li = 1 end
	if not ri then ri = #kps end

	if s.handlesEnabled and li and ri and li ~= ri then
		-- Bezier ghost: the handles _initH would give the new keypoint (a third of each neighbouring
		-- segment, along the line through the neighbours), with the neighbours' handles as they are, so
		-- the ghost matches the real insert.
		local liKp, riKp = kps[li], kps[ri]
		local dtI = (gTime - liKp.time) / 3
		local dtO = (riKp.time - gTime) / 3
		local d = riKp.time - liKp.time
		local tan = (d > 0) and ((riKp.value - liKp.value) / d) or 0
		local gHix, gHiy = -dtI, -tan * dtI
		local gHox, gHoy = dtO, tan * dtO

		local segs = math.max(8, math.floor(C.BEZIER_SEGS / 2))
		local function drawBezSeg(p0x, p0y, p1x, p1y, p2x, p2y, p3x, p3y)
			local pnx, pny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, p0x, p0y, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			for si = 1, segs do
				local t = si / segs
				local cx = U.cubicBez(t, p0x, p1x, p2x, p3x)
				local cy = U.cubicBez(t, p0y, p1y, p2y, p3y)
				local cnx, cny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, cx, cy, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
				local r = {U.clipLine(pnx, pny, cnx, cny)}
				if r[1] then
					local line = U.poolAcquire(self._ghostLinePool, gf)
					U.setupLine(line, r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], self._T.MutedGold, 1, C.GHOST_LINE_ALPHA, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
				end
				pnx, pny = cnx, cny
			end
		end
		drawBezSeg(liKp.time, liKp.value, liKp.time + liKp.handleOutX, liKp.value + liKp.handleOutY, gTime + gHix, gValue + gHiy, gTime, gValue)
		drawBezSeg(gTime, gValue, gTime + gHox, gValue + gHoy, riKp.time + riKp.handleInX, riKp.value + riKp.handleInY, riKp.time, riKp.value)
		self._ghostLineL.Visible = false
		self._ghostLineR.Visible = false
	else
		-- Linear mode, or no neighbour pair: the straight ghost lines.
		if li then
			local lnx, lny = self:_kpToNorm(kps[li])
			lny = U.clamp(lny, 0, 1)
			if U.setupLine(self._ghostLineL, lnx, lny, gnx, gny, self._T.MutedGold, 1, C.GHOST_LINE_ALPHA, absW, absH, self._uiScale) then
				self._ghostLineL.Visible = true
			end
		end
		if ri and ri ~= li then
			local rnx, rny = self:_kpToNorm(kps[ri])
			rny = U.clamp(rny, 0, 1)
			if U.setupLine(self._ghostLineR, gnx, gny, rnx, rny, self._T.MutedGold, 1, C.GHOST_LINE_ALPHA, absW, absH, self._uiScale) then
				self._ghostLineR.Visible = true
			end
		end
	end

	self._ghostDot.Position = UDim2.new(gnx, 0, gny, 0)
	self._ghostDot.Visible = true
end


-- A short toast at the top right of the plot: the text fades over 1.2 s and the label hides at
-- 1.5 s, unless a newer toast took the slot.
function GraphEditor:_showActionPopup(text)
	local label = self._actionLabel
	if not label then return end
	label.Text = text or ""
	label.Visible = true
	label.TextTransparency = 0
	TweenService:Create(label, C.ACTION_FADE_TWEEN, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	task.delay(1.5, function()
		if label.Text == text then
			label.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end


function GraphEditor:_showEditPanel()
	local pri = self:_getPrimary()
	if not pri or not self._state.keypoints[pri] then return end

	self._editPanelOpen = true
	self:_layoutEditPanel()
	self:_updateEditPanelValues()
	self:_positionEditPanel()
	self._editPanel.Visible = true
end

function GraphEditor:_hideEditPanel()
	self._editPanelOpen = false
	self._editPanel.Visible = false
	-- A hidden-but-focused TextBox keeps swallowing keystrokes; release all three inputs.
	if self._tIn and self._tIn:IsFocused() then self._tIn:ReleaseFocus() end
	if self._vIn and self._vIn:IsFocused() then self._vIn:ReleaseFocus() end
	if self._eIn and self._eIn:IsFocused() then self._eIn:ReleaseFocus() end
end

function GraphEditor:_updateEditPanelValues()
	local pri = self:_getPrimary()
	if not pri or not self._state.keypoints[pri] then return end
	local kp = self._state.keypoints[pri]

	self._tIn.Text = string.format("%.4g", kp.time)
	self._vIn.Text = string.format("%.4g", kp.value)
	self._eIn.Text = string.format("%.4g", kp.envelope)
end

function GraphEditor:_positionEditPanel()
	local pri = self:_getPrimary()
	if not pri then return end
	local kp = self._state.keypoints[pri]
	if not kp then return end

	local nx, ny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
	local L = self._layout
	local gfW = L.panelW - L.side * 2
	local daW = gfW - C.DRAW_PAD.left - C.DRAW_PAD.right
	local daH = self._gH - C.DRAW_PAD.top - C.DRAW_PAD.bottom
	local px = L.side + C.DRAW_PAD.left + nx * daW
	local py = self._gY + C.DRAW_PAD.top + ny * daH

	local panelH = self._editPanelFullH or 60
	local targetX = px - C.EDITPANEL_W / 2
	local targetY = py + 14

	targetX = U.clamp(targetX, 8, L.panelW - C.EDITPANEL_W - 8)
	targetY = U.clamp(targetY, self._gY + 2, L.panelH - panelH - L.statusH - 4)
	self._editPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX, 0, targetY)

	local caretX = px - targetX
	caretX = U.clamp(caretX, 10, C.EDITPANEL_W - 10)
	self._editCaret.Position = UDim2.new(0, caretX, 0, -2)
end


-- The first and last keypoints stay at 0 and 1, so time edits there are ignored. Neighbours keep
-- 0.001 apart; with no room left between them the edit is rejected.
function GraphEditor:_onTimeIn()
	local s = self._state
	local pri = self:_getPrimary(); if not pri then return end
	local kp = s.keypoints[pri]; if not kp then return end
	local n = tonumber(self._tIn.Text)
	if not n or pri == 1 or pri == #s.keypoints then
		if not n and self._tIn.Text ~= "" then
			self._tIn.TextColor3 = self._T.Red
			task.delay(0.5, function() if self._tIn then self._tIn.TextColor3 = self._T.BrightGold end end)
		end
		return
	end
	local lo = s.keypoints[pri-1].time + 0.001
	local hi = s.keypoints[pri+1].time - 0.001
	if hi <= lo then return end
	self:_pushUndo()
	kp.time = U.round(U.clamp(n, lo, hi), 4)
	-- Re-clamp handles so the curve stays a function of time (Rendering._reclampHandles).
	self:_reclampHandles(pri)
	if self._editPanelOpen then self:_updateEditPanelValues(); self:_positionEditPanel() end
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
end

function GraphEditor:_onValIn()
	local pri = self:_getPrimary(); if not pri then return end
	local kp = self._state.keypoints[pri]; if not kp then return end
	local n = tonumber(self._vIn.Text)
	if not n then
		self._vIn.TextColor3 = self._T.Red
		task.delay(0.5, function() if self._vIn then self._vIn.TextColor3 = self._T.BrightGold end end)
		return
	end
	self:_pushUndo()
	-- Handle Y offsets shift by the opposite of the value change, so the handle ends stay put.
	local dv = n - kp.value
	kp.value = U.round(n, 4)
	if kp.handleInY then kp.handleInY = U.round(kp.handleInY - dv, 4) end
	if kp.handleOutY then kp.handleOutY = U.round(kp.handleOutY - dv, 4) end
	self:_autoExpandRange(kp.value, kp.envelope)
	if self._editPanelOpen then self:_updateEditPanelValues(); self:_positionEditPanel() end
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
end

function GraphEditor:_onEnvIn()
	local pri = self:_getPrimary(); if not pri then return end
	local kp = self._state.keypoints[pri]; if not kp then return end
	local n = tonumber(self._eIn.Text)
	if not n then
		self._eIn.TextColor3 = self._T.Red
		task.delay(0.5, function() if self._eIn then self._eIn.TextColor3 = self._T.BrightGold end end)
		return
	end
	self:_pushUndo()
	kp.envelope = math.max(0, U.round(n, 4))
	self:_autoExpandRange(kp.value, kp.envelope)
	if self._editPanelOpen then self:_updateEditPanelValues(); self:_positionEditPanel() end
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
end

function GraphEditor:_onRange()
	local lo, hi = tonumber(self._rMinIn.Text), tonumber(self._rMaxIn.Text)
	if lo and hi and hi > lo then
		self._state.rangeMin = lo; self._state.rangeMax = hi
		self:_redraw()
		if self._editPanelOpen then self:_positionEditPanel() end
	else
		-- Both inputs flash on a failed parse or an inverted range.
		if self._rMinIn then
			local orig = self._rMinIn.TextColor3
			self._rMinIn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
			task.delay(0.35, function() if self._rMinIn and self._rMinIn.Parent then self._rMinIn.TextColor3 = orig end end)
		end
		if self._rMaxIn then
			local orig = self._rMaxIn.TextColor3
			self._rMaxIn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
			task.delay(0.35, function() if self._rMaxIn and self._rMaxIn.Parent then self._rMaxIn.TextColor3 = orig end end)
		end
	end
end

-- Bake writes segments + 1 keypoints and a NumberSequence holds 20, so segments <= 19.
function GraphEditor:_onSegmentsIn()
	local count = tonumber(self._segIn.Text)
	if count then
		self._state.segments = math.clamp(math.floor(count), 2, 19)
	end
	self._segIn.Text = tostring(self._state.segments)
end

-- Env +: adds the typed amount (negative shrinks, clamped at 0) to every keypoint's envelope as one
-- undo step, widens the range to fit and shows the envelope.
function GraphEditor:_onAddEnvelope()
	local txt = self._envAddIn.Text
	if not txt or txt == "" then return end
	local n = tonumber(txt)
	if not n then
		self._envAddIn.TextColor3 = self._T.Red
		task.delay(0.5, function() if self._envAddIn then self._envAddIn.TextColor3 = self._T.BrightGold end end)
		return
	end
	if n == 0 then self._envAddIn.Text = ""; return end
	self:_pushUndo()
	local s = self._state
	for _, kp in ipairs(s.keypoints) do
		kp.envelope = U.round(math.max(0, (kp.envelope or 0) + n), 4)
		self:_autoExpandRange(kp.value, kp.envelope)
	end
	if n > 0 and not s.envelopeEnabled then
		s.envelopeEnabled = true
		self:_syncUIToState()
	end
	self._envAddIn.Text = ""
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
	self:_showActionPopup(string.format("Env %+.3g", n))
end


-- Saved panel scale (plugin setting "GraphEditorScale"), clamped to the slider range; defaults to 1.
function GraphEditor:_savedPanelScale()
	local saved = self._plugin and tonumber(self._plugin:GetSetting("GraphEditorScale"))
	if not saved then return 1 end
	return math.clamp(saved, C.PANEL_SCALE_MIN, C.PANEL_SCALE_MAX)
end

-- Header slider release: apply, persist, and redraw (line widths depend on the scale).
function GraphEditor:_setPanelScale(scale)
	if not self._panelScale then return end
	self._panelScale.Scale = scale * C.PANEL_BASE_SCALE
	if self._plugin then pcall(function() self._plugin:SetSetting("GraphEditorScale", scale) end) end
	self:_redraw()
end


-- Panel drag: cursor delta divided by the ancestors' UIScale (not the panel's own: Position is in
-- the parent's space), read when the drag begins.
function GraphEditor:_makeDrag(frame, handle)
	local drag, ds, sp, scale = false, nil, nil, 1
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true; ds = i.Position; sp = frame.Position; scale = self:_getOuterUIScale() end
	end)
	handle.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = false end
	end)
	local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if drag and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			local d = i.Position - ds
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X / scale, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y / scale)
		end
	end)
	local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = false end
	end)
	table.insert(self._conns, c1); table.insert(self._conns, c2)
end

end

--[[
	InputWiring mixin: _wire registers the editor's input connections; the handlers for mouse down,
	drag, box select, pan and scroll; _clampRangeToKeypoints.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
return function(GraphEditor)
function GraphEditor:_wire()
	local c1 = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
		if not self._panel.Visible or self._closing then return end
		if self._helpVisible then
			self:_hideHelp()
			return
		end
		-- Middle mouse / Alt+left for panning
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 and self:_mouseInGraph() and not self:_isMouseOverUI() then
			self._interactionState = "panning"
			self._panStartMouse = { self:_mouseNorm() }
			self._panStartView = { rangeMin = self._state.rangeMin, rangeMax = self._state.rangeMax }
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and self:_mouseInGraph() and not self:_isMouseOverUI() then
			local alt = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt)
			if alt then
				self._interactionState = "panning"
				self._panStartMouse = { self:_mouseNorm() }
				self._panStartView = { rangeMin = self._state.rangeMin, rangeMax = self._state.rangeMax }
				return
			end
			self:_onDown()
		end
		-- Delete / Backspace run before the gameProcessed check (outside a focused TextBox).
		if (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace) then
			if not self:_isTextBoxFocused() and self:_selectedCount() > 0 then
				self:_delSelected()
			end
			return
		end
		if gpe then return end
		-- C / V copy and paste, no modifier.
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then
			self:_copyToClipboard()
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
			self:_pasteFromClipboard()
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			-- Esc shuts what is open on top first: the view's menu, the edit panel, then the editor.
			local view = self._viewHandles
			if view and view.menu.isOpen() then
				view.menu.close()
			elseif self._editPanelOpen then
				self:_hideEditPanel()
			else
				self:Close()
			end
		elseif self:_selectedCount() > 0 then
			local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
			-- Value nudges scale with the visible range so large-range graphs move by a visible amount.
			local rangeSpan = math.max(1, self._state.rangeMax - self._state.rangeMin)
			local vStep = (shift and 0.1 or 0.01) * rangeSpan
			local tStep = shift and 0.05 or 0.005
			local changed = false
			local kps = self._state.keypoints
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
				self:_pushUndo()
				local dir = input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up and 1 or -1
				for idx in pairs(self._state.selection.indices) do
					local kp = kps[idx]
					if kp then kp.value = U.round(kp.value + vStep * dir, 4); changed = true end
				end
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right then
				self:_pushUndo()
				local dir = input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right and 1 or -1
				for idx in pairs(self._state.selection.indices) do
					if idx > 1 and idx < #kps then
						local kp = kps[idx]
						local lo = kps[idx - 1].time + 0.001
						local hi = kps[idx + 1].time - 0.001
						kp.time = U.round(U.clamp(kp.time + tStep * dir, lo, hi), 4)
						changed = true
					end
				end
			end
			if changed then
				local pri = self:_getPrimary()
				if pri then
					local kp = kps[pri]
					if kp then self:_autoExpandRange(kp.value, kp.envelope) end
				end
				if self._editPanelOpen then self:_updateEditPanelValues(); self:_positionEditPanel() end
				self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
				self:_showActionPopup("Nudged")
			end
		end
	end)
	local c2 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not self._panel.Visible or self._closing then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			if self._getSimpDragging() then
				self:_onSimpSliderInput(input.Position)
			elseif self._interactionState == "panning" then
				self:_onPanMove()
			elseif self._interactionState == "box_selecting" then
				self:_onBoxSelectMove()
			elseif self._interactionState ~= "idle" then
				self._pendingDragMoved = true
				self:_onDragMove()
			else
				self:_updateGhost()
			end
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and self:_mouseInGraph() and not self:_isMouseOverUI() then
			self:_onScroll(input.Position.Z)
		end
	end)
	local c3 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
			self._setSimpDragging(false)
			if self._pendingSingleSelect and not self._pendingDragMoved then
				self:_selectSingle(self._pendingSingleSelect)
				if self._editPanelOpen then
					self:_updateEditPanelValues()
					self:_positionEditPanel()
				end
				self:_redraw()
			end
			self._pendingSingleSelect = nil
			self._pendingDragMoved = false
			if self._interactionState == "box_selecting" then
				self:_onBoxSelectEnd()
			elseif self._interactionState == "panning" then
				-- No toast for a pan.
			elseif self._interactionState ~= "idle" then
				local pri = self:_getPrimary()
				local kp = pri and self._state.keypoints[pri]
				if kp and self._interactionState == "dragging_kp" then
					self:_showActionPopup(string.format("Moved \xe2\x86\x92 T:%.3f V:%.3f", kp.time, kp.value))
				elseif kp and (self._interactionState == "dragging_envTop" or self._interactionState == "dragging_envBot") then
					self:_showActionPopup(string.format("Env: %.3f", kp.envelope))
				end
			end
			self._interactionState = "idle"
			self._dragStartNorm = nil
			self._dragStartKps = nil
			self._panStartView = nil
			self._panStartMouse = nil
			self._boxStart = nil
			self._boxRect.Visible = false
			if self._panel.Visible then
				task.defer(function() self:_updateGhost() end)
			end
		end
	end)
	table.insert(self._conns, c1)
	table.insert(self._conns, c2)
	table.insert(self._conns, c3)
end
-- Mouse down: a hit starts its drag, empty space a box select. _pushUndo drops a snapshot equal to
-- the last, so a click without a drag leaves no undo step.
function GraphEditor:_onDown()
	local ht, hi = self:_findNearest()
	local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
	-- Double-click detection
	if (ht == "kp" or ht == "envTop" or ht == "envBot") and hi then
		local now = os.clock()
		if self._lastClickIndex == hi and (now - self._lastClickTime) < C.DOUBLE_CLICK_TIME then
			self:_selectSingle(hi)
			self:_showEditPanel()
			if (ht == "envTop" or ht == "envBot") and self._eIn then
				task.defer(function()
					if self._editPanelOpen and self._eIn then
						self._eIn:CaptureFocus()
					end
				end)
			end
			self:_redraw()
			self._lastClickTime = 0
			self._lastClickIndex = nil
			return
		end
		self._lastClickTime = now
		self._lastClickIndex = hi
	else
		self._lastClickTime = 0
		self._lastClickIndex = nil
	end
	if ht then
		if ht == "kp" then
			-- Shift on a selected keypoint removes it (no drag); Shift on another adds it and drags. A plain
			-- click on a selected keypoint keeps the selection and selects it alone on release if nothing
			-- moved; a plain click elsewhere selects only it.
			local enterDrag = true
			if shift then
				if self:_isSelected(hi) then
					self:_toggleSelectIndex(hi)
					enterDrag = false
				else
					self:_toggleSelectIndex(hi)
				end
			elseif self:_isSelected(hi) and self:_selectedCount() > 1 then
				self._pendingSingleSelect = hi
			elseif not self:_isSelected(hi) then
				self:_selectSingle(hi)
			end
			if enterDrag then
				self._state.selection.primary = hi
			end
			if self._editPanelOpen then
				self:_updateEditPanelValues()
				self:_positionEditPanel()
			end
			self:_pushUndo()
			if enterDrag then
				self._interactionState = "dragging_kp"
				self._dragStartNorm = { self:_mouseNorm() }
				self._dragStartKps = {}
				for idx in pairs(self._state.selection.indices) do
					local kp = self._state.keypoints[idx]
					if kp then
						self._dragStartKps[idx] = { time = kp.time, value = kp.value }
					end
				end
			end
		elseif ht == "envTop" or ht == "envBot" then
			self:_selectSingle(hi)
			if self._editPanelOpen then
				self:_updateEditPanelValues()
				self:_positionEditPanel()
			end
			self:_pushUndo()
			self._interactionState = "dragging_" .. ht
			self._dragStartNorm = { self:_mouseNorm() }
		elseif ht == "handleOut" or ht == "handleIn" then
			self:_selectSingle(hi)
			self:_pushUndo()
			-- A handle dragged by hand is the user's: Smooth stops laying them.
			self:_releaseSmooth()
			self._interactionState = "dragging_" .. ht
			self._dragStartNorm = { self:_mouseNorm() }
		end
		self._ghostDot.Visible = false
		self._ghostLineL.Visible = false
		self._ghostLineR.Visible = false
		self._tooltip.Visible = false
		self:_redraw()
		return
	end
	-- Empty space: close the floating panels, then box-select.
	if self._editPanelOpen then self:_hideEditPanel() end
	if self._simpPanel and self._simpPanel.Visible then self._simpPanel.Visible = false end
	self._ghostDot.Visible = false; self._ghostLineL.Visible = false
	self._ghostLineR.Visible = false; self._tooltip.Visible = false
	self._interactionState = "box_selecting"
	self._boxStart = { self:_mouseNorm() }
	self._boxRect.Visible = true
end
function GraphEditor:_onDragMove()
	local s = self._state
	local kps = s.keypoints
	local nx, rawNy = self:_mouseNorm()
	local ny = U.clamp(rawNy, 0, 1)
	local time, value = self:_normToData(nx, ny)
	-- Ctrl snaps Time to 0.1 and Value to a round step (U.snapValue), before the per-drag branches so
	-- handle drags get it too; Shift locks an axis in a keypoint drag.
	local ctrlHeld = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
	if ctrlHeld then
		time = U.snapTime(time)
		value = U.snapValue(value, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
	end
	if self._interactionState == "dragging_kp" then
		if self._dragStartNorm and self._dragStartKps then
			local startTime, startValue = self:_normToData(self._dragStartNorm[1], self._dragStartNorm[2])
			local deltaTime = time - startTime
			-- The mouse may leave the graph: the value clamp below stops the keypoint at the edge, so a
			-- keypoint grabbed off-centre still reaches rangeMin / rangeMax.
			local _, freeValue = self:_normToData(nx, rawNy)
			local deltaValue = freeValue - startValue
			local shiftHeld = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
			if shiftHeld then
				local dx = math.abs(nx - self._dragStartNorm[1])
				local dy = math.abs(ny - self._dragStartNorm[2])
				if dx > dy then deltaValue = 0 else deltaTime = 0 end
			end
			-- Each selected keypoint keeps value +/- its envelope inside the range: the drag clamps to the
			-- tightest delta among them.
			local maxDeltaUp = math.huge
			local maxDeltaDown = -math.huge
			for idx, startPos in pairs(self._dragStartKps) do
				local kp = kps[idx]
				if kp then
					local env = kp.envelope or 0
					local up = s.rangeMax - startPos.value - env
					local down = s.rangeMin - startPos.value + env
					if up < maxDeltaUp then maxDeltaUp = up end
					if down > maxDeltaDown then maxDeltaDown = down end
				end
			end
			if maxDeltaUp < maxDeltaDown then maxDeltaUp, maxDeltaDown = maxDeltaDown, maxDeltaUp end -- an impossible constraint
			deltaValue = math.clamp(deltaValue, maxDeltaDown, maxDeltaUp)
			for idx, startPos in pairs(self._dragStartKps) do
				local kp = kps[idx]
				if kp then
					local newTime = startPos.time + deltaTime
					local newValue = startPos.value + deltaValue
					-- Ctrl snaps the keypoint itself onto the grid, kept inside the view.
					if ctrlHeld then
						local env = kp.envelope or 0
						newValue = U.clamp(U.snapValue(newValue, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax), s.rangeMin + env, s.rangeMax - env)
					end


					if idx == 1 then newTime = 0
					elseif idx == #kps then newTime = 1
					else newTime = U.clamp(newTime, 0, 1) end
					kp.time = U.round(newTime, 4)
					kp.value = U.round(newValue, 4)
				end
			end
			if self:_selectedCount() == 1 then
				local pri = self:_getPrimary()
				if pri and pri > 1 and pri < #kps then
					local kp = kps[pri]
					local moved = true
					while moved do
						moved = false
						if pri > 1 and kp.time < kps[pri - 1].time then
							kps[pri], kps[pri - 1] = kps[pri - 1], kps[pri]
							pri = pri - 1; moved = true
						elseif pri < #kps and kp.time > kps[pri + 1].time then
							kps[pri], kps[pri + 1] = kps[pri + 1], kps[pri]
							pri = pri + 1; moved = true
						end
						if pri <= 1 or pri >= #kps then break end
					end
					self._state.selection = { indices = { [pri] = true }, primary = pri }
					self._dragStartKps = { [pri] = self._dragStartKps[next(self._dragStartKps)] or { time = kp.time, value = kp.value } }
				end
			else
				-- Re-sort when a keypoint crossed a neighbour.
				local needsSort = false
				for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
					if kps[i].time > kps[i + 1].time then needsSort = true; break end
				end
				if needsSort then
					-- Selection and drag starts follow their keypoints through the sort.
					local selRefs = {}
					local priRef = s.selection.primary and kps[s.selection.primary]
					for idx in pairs(s.selection.indices) do
						local kp = kps[idx]
						if kp then selRefs[kp] = self._dragStartKps[idx] end
					end
					table.sort(kps, function(a, b) return a.time < b.time end)
					local newSel = { indices = {}, primary = nil }
					local newDragStart = {}
					for i, kp in ipairs(kps) do
						if selRefs[kp] then
							newSel.indices[i] = true
							if kp == priRef then newSel.primary = i end
							newDragStart[i] = selRefs[kp]
						end
					end
					if not newSel.primary then newSel.primary = next(newSel.indices) end
					self._state.selection = newSel
					self._dragStartKps = newDragStart
				end
			end
			-- Time changes can leave handles past their neighbours: re-clamp all.
			self:_reclampAllHandles()
		end
	elseif self._interactionState == "dragging_envTop" or self._interactionState == "dragging_envBot" then
		local pri = self:_getPrimary()
		local kp = pri and kps[pri]
		if kp then
			-- The envelope is one symmetric value, so it clamps to the tighter bound whichever side is dragged;
			-- the mouse clamp alone leaves rounding slivers that the band's slope magnifies.
			local topBound = math.max(0, self._state.rangeMax - kp.value)
			local botBound = math.max(0, kp.value - self._state.rangeMin)
			local maxEnv = math.min(topBound, botBound)
			local raw = (self._interactionState == "dragging_envTop") and (value - kp.value) or (kp.value - value)
			kp.envelope = U.round(U.clamp(raw, 0, maxEnv), 4)
		end
	elseif self._interactionState == "dragging_handleOut" or self._interactionState == "dragging_handleIn" then
		local pri = self:_getPrimary()
		local kp = pri and kps[pri]
		if kp then
			-- Handle X stays within its neighbour's time so the bezier is a function of time; with sync on,
			-- within the mirrored side's gap too.
			local nxtT = (pri < #kps) and kps[pri + 1].time or 1
			local prvT = (pri > 1) and kps[pri - 1].time or 0
			local rightGap = nxtT - kp.time
			local leftGap = kp.time - prvT
			-- With sync on the mirrored handle's Y is -Y, so |Y| clamps to the tighter headroom.
			local topHead = math.max(0, s.rangeMax - kp.value)
			local botHead = math.max(0, kp.value - s.rangeMin)
			local isOut = (self._interactionState == "dragging_handleOut")
			local rawX = isOut and (time - kp.time) or -(time - kp.time) -- positive on both sides
			local rawY = value - kp.value
			-- An endpoint has one side only, so sync has nothing to mirror and its two-sided clamp would pin the
			-- handle at 0: sync is off for endpoint drags.
			local effectiveSync = s.syncHandles and pri > 1 and pri < #kps
			local maxX = isOut and rightGap or leftGap
			if effectiveSync then
				maxX = math.max(0, math.min(rightGap, leftGap))
				local maxY = math.min(topHead, botHead)
				rawY = math.clamp(rawY, -maxY, maxY)
			end
			-- X floors at MIN_HANDLE_FRAC so the handle can be grabbed apart from its keypoint; a tighter gap
			-- pins it at maxX.
			local minX = math.min(C.MIN_HANDLE_FRAC, math.max(0, maxX))
			local clampedX = U.round(math.clamp(rawX, minX, math.max(0, maxX)), 4)
			local clampedY = U.round(rawY, 4)
			if isOut then
				kp.handleOutX = clampedX; kp.handleOutY = clampedY
				if effectiveSync then kp.handleInX = -clampedX; kp.handleInY = -clampedY end
			else
				kp.handleInX = -clampedX; kp.handleInY = clampedY
				if effectiveSync then kp.handleOutX = clampedX; kp.handleOutY = -clampedY end
			end
		end
	end
	if self._editPanelOpen then self:_updateEditPanelValues(); self:_positionEditPanel() end
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
end
function GraphEditor:_onBoxSelectMove()
	if not self._boxStart then return end
	local nx, ny = self:_mouseNorm()
	local bsx, bsy = self._boxStart[1], self._boxStart[2]
	local minX, maxX = math.min(bsx, nx), math.max(bsx, nx)
	local minY, maxY = math.min(bsy, ny), math.max(bsy, ny)
	self._boxRect.Position = UDim2.new(minX, 0, minY, 0)
	self._boxRect.Size = UDim2.new(maxX - minX, 0, maxY - minY, 0)
end
function GraphEditor:_onBoxSelectEnd()
	if not self._boxStart then return end
	local nx, ny = self:_mouseNorm()
	local bsx, bsy = self._boxStart[1], self._boxStart[2]
	local dx = math.abs(nx - bsx)
	local dy = math.abs(ny - bsy)
	if dx < C.BOX_SELECT_THRESHOLD and dy < C.BOX_SELECT_THRESHOLD then
		local time, value = self:_normToData(bsx, bsy)
		time = U.clamp(time, 0, 1)
		self:_addKp(U.round(time, 4), U.round(value, 4))
	else
		local minX, maxX = math.min(bsx, nx), math.max(bsx, nx)
		local minY, maxY = math.min(bsy, ny), math.max(bsy, ny)
		local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
		if not shift then self:_clearSelection() end
		for i, kp in ipairs(self._state.keypoints) do
			local knx, kny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
			if knx >= minX and knx <= maxX and kny >= minY and kny <= maxY then
				self._state.selection.indices[i] = true
				if not self._state.selection.primary then self._state.selection.primary = i end
			end
		end
		self:_redraw()
	end
	self._boxRect.Visible = false
end
-- Y pan (time is fixed to 0..1): the value under the cursor follows it 1:1, then the range clamps
-- to the data.
function GraphEditor:_onPanMove()
	if not self._panStartMouse or not self._panStartView then return end
	local _, ny = self:_mouseNorm()
	local dy = ny - self._panStartMouse[2]
	local startRange = self._panStartView.rangeMax - self._panStartView.rangeMin
	local shift = dy * startRange
	self._state.rangeMin = self._panStartView.rangeMin + shift
	self._state.rangeMax = self._panStartView.rangeMax + shift
	self:_clampRangeToKeypoints()
	self._rMinIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", self._state.rangeMin)
	self._rMaxIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", self._state.rangeMax)
	self:_redraw()
end
-- Y zoom about the cursor, 0.85 or 1/0.85 per step, keeping the value under the cursor in place;
-- the range then clamps so the data plus 5% stays visible.
function GraphEditor:_onScroll(dir)
	local nx, ny = self:_mouseNorm()
	local _, cursorValue = self:_normToData(nx, ny)
	local s = self._state
	local range = math.max(0.001, s.rangeMax - s.rangeMin)
	local factor = dir > 0 and 0.85 or (1 / 0.85)
	local newRange = range * factor
	local cursorFrac = (cursorValue - s.rangeMin) / range
	s.rangeMin = cursorValue - cursorFrac * newRange
	s.rangeMax = cursorValue + (1 - cursorFrac) * newRange
	self:_clampRangeToKeypoints()
	self._rMinIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMin)
	self._rMaxIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMax)
	self:_showActionPopup(string.format("Range: %.3g \xe2\x80\x93 %.3g", s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax))
	self:_redraw()
end
function GraphEditor:_clampRangeToKeypoints()
	local s = self._state
	local lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, kp in ipairs(s.keypoints) do
		lo = math.min(lo, kp.value - kp.envelope)
		hi = math.max(hi, kp.value + kp.envelope)
	end
	if lo < math.huge then
		local pad = math.max(0.1, (hi - lo) * 0.05)
		if s.rangeMin > lo - pad then s.rangeMin = lo - pad end
		if s.rangeMax < hi + pad then s.rangeMax = hi + pad end
	end
end
end

--[[
	Interaction mixin: clipboard, selection, coordinates, hit testing, range fitting, live preview,
	the bake to a sequence, the bezier data and Invert. Input wiring is in InputWiring, the edit panel
	in EditMode.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder.Widgets)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return function(GraphEditor)


function GraphEditor:SetClipboardCallbacks(onCopy, onGetClip)
	self._onCopy = onCopy
	self._onGetClip = onGetClip
	self:_updatePasteBtn()
end

function GraphEditor:_copyToClipboard()
	if not self._onCopy then return end
	local s = self._state
	local clipData = {
		keypoints = self:_snapshotKps(),
		rangeMin = s.rangeMin,
		rangeMax = s.rangeMax,
		handlesEnabled = s.handlesEnabled,
		envelopeEnabled = s.envelopeEnabled,
		propName = s.propName,
	}
	self._onCopy(clipData)
	self:_updatePasteBtn()
	self:_flashCopied()
end

-- Feedback for a copy: the header's Copy button turns green for a moment. A view without that
-- button replaces this method.
function GraphEditor:_flashCopied()
	self._copyBtn.TextColor3 = self._T.Green
	task.delay(0.4, function()
		if self._copyBtn then self._copyBtn.TextColor3 = self._T.Gold end
	end)
end

-- Values, envelopes and handle Y map from the clipboard's range into this editor's; times and handle
-- X stay. Missing handle Y reads as 0 (a clip of a linear graph has none).
function GraphEditor:_pasteFromClipboard()
	if not self._onGetClip then return end
	local clip = self._onGetClip()
	if not clip or not clip.keypoints or #clip.keypoints < 2 then return end

	self:_pushUndo()
	local s = self._state
	local srcRange = clip.rangeMax - clip.rangeMin
	local dstRange = s.rangeMax - s.rangeMin

	s.keypoints = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(clip.keypoints) do
		local normalizedVal = (srcRange > 0) and ((kp.value - clip.rangeMin) / srcRange) or 0
		local scaledVal = s.rangeMin + normalizedVal * dstRange
		local normalizedEnv = (srcRange > 0) and (kp.envelope / srcRange) or 0
		local scaledEnv = normalizedEnv * dstRange
		local normalizedHInY = (srcRange > 0) and ((kp.handleInY or 0) / srcRange) or 0
		local normalizedHOutY = (srcRange > 0) and ((kp.handleOutY or 0) / srcRange) or 0

		table.insert(s.keypoints, {
			time = kp.time,
			value = scaledVal,
			envelope = math.abs(scaledEnv),
			handleInX = kp.handleInX, handleInY = normalizedHInY * dstRange,
			handleOutX = kp.handleOutX, handleOutY = normalizedHOutY * dstRange,
		})
	end

	s.handlesEnabled = clip.handlesEnabled or false
	-- A clip without envelopeEnabled shows the envelope only when its keypoints carry one.
	if clip.envelopeEnabled ~= nil then
		s.envelopeEnabled = clip.envelopeEnabled == true
	else
		local hasEnv = false
		for _, kp in ipairs(s.keypoints) do
			if kp.envelope and kp.envelope > 1e-4 then hasEnv = true; break end
		end
		s.envelopeEnabled = hasEnv
	end
	self._handlesEverEnabled = s.handlesEnabled
	self:_syncUIToState()
	self:_clearSelection()
	self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_layoutEditPanel()
	self:_adaptRange()
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
end

function GraphEditor:_updatePasteBtn()
	if not self._pasteBtn then return end
	local hasClip = self._onGetClip and self._onGetClip() ~= nil
	self:_paintHeaderButton(self._pasteBtn, hasClip, self._T.MutedGold)
end


function GraphEditor:_clearSelection()
	self._state.selection = { indices = {}, primary = nil }
end

function GraphEditor:_selectSingle(idx)
	self._state.selection = { indices = { [idx] = true }, primary = idx }
end

function GraphEditor:_toggleSelectIndex(idx)
	local sel = self._state.selection
	if sel.indices[idx] then
		sel.indices[idx] = nil
		if sel.primary == idx then sel.primary = next(sel.indices) end
	else
		sel.indices[idx] = true
		sel.primary = idx
	end
end

function GraphEditor:_isSelected(idx)
	return self._state.selection.indices[idx] == true
end

function GraphEditor:_selectedCount()
	local c = 0
	for _ in pairs(self._state.selection.indices) do c = c + 1 end
	return c
end

function GraphEditor:_getPrimary()
	return self._state.selection.primary
end


function GraphEditor:_kpToNorm(kp)
	return U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time, kp.value, self._state.rangeMin, self._state.rangeMax)
end

function GraphEditor:_daPos() return self._drawArea.AbsolutePosition end
function GraphEditor:_daSz() return self._drawArea.AbsoluteSize end

function GraphEditor:_mouseNorm()
	local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local p = self:_daPos(); local s = self:_daSz()
	return (m.X - p.X) / s.X, (m.Y - p.Y) / s.Y
end

function GraphEditor:_mouseInGraph()
	local nx, ny = self:_mouseNorm()
	return nx >= -0.05 and nx <= 1.05 and ny >= -0.05 and ny <= 1.05
end

-- No ghost, box select or wheel zoom under an overlay (edit popover, Simplify, help, Show popup) or an
-- edge bar (status bar, preset strip).
function GraphEditor:_isMouseOverUI()
	local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local function isOver(frame)
		if not frame or not frame.Visible then return false end
		local pos = frame.AbsolutePosition
		local sz = frame.AbsoluteSize
		return mouse.X >= pos.X and mouse.X <= pos.X + sz.X
			and mouse.Y >= pos.Y and mouse.Y <= pos.Y + sz.Y
	end
	-- The plot hidden behind another page of the window, or covered at the cursor by a menu, a
	-- popup, an open list or another panel (Widgets.pointerBlocked): no plot input.
	if not self._graphFrame.Visible then return true end
	if Widgets.pointerBlocked(self._graphFrame) then return true end
	if isOver(self._editPanel) then return true end
	if isOver(self._simpPanel) then return true end
	if isOver(self._helpOverlay) then return true end
	if isOver(self._statusBar) then return true end
	if isOver(self._presetStrip) then return true end
	if isOver(self._showPopup) then return true end
	if self:_isTextBoxFocused() then return true end
	return false
end

-- Product of every UIScale up the ancestry (nested UIScales multiply), floored at 0.01 for callers
-- that divide by it.
function GraphEditor:_getUIScale()
	return self:_scaleFrom(self._panel)
end

-- Scale of the panel's ancestors only (position math: Position.Offset lives in the parent's space).
function GraphEditor:_getOuterUIScale()
	return self:_scaleFrom(self._panel and self._panel.Parent)
end

function GraphEditor:_scaleFrom(f)
	local scale = 1
	while f and f:IsA("GuiBase2d") do
		local usc = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if usc then scale = scale * usc.Scale end
		f = f.Parent
	end
	return math.max(0.01, scale)
end

function GraphEditor:_normToData(nx, ny)
	return U.normToData(self._view, nx, ny, self._state.rangeMin, self._state.rangeMax)
end


function GraphEditor:_findNearest()
	local s = self._state; local kps = s.keypoints; local sz = self:_daSz()
	local mnx, mny = self:_mouseNorm()

	local function pxDist(vnx, vny)
		local dx = (mnx - vnx) * sz.X; local dy = (mny - vny) * sz.Y
		return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	end

	local bi, bd = nil, C.HIT_LIMIT_PX
	for i, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local knx, kny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
		local d = pxDist(knx, kny)
		if d < bd then bd = d; bi = i end
	end

	-- Envelope ticks and bezier handles (primary keypoint only) compete on cursor distance, each within
	-- its own hit radius (ENV_HIT_PX, HANDLE_HIT_PX).
	local bestType, bestDist = nil, math.huge

	if s.envelopeEnabled and s.selection.primary then
		local pri = s.selection.primary
		local kp = kps[pri]
		if kp then
			local knx, kny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
			local tNy, bNy
			if kp.envelope > 0 then
				_, tNy = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time, kp.value + kp.envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
				_, bNy = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time, kp.value - kp.envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			else
				tNy = kny - C.ENV_ZERO_OFFSET; bNy = kny + C.ENV_ZERO_OFFSET
			end
			local dTop = pxDist(knx, tNy)
			local dBot = pxDist(knx, bNy)
			if dTop < C.ENV_HIT_PX and dTop < bestDist then bestType, bestDist = "envTop", dTop end
			if dBot < C.ENV_HIT_PX and dBot < bestDist then bestType, bestDist = "envBot", dBot end
		end
	end

	if s.handlesEnabled and s.selection.primary then
		local pri = s.selection.primary
		local kp = kps[pri]
		if kp then
			if pri < #kps then
				local hnx, hny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time + kp.handleOutX, kp.value + kp.handleOutY, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
				local d = pxDist(hnx, hny)
				if d < C.HANDLE_HIT_PX and d < bestDist then bestType, bestDist = "handleOut", d end
			end
			if pri > 1 then
				local hnx, hny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time + kp.handleInX, kp.value + kp.handleInY, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
				local d = pxDist(hnx, hny)
				if d < C.HANDLE_HIT_PX and d < bestDist then bestType, bestDist = "handleIn", d end
			end
		end
	end

	-- An overlay beats the keypoint only when strictly closer, so a click on its centre stays "kp".
	if bestType and bestDist < (bd or C.HIT_LIMIT_PX) then
		return bestType, s.selection.primary
	end

	if bi then return "kp", bi end

	return nil, nil
end


function GraphEditor:_isTextBoxFocused()
	local boxes = { self._tIn, self._vIn, self._eIn, self._rMinIn, self._rMaxIn,
		self._segIn, self._envAddIn, self._codeBox }
	for _, tb in ipairs(boxes) do
		if tb and tb:IsFocused() then return true end
	end
	return false
end


function GraphEditor:_autoExpandRange(value, envelope)
	local s = self._state
	local top = value + (envelope or 0)
	local bot = value - (envelope or 0)
	local changed = false
	local currentRange = math.max(0.001, s.rangeMax - s.rangeMin)
	local pad = math.max(0.5, currentRange * 0.3)

	if top > s.rangeMax then s.rangeMax = top + pad; changed = true end
	if bot < s.rangeMin then s.rangeMin = bot - pad; changed = true end

	if changed then
		self._rMinIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMin :: number)
		self._rMaxIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMax :: number)
	end
end

function GraphEditor:_adaptRange(forceUnit)
	local s = self._state
	if #s.keypoints == 0 then return end
	-- Fit includes handle ends in bezier mode. forceUnit (default true) keeps 0..1 in view; the Fit
	-- button passes false for a tight crop.
	local fu = forceUnit; if fu == nil then fu = true end
	local newMin, newMax = U.autoRange(s.keypoints, s.handlesEnabled, fu)
	if newMin ~= s.rangeMin or newMax ~= s.rangeMax then
		s.rangeMin = newMin; s.rangeMax = newMax
		self._rMinIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMin :: number)
		self._rMaxIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMax :: number)
		self:_redraw()
	end
end


-- onPreview at most once per C.PREVIEW_INTERVAL: a call inside the window arms one deferred preview,
-- which checks the editor is still open.
function GraphEditor:_tryPreview()
	if not self._state.onPreview then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self._lastPreviewTime < C.PREVIEW_INTERVAL then
		if not self._previewPending then
			self._previewPending = true
			task.delay(C.PREVIEW_INTERVAL, function()
				self._previewPending = false
				if self._panel.Visible and self._state.onPreview then
					self._lastPreviewTime = os.clock()
					self._state.onPreview(self:_toSeq())
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
	self._lastPreviewTime = now
	self._state.onPreview(self:_toSeq())
end


function GraphEditor:_toSeq()
	self:_laySmooth()
	local s = self._state; local kps = s.keypoints
	if not s.handlesEnabled then
		local nk = {}
		for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
			local env = s.envelopeEnabled and kp.envelope or 0
			table.insert(nk, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.time, kp.value, env))
		end
		return NumberSequence.new(nk)
	end
	-- Bezier bake: dense samples reduced by RDP to the segment budget, so points land where the curve
	-- bends; epsilon is bisected for the densest result within budget.
	local envOn = s.envelopeEnabled
	local budget = math.clamp(s.segments + 1, 3, C.MAX_KEYPOINTS)
	local samples = self:_sampleCurve(96)
	local valRange = math.max(1e-9, (s.rangeMax or 1) - (s.rangeMin or 0))
	local lo, hi = 0, valRange
	local best = nil
	for _ = 1, 25 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) / 2
		local keep = self:_rdpSimplify(samples, mid)
		if #keep <= budget then
			if not best or #keep > #best then best = keep end
			hi = mid
		else
			lo = mid
		end
	end
	if not best then best = self:_rdpSimplify(samples, valRange) end

	-- The envelope interpolates the authored keypoints linearly, as in linear mode.
	local function envAt(t)
		local env = kps[#kps].envelope
		for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
			if t >= kps[i].time and (t <= kps[i+1].time or i == #kps-1) then
				local sr = kps[i+1].time - kps[i].time
				local u = U.clamp(sr > 0 and ((t - kps[i].time) / sr) or 0, 0, 1)
				env = kps[i].envelope + (kps[i+1].envelope - kps[i].envelope) * u
				break
			end
		end
		return env
	end

	-- NumberSequence rejects non-ascending times, and curve samples can tie at overhangs.
	local nk = {}
	local lastT = -1
	for _, idx in ipairs(best) do
		local sm = samples[idx]
		local t = U.clamp(sm.time, 0, 1)
		if t > lastT + 1e-4 then
			table.insert(nk, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, sm.value, envOn and envAt(t) or 0))
			lastT = t
		end
	end
	if #nk < 2 then
		local v = #nk == 1 and nk[1].Value or (samples[1] and samples[1].value or 0)
		local e = #nk == 1 and nk[1].Envelope or 0
		nk = { NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, v, e), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, v, e) }
	end
	-- Exact endpoint times; endpoint envelopes kept.
	nk[1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, nk[1].Value, nk[1].Envelope)
	nk[#nk] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, nk[#nk].Value, nk[#nk].Envelope)
	return NumberSequence.new(nk)
end

-- Serializable bezier keypoint data, or nil with handles off.
function GraphEditor:_getBezierData()
	if not self._state.handlesEnabled then return nil end
	-- Envelope off writes zero envelopes: reopening prefers the bezier data and would bring the old
	-- ones back.
	local envOn = self._state.envelopeEnabled == true
	local data = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(self._state.keypoints) do
		table.insert(data, {
			t = kp.time, v = kp.value, e = envOn and kp.envelope or 0,
			hix = kp.handleInX, hiy = kp.handleInY,
			hox = kp.handleOutX, hoy = kp.handleOutY,
		})
	end
	-- The Smooth slider's amount rides on the first entry (Smooth.amountOf reads it back): the
	-- readers of this data take only the fields they know.
	if (self._state.smooth or 0) > 0 and data[1] then
		data[1].sm = self._state.smooth
	end
	return data
end


-- Flips values about their midpoint. Not a time reverse, which is ColorGradientEditor's Invert: a
-- NumberSequence wants the value flip, a gradient the time flip.
function GraphEditor:_invertGraph()
	local s = self._state; local kps = s.keypoints
	if not kps or #kps < 2 then return end
	self:_pushUndo()
	-- Hinges on the data's extents, not the view, so zoom does not change the result.
	local vMin, vMax = math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do vMin = math.min(vMin, kp.value); vMax = math.max(vMax, kp.value) end
	-- Handle Y negates with the values; handle X stays (time is not reversed).
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		kp.value = vMin + (vMax - kp.value)
		kp.handleInY = -kp.handleInY
		kp.handleOutY = -kp.handleOutY
	end
	self:_clearSelection()
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
	self:_showActionPopup("Inverted")
end

end

--[[
	Layout: sizes and positions of the regions of the graph editor's Classic view (ViewClassic).
	  Layout.CLASSIC                    the region sizes
	  Layout.stripY(L)                  top of the preset bar
	  Layout.graphY(L, presetsOpen)     top of the plot
	  Layout.graphH(L, presetsOpen)     height of the plot
	  Layout.statusY(L), Layout.footerY(L)
	BuildUI, BuildUIControls, ViewClassic and EditMode (_positionEditPanel) all place regions from this
	table, so they stay in step. ViewCompact anchors its regions and needs none.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)

local Layout = {}

-- side / top / bottom: panel margins. gap: space between regions.
-- presetCollapsedH is also the height of the preset bar's own title row.
Layout.CLASSIC = table.freeze({
	panelW = C.PANEL_W, panelH = C.PANEL_H,
	side = 6, top = 4, bottom = 4, gap = 4,
	headerH = C.HEADER_H, headerGap = 2, buttonY = 3, buttonH = 18,
	presetH = C.PRESET_STRIP_H, presetCollapsedH = C.PRESET_BAR_COLLAPSED_H, presetsOpen = false,
	statusH = C.STATUS_BAR_H, footerH = C.FOOTER_H,
})

function Layout.stripY(L)
	return L.top + L.headerH + L.headerGap
end

function Layout.graphY(L, presetsOpen)
	local stripH = presetsOpen and L.presetH or L.presetCollapsedH
	return Layout.stripY(L) + stripH + L.gap
end

function Layout.footerY(L)
	return L.panelH - L.footerH - L.bottom
end

function Layout.statusY(L)
	return Layout.footerY(L) - L.gap - L.statusH
end

function Layout.graphH(L, presetsOpen)
	return Layout.statusY(L) - L.gap - Layout.graphY(L, presetsOpen)
end

return Layout

--[[
	PresetThumb  -  draws one preset's curve as short line segments inside a frame.
	  PresetThumb.draw(parent, preset, width, height, T, trackColor, zIndex, inset)
	    width, height: the frame's size in offsets; segment lengths are fixed for it.
	    trackColor(line, "BackgroundColor3", "Gold") registers each segment for theme changes.
	    inset: { Left, Width, Top, Height } as shares of the frame, the box the curve is drawn
	    in. Default: a small margin and the upper 75%, which leaves the bottom for a name label.
]]

local U = require(script.Parent.Util)

local STRIP_INSET = { Left = 0.06, Width = 0.88, Top = 0.05, Height = 0.7 }

local PresetThumb = {}

function PresetThumb.draw(parent, preset, width, height, T, trackColor, zIndex, inset)
	inset = inset or STRIP_INSET
	if preset.handles then
		-- Bezier presets: the cubic sampled at sampleCount + 1 points; the margins keep the curve off the
		-- thumb's rounded corners.
		local kpData = preset.kps
		local p0t, p0v = kpData[1][1], kpData[1][2]
		local p1t, p1v = kpData[2][1], kpData[2][2]
		local hOutX = kpData[1].hOutX or 0
		local hOutY = kpData[1].hOutY or 0
		local hInX = kpData[2].hInX or 0
		local hInY = kpData[2].hInY or 0
		local sampleCount = 16
		local prevNx, prevNy
		for si = 0, sampleCount do
			local st = si / sampleCount
			local ct = U.cubicBez(st, p0t, p0t + hOutX, p1t + hInX, p1t)
			local cv = U.cubicBez(st, p0v, p0v + hOutY, p1v + hInY, p1v)
			local snx = inset.Left + ct * inset.Width
			local sny = inset.Top + (1 - cv) * inset.Height
			if prevNx then
				local line = U.drawLineStatic(parent, prevNx, prevNy, snx, sny, T.Gold, 1.5, 0.2, width, height, 1)
				if line then line.ZIndex = zIndex; trackColor(line, "BackgroundColor3", "Gold") end
			end
			prevNx, prevNy = snx, sny
		end
	else
		for j = 1, #preset.kps - 1 do
			local k1t, k1v = preset.kps[j][1], preset.kps[j][2]
			local k2t, k2v = preset.kps[j+1][1], preset.kps[j+1][2]
			local subSegs = 8
			for si = 0, subSegs - 1 do
				local a1, a2 = si / subSegs, (si + 1) / subSegs
				local nx1 = inset.Left + (k1t + (k2t - k1t) * a1) * inset.Width
				local ny1 = inset.Top + (1 - (k1v + (k2v - k1v) * a1)) * inset.Height
				local nx2 = inset.Left + (k1t + (k2t - k1t) * a2) * inset.Width
				local ny2 = inset.Top + (1 - (k1v + (k2v - k1v) * a2)) * inset.Height
				local line = U.drawLineStatic(parent, nx1, ny1, nx2, ny2, T.Gold, 1.5, 0.2, width, height, 1)
				if line then line.ZIndex = zIndex; trackColor(line, "BackgroundColor3", "Gold") end
			end
		end
	end

end

return PresetThumb

--[[
	RenderDraw mixin: pooled drawing: _redraw, the grid, linear and bezier curves, envelope fills.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)
local UIConstants = require(script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder.TypeScale)

return function(GraphEditor)

-- A grid label's face: Classic's theme font at every redraw; elsewhere the Caption role's, set the
-- first time a label is drawn and then by TypeScale.reapply, so a redraw never undoes a live mode
-- change. Labels are pooled for the editor's life.
function GraphEditor:_gridLabelFont(label, theme)
	if UIConstants.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		label.Font = theme.Font
		return
	end
	self._styledLabels = self._styledLabels or {}
	if not self._styledLabels[label] then
		self._styledLabels[label] = true
		TypeScale.style(label, "Caption")
	end
end


-- Releases every pool and draws the current state in ZIndex order: grid, envelope, curve, keypoint
-- dots, envelope handles, bezier handles. The hover ring's _findNearest runs only when idle.
function GraphEditor:_redraw()
	-- Smooth's handles first, so what is drawn is what the bake and the preview write.
	self:_laySmooth()
	U.poolReleaseAll(self._linePool)
	U.poolReleaseAll(self._dotPool)
	U.poolReleaseAll(self._stripPool)
	U.poolReleaseAll(self._labelPool)

	local T = self._T; local s = self._state; local kps = s.keypoints
	if #kps == 0 then return end
	local ll = self._lineLayer
	local da = self._drawArea
	local absW, absH = ll.AbsoluteSize.X, ll.AbsoluteSize.Y
	if absW < 1 or absH < 1 then return end
	self._uiScale = self:_getUIScale()

	self:_drawGrid(absW, absH)

	-- The envelope draws first so the curve lies over it; with handles on, the band follows the bezier.
	if s.handlesEnabled then
		if s.envelopeEnabled then self:_drawEnvBez(absW, absH) end
		self:_drawBez(absW, absH)
	else
		if s.envelopeEnabled then self:_drawEnv(absW, absH) end
		self:_drawLin(absW, absH)
	end

	local hoveredIdx = nil
	if self._interactionState == "idle" then
		local ht, hi = self:_findNearest()
		if ht == "kp" then hoveredIdx = hi end
	end

	for i, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local nx, ny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
		local isPrimary = (i == s.selection.primary)
		local isSel = self:_isSelected(i)
		local isHovered = (i == hoveredIdx and not isSel)

		if isPrimary then
			local ring = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
			U.setupRing(ring, nx, ny, C.SEL_RING_PX, T.BrightGold, 1.5, 0.35, 5)
			local dot = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
			U.setupDot(dot, nx, ny, C.DOT_SEL_PX, T.BrightGold, 6)
		elseif isSel then
			local ring = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
			U.setupRing(ring, nx, ny, C.SEL_RING_PX - 2, T.Gold, 1, 0.5, 5)
			local dot = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
			U.setupDot(dot, nx, ny, C.DOT_MULTI_PX, T.Gold, 6)
		elseif isHovered then
			local dot = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
			U.setupDot(dot, nx, ny, C.DOT_HOVER_PX, T.Gold, 6)
		else
			local dot = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
			U.setupDot(dot, nx, ny, C.DOT_PX, T.Gold, 6)
		end
	end

	-- Envelope handles: stems and ticks on the primary keypoint.
	if s.envelopeEnabled and s.selection.primary then
		local pri = s.selection.primary
		local kp = kps[pri]
		if kp then
			local knx, kny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
			if kp.envelope > 0 then
				local _, tNy = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time, kp.value + kp.envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
				local _, bNy = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time, kp.value - kp.envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)

				if tNy >= -0.05 and tNy <= 1.05 then
					local stem = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, da)
					U.setupLine(stem, knx, U.clamp(kny, 0, 1), knx, U.clamp(tNy, 0, 1), T.MutedGold, 3, 0.1, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
					stem.ZIndex = 3
					local tC = U.clamp(tNy, -0.02, 1.02)
					local tick = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
					U.setupBar(tick, knx, tC, C.ENV_BAR_H, C.ENV_BAR_W, T.BrightGold, 0, 7)
				end
				if bNy >= -0.05 and bNy <= 1.05 then
					local stem = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, da)
					U.setupLine(stem, knx, U.clamp(kny, 0, 1), knx, U.clamp(bNy, 0, 1), T.MutedGold, 3, 0.1, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
					stem.ZIndex = 3
					local bC = U.clamp(bNy, -0.02, 1.02)
					local tick = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
					U.setupBar(tick, knx, bC, C.ENV_BAR_H, C.ENV_BAR_W, T.BrightGold, 0, 7)
				end
			else
				local topNy = kny - C.ENV_ZERO_OFFSET
				local botNy = kny + C.ENV_ZERO_OFFSET
				local stemUp = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, da)
				U.setupLine(stemUp, knx, kny, knx, topNy, T.MutedGold, 3, 0.1, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
				stemUp.ZIndex = 3
				local tickUp = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
				U.setupBar(tickUp, knx, topNy, C.ENV_BAR_H, C.ENV_ZERO_BAR_W, T.DarkGold, 0, 7)
				local stemDown = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, da)
				U.setupLine(stemDown, knx, kny, knx, botNy, T.MutedGold, 3, 0.1, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
				stemDown.ZIndex = 3
				local tickDown = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
				U.setupBar(tickDown, knx, botNy, C.ENV_BAR_H, C.ENV_ZERO_BAR_W, T.DarkGold, 0, 7)
			end
		end
	end

	if s.handlesEnabled and s.selection.primary then
		local kp = kps[s.selection.primary]
		if kp then
			local knx, kny = self:_kpToNorm(kp)
			if s.selection.primary < #kps then
				local hnx, hny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time + kp.handleOutX, kp.value + kp.handleOutY, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
				local hLine = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, da)
				if U.setupLine(hLine, knx, kny, hnx, hny, T.DarkGold, 1, 0.3, absW, absH, self._uiScale) then
					hLine.ZIndex = 3
				end
				local hDot = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
				U.setupDot(hDot, U.clamp(hnx,-0.02,1.02), U.clamp(hny,-0.02,1.02), C.HANDLE_PX, T.SliderFill, 7)
			end
			if s.selection.primary > 1 then
				local hnx, hny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kp.time + kp.handleInX, kp.value + kp.handleInY, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
				local hLine = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, da)
				if U.setupLine(hLine, knx, kny, hnx, hny, T.DarkGold, 1, 0.3, absW, absH, self._uiScale) then
					hLine.ZIndex = 3
				end
				local hDot = U.poolAcquire(self._dotPool, da)
				U.setupDot(hDot, U.clamp(hnx,-0.02,1.02), U.clamp(hny,-0.02,1.02), C.HANDLE_PX, T.SliderFill, 7)
			end
		end
	end
end


function GraphEditor:_drawGrid(absW, absH)
	local T = self._T; local s = self._state
	local ll = self._lineLayer; local al = self._axisLayer

	local visTimeMin = 0
	local visTimeMax = 1
	local dataRange = math.max(0.001, s.rangeMax - s.rangeMin)
	local visValMin = s.rangeMin
	local visValMax = s.rangeMax

	local xRange = visTimeMax - visTimeMin
	local xStepLine = U.niceStep(xRange)
	local xStepLabel = xStepLine
	local xLabelMax = 8
	while xRange / xStepLabel > xLabelMax do xStepLabel = xStepLabel * 2 end
	local xStart = math.ceil(visTimeMin / xStepLine) * xStepLine
	local xSafety = 0
	while xStart <= visTimeMax + xStepLine * 0.01 and xSafety < 50 do
		xSafety = xSafety + 1
		local nx = xStart
		if nx >= -0.02 and nx <= 1.02 then
			local line = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, ll)
			U.setupLine(line, nx, 0, nx, 1, T.DarkGold, 1, C.GRID_ALPHA, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
			local onLabelStep = math.abs(xStart / xStepLabel - math.floor(xStart / xStepLabel + 0.5)) < 0.001
			if onLabelStep then
				local label = U.poolAcquireLabel(self._labelPool, al)
				label.Text = U.fmtVal(xStart)
				label.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; self:_gridLabelFont(label, T); label.TextSize = self._gridLabelSize
				label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 14)
				label.Position = UDim2.new(0, C.DRAW_PAD.left + nx * absW / self._uiScale - 15, 1, -16)
				label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; label.ZIndex = 4
			end
		end
		xStart = xStart + xStepLine
	end
	local yRange = visValMax - visValMin
	local yStepLine = U.niceStep(yRange)
	local yStepLabel = yStepLine
	local yLabelMax = 6
	while yRange / yStepLabel > yLabelMax do yStepLabel = yStepLabel * 2 end
	local yStart = math.ceil(visValMin / yStepLine) * yStepLine
	local drawnCount = 0
	while yStart <= visValMax + yStepLine * 0.01 and drawnCount < 50 do
		drawnCount = drawnCount + 1
		local _, ny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, 0, yStart, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
		if ny >= -0.01 and ny <= 1.01 then
			local isZero = math.abs(yStart) < yStepLine * 0.001
			local lineColor = isZero and T.MutedGold or T.DarkGold
			local lineAlpha = isZero and C.GRID_ZERO_ALPHA or C.GRID_ALPHA
			local lineThick = isZero and 2 or 1
			local line = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, ll)
			U.setupLine(line, 0, ny, 1, ny, lineColor, lineThick, lineAlpha, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
			local onLabelStep = math.abs(yStart / yStepLabel - math.floor(yStart / yStepLabel + 0.5)) < 0.001
			local txt = U.fmtVal(yStart)
			if onLabelStep then
				local label = U.poolAcquireLabel(self._labelPool, al)
				label.Text = txt
				label.TextColor3 = isZero and T.MutedGold or T.DarkGold
				self:_gridLabelFont(label, T); label.TextSize = self._gridLabelSize
				label.Size = UDim2.new(0, C.GRID_LABEL_Y_W, 0, 14)
				label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, C.DRAW_PAD.top + ny * absH / self._uiScale - 7)
				label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right; label.ZIndex = 4
			end
		end
		yStart = yStart + yStepLine
	end
end


function GraphEditor:_drawLin(absW, absH)
	local T = self._T; local kps = self._state.keypoints; local ll = self._lineLayer
	for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
		local nx1, ny1 = self:_kpToNorm(kps[i])
		local nx2, ny2 = self:_kpToNorm(kps[i+1])
		local r = {U.clipLine(nx1, ny1, nx2, ny2)}
		if r[1] then
			local line = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, ll)
			U.setupLine(line, r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], T.BrightGold, C.CURVE_PX, 0.1, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
		end
	end
end

-- BEZIER_SEGS (120) points spread over the sub-curves, at least 10 each, so many keypoints add
-- points rather than lose smoothness.
function GraphEditor:_drawBez(absW, absH)
	local T = self._T; local kps = self._state.keypoints; local ll = self._lineLayer; local s = self._state
	for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
		local k1, k2 = kps[i], kps[i+1]
		local segs = math.max(10, math.floor(C.BEZIER_SEGS / math.max(1, #kps - 1)))
		local pnx, pny = self:_kpToNorm(k1)
		for si = 1, segs do
			local t = si / segs
			local cnx_t = U.cubicBez(t, k1.time, k1.time+k1.handleOutX, k2.time+k2.handleInX, k2.time)
			local cv = U.cubicBez(t, k1.value, k1.value+k1.handleOutY, k2.value+k2.handleInY, k2.value)
			local cnx, cny = U.dataToNorm(self._view, cnx_t, cv, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local r = {U.clipLine(pnx, pny, cnx, cny)}
			if r[1] then
				local line = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, ll)
				U.setupLine(line, r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], T.BrightGold, C.CURVE_PX, 0.1, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
			end
			pnx, pny = cnx, cny
		end
	end
end


-- Linear envelope band: ENV_STRIPS_PER_SEG strips per unit width (at least 2), each a rectangle at
-- its trapezoid's outer bounds; the small steps left hide under the 0.88 alpha and 0.002 padding.
function GraphEditor:_drawEnv(absW, absH)
	local T = self._T; local kps = self._state.keypoints; local ll = self._lineLayer; local s = self._state

	local hasEnv = false
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do if kp.envelope > 0 then hasEnv = true; break end end
	if not hasEnv then return end

	for seg = 1, #kps - 1 do
		local k1, k2 = kps[seg], kps[seg + 1]
		if k1.envelope <= 0 and k2.envelope <= 0 then continue end

		local t1, t2 = k1.time, k2.time
		local segW = t2 - t1
		if segW <= 0 then continue end

		local strips = math.max(2, math.ceil(C.ENV_STRIPS_PER_SEG * segW))
		for si = 0, strips - 1 do
			local a1 = si / strips
			local a2 = (si + 1) / strips
			local st1 = U.lerp(t1, t2, a1)
			local st2 = U.lerp(t1, t2, a2)
			local val1 = U.lerp(k1.value, k2.value, a1)
			local val2 = U.lerp(k1.value, k2.value, a2)
			local env1 = U.lerp(k1.envelope, k2.envelope, a1)
			local env2 = U.lerp(k1.envelope, k2.envelope, a2)

			local _, topNy1 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st1, val1 + env1, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local _, botNy1 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st1, val1 - env1, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local _, topNy2 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st2, val2 + env2, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local _, botNy2 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st2, val2 - env2, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)

			local nx1, _ = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st1, 0, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local nx2b, _ = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st2, 0, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)

			local topNy = math.min(topNy1, topNy2)
			local botNy = math.max(botNy1, botNy2)
			topNy = U.clamp(topNy, 0, 1); botNy = U.clamp(botNy, 0, 1)
			local h = botNy - topNy
			if h < 0.0005 then continue end

			local strip = U.poolAcquire(self._stripPool, ll)
			U.setupStrip(strip, nx1, topNy, nx2b - nx1 + 0.002, h + 0.002, T.DarkGold, 0.88, 1)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
		if kps[i].envelope <= 0 and kps[i+1].envelope <= 0 then continue end
		local nx1, tNy1 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kps[i].time, kps[i].value + kps[i].envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
		local nx2, tNy2 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kps[i+1].time, kps[i+1].value + kps[i+1].envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
		local _, bNy1 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kps[i].time, kps[i].value - kps[i].envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
		local _, bNy2 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, kps[i+1].time, kps[i+1].value - kps[i+1].envelope, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)

		local r1 = {U.clipLine(nx1, tNy1, nx2, tNy2)}
		if r1[1] then
			local line = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, ll)
			U.setupLine(line, r1[1], r1[2], r1[3], r1[4], T.Gold, 1, 0.35, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
		end
		local r2 = {U.clipLine(nx1, bNy1, nx2, bNy2)}
		if r2[1] then
			local line = U.poolAcquire(self._linePool, ll)
			U.setupLine(line, r2[1], r2[2], r2[3], r2[4], T.Gold, 1, 0.35, absW, absH, self._uiScale)
		end
	end
end

-- As _drawEnv, centred on the bezier rather than the chord; the width still interpolates linearly
-- between keypoints, as _toSeq samples it.
function GraphEditor:_drawEnvBez(absW, absH)
	local T = self._T; local kps = self._state.keypoints; local ll = self._lineLayer; local s = self._state

	local hasEnv = false
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do if kp.envelope > 0 then hasEnv = true; break end end
	if not hasEnv then return end

	for seg = 1, #kps - 1 do
		local k1, k2 = kps[seg], kps[seg + 1]
		if k1.envelope <= 0 and k2.envelope <= 0 then continue end
		local segW = k2.time - k1.time
		if segW <= 0 then continue end

		local strips = math.max(2, math.ceil(C.ENV_STRIPS_PER_SEG * segW))
		for si = 0, strips - 1 do
			local a1 = si / strips
			local a2 = (si + 1) / strips
			local st1 = U.cubicBez(a1, k1.time, k1.time+k1.handleOutX, k2.time+k2.handleInX, k2.time)
			local st2 = U.cubicBez(a2, k1.time, k1.time+k1.handleOutX, k2.time+k2.handleInX, k2.time)
			local val1 = U.cubicBez(a1, k1.value, k1.value+k1.handleOutY, k2.value+k2.handleInY, k2.value)
			local val2 = U.cubicBez(a2, k1.value, k1.value+k1.handleOutY, k2.value+k2.handleInY, k2.value)
			local env1 = U.lerp(k1.envelope, k2.envelope, a1)
			local env2 = U.lerp(k1.envelope, k2.envelope, a2)

			local _, topNy1 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st1, val1 + env1, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local _, botNy1 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st1, val1 - env1, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local _, topNy2 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st2, val2 + env2, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local _, botNy2 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st2, val2 - env2, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)

			local nx1 = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st1, 0, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)
			local nx2b = U.dataToNorm(self._view, st2, 0, s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax)

			local topNy = math.min(topNy1, topNy2)
			local botNy = math.max(botNy1, botNy2)
			topNy = U.clamp(topNy, 0, 1); botNy = U.clamp(botNy, 0, 1)
			local h = botNy - topNy
			if h < 0.0005 then continue end

			local strip = U.poolAcquire(self._stripPool, ll)
			U.setupStrip(strip, nx1, topNy, nx2b - nx1 + 0.002, h + 0.002, T.DarkGold, 0.88, 1)
		end
	end
end

end
