--[[
	Rendering mixin: theme refresh, keypoint state, undo / redo, the handle and Smooth toggles, presets,
	and loading a sequence (with bezier detection). Layout belongs to the view (ViewClassic,
	ViewCompact); drawing is RenderDraw, simplification RenderSimplify.
]]


local U = require(script.Parent.Util)

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)

local Smooth = require(script.Parent.Smooth)

return function(GraphEditor)
function GraphEditor:RefreshTheme()
	local T = self._T
	for _, p in ipairs(self._themeRefs.panels) do
		if p.Parent then p.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha end
	end
	for _, b in ipairs(self._themeRefs.blobs) do
		if b.Parent then b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; if not b:GetAttribute("_opaqueBlob") then b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha end end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(self._themeRefs.strokes) do
		if s.Parent then s.Color = T.Border; s.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha end
	end
	for _, sb in ipairs(self._themeRefs.scrollbars) do
		if sb.Parent then sb.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar end
	end
	-- Controls coloured per property, {instance, property, themeColorKey} (BuildUI.trackColor).
	for _, e in ipairs(self._themeRefs.colored or {}) do
		local inst, prop, key = e[1], e[2], e[3]
		if inst and inst.Parent and T[key] then inst[prop] = T[key] end
	end
	-- The edit panel stays opaque: colour only.
	if self._editPanel then self._editPanel.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg end
	if self._editCaret then self._editCaret.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg end
	-- Plot background and preset thumbs: a darker shade of PanelBg unless the theme names one.
	local graphBg = T.GraphBg or (self._plotSunken and T.Sunken) or Color3.fromRGB(T.PanelBg.R * 255 * 0.4, T.PanelBg.G * 255 * 0.4, T.PanelBg.B * 255 * 0.4)
	if self._plotSurface then self._plotSurface.BackgroundColor3 = graphBg end
	if self._presetThumbs then
		for _, thumb in ipairs(self._presetThumbs) do
			if thumb.Parent then thumb.BackgroundColor3 = graphBg end
		end
	end
	self:_updateUndoRedoBtns()
	self:_updatePasteBtn()
	if self._panel.Visible then task.defer(function() self:_redraw() end) end
end
function GraphEditor:_layoutEditPanel()
	local showEnv = self._state.envelopeEnabled
	self._eRow.Visible = showEnv
	local CARET_H = 8
	local inputRows = showEnv and 3 or 2
	local delY = CARET_H + inputRows * C.EDITPANEL_ROW_H + inputRows * C.EDITPANEL_GAP
	self._editDelBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, C.EDITPANEL_PAD, 0, delY)
	local h = delY + C.EDITPANEL_ROW_H + C.EDITPANEL_PAD
	self._editPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, C.EDITPANEL_W, 0, h)
	self._editPanelFullH = h
	local pri = self:_getPrimary()
	local kps = self._state.keypoints
	local canDelete = pri and pri > 1 and pri < #kps
	self._editDelBtn.TextColor3 = canDelete and self._T.MutedGold or self._T.DarkGold
	self._editDelBtn.AutoButtonColor = canDelete or false
end
-- In linear mode only the new keypoint gets handles (_initLinearHandlesAt): handles authored in
-- bezier mode on the others are kept while handles are off.
function GraphEditor:_addKp(time, value)
	local s = self._state
	if #s.keypoints >= C.MAX_KEYPOINTS then
		self:_showActionPopup("Roblox limit: " .. C.MAX_KEYPOINTS .. " keypoints")
		return
	end
	self:_pushUndo()
	local kp = { time = time, value = value, envelope = 0,
		handleInX = -0.05, handleInY = 0, handleOutX = 0.05, handleOutY = 0 }
	local idx = #s.keypoints + 1
	for i, e in ipairs(s.keypoints) do if time < e.time then idx = i; break end end
	table.insert(s.keypoints, idx, kp)
	if s.handlesEnabled then self:_initH(idx) else self:_initLinearHandlesAt(idx) end
	local insertedIdx
	for i, k in ipairs(s.keypoints) do
		if k == kp then insertedIdx = i; break end
	end
	if insertedIdx then self:_selectSingle(insertedIdx) end
	if self._editPanelOpen then self:_updateEditPanelValues(); self:_positionEditPanel() end
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
	self:_showActionPopup("Added keypoint")
end
function GraphEditor:_delSelected()
	local s = self._state
	if #s.keypoints <= 2 then return end
	self:_pushUndo()
	local toDelete = {}
	for idx in pairs(s.selection.indices) do
		if idx > 1 and idx < #s.keypoints then table.insert(toDelete, idx) end
	end
	if #toDelete == 0 then return end
	local count = #toDelete
	table.sort(toDelete, function(a, b) return a > b end)
	for _, idx in ipairs(toDelete) do table.remove(s.keypoints, idx) end
	self:_clearSelection()
	self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
	self:_showActionPopup("Deleted " .. count .. " keypoint(s)")
end
-- Handles a third of each neighbouring segment long, along the line through the neighbours; at
-- least MIN_HANDLE_FRAC so they can be grabbed, but never past the neighbour's time.
function GraphEditor:_initH(idx)
	local s = self._state; local kp = s.keypoints[idx]; if not kp then return end
	local prev, nxt = s.keypoints[idx-1], s.keypoints[idx+1]
	local prevGap = prev and (kp.time - prev.time) or 0
	local nxtGap = nxt and (nxt.time - kp.time) or 0
	local dtI = math.min(math.max(prevGap / 3, C.MIN_HANDLE_FRAC), prevGap)
	local dtO = math.min(math.max(nxtGap / 3, C.MIN_HANDLE_FRAC), nxtGap)
	local tan = 0
	if prev and nxt then
		local d = nxt.time - prev.time
		if d > 0 then tan = (nxt.value - prev.value) / d end
	end
	kp.handleInX = -dtI; kp.handleInY = -tan * dtI
	kp.handleOutX = dtO; kp.handleOutY = tan * dtO
end
-- Seeds handles along each segment's own slope so the bezier matches the linear curve; same length
-- floor as _initH, the slope kept by scaling Y.
function GraphEditor:_initLinearHandles()
	local kps = self._state.keypoints
	for i = 1, #kps do self:_initLinearHandlesAt(i) end
end
-- _initLinearHandles for one keypoint (_addKp), leaving the others' handles as they are.
function GraphEditor:_initLinearHandlesAt(idx)
	local kps = self._state.keypoints
	local kp = kps[idx]; if not kp then return end
	local prev, nxt = kps[idx - 1], kps[idx + 1]
	if prev then
		local gap = kp.time - prev.time
		local slope = (gap > 0) and ((kp.value - prev.value) / gap) or 0
		local dtI = math.min(math.max(gap / 3, C.MIN_HANDLE_FRAC), gap)
		kp.handleInX = -dtI; kp.handleInY = -slope * dtI
	else kp.handleInX = 0; kp.handleInY = 0 end
	if nxt then
		local gap = nxt.time - kp.time
		local slope = (gap > 0) and ((nxt.value - kp.value) / gap) or 0
		local dtO = math.min(math.max(gap / 3, C.MIN_HANDLE_FRAC), gap)
		kp.handleOutX = dtO; kp.handleOutY = slope * dtO
	else kp.handleOutX = 0; kp.handleOutY = 0 end
end
function GraphEditor:_snapshotKps()
	local snap = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(self._state.keypoints) do
		table.insert(snap, {
			time = kp.time, value = kp.value, envelope = kp.envelope,
			handleInX = kp.handleInX, handleInY = kp.handleInY,
			handleOutX = kp.handleOutX, handleOutY = kp.handleOutY,
		})
	end
	return snap
end
-- A snapshot holds the keypoints, the selection and the handle and envelope toggles; segments and
-- range are recomputed on restore. handlesEnabled is in it because _applyPreset changes it in the
-- same undo step.
function GraphEditor:_pushUndo()
	local snapKps = self:_snapshotKps()
	local primary = self._state.selection.primary
	local handlesEnabled = self._state.handlesEnabled
	local envelopeEnabled = self._state.envelopeEnabled
	local smooth = self._state.smooth
	-- A snapshot equal to the last is dropped: _onDown pushes on mouse down, before anything changed.
	local last = self._undoStack[#self._undoStack]
	if last and last.selection.primary == primary
		and last.handlesEnabled == handlesEnabled and last.envelopeEnabled == envelopeEnabled
		and last.smooth == smooth and #last.keypoints == #snapKps then
		local same = true
		for i = 1, #snapKps do
			local a, b = last.keypoints[i], snapKps[i]
			if a.time ~= b.time or a.value ~= b.value or a.envelope ~= b.envelope
				or a.handleInX ~= b.handleInX or a.handleInY ~= b.handleInY
				or a.handleOutX ~= b.handleOutX or a.handleOutY ~= b.handleOutY then
				same = false; break
			end
		end
		-- Selection-only changes are kept, so Ctrl+Z restores the selection too.
		if same then
			local lastIndices = last.selection.indices or {}
			local nowIndices = self._state.selection.indices or {}
			local lastCount, nowCount = 0, 0
			for _ in pairs(lastIndices) do lastCount = lastCount + 1 end
			for _ in pairs(nowIndices) do nowCount = nowCount + 1 end
			if lastCount ~= nowCount then same = false
			else for k in pairs(lastIndices) do if not nowIndices[k] then same = false; break end end end
		end
		if same then return end
	end
	-- Copied: the selection set is changed in place.
	local indicesCopy = {}
	if self._state and self._state.selection and self._state.selection.indices then
		for k, v in pairs(self._state.selection.indices) do indicesCopy[k] = v end
	end
	table.insert(self._undoStack, {
		keypoints = snapKps, selection = { primary = primary, indices = indicesCopy },
		handlesEnabled = handlesEnabled, envelopeEnabled = envelopeEnabled, smooth = smooth,
	})
	self._redoStack = {}
	if #self._undoStack > C.UNDO_LIMIT then table.remove(self._undoStack, 1) end
	self:_updateUndoRedoBtns()
end
-- Selection (primary and the multi-select set) for undo and redo.
local function _snapSelection(state)
	local indicesCopy = {}
	if state and state.selection and state.selection.indices then
		for k, v in pairs(state.selection.indices) do indicesCopy[k] = v end
	end
	return { primary = state.selection.primary, indices = indicesCopy }
end
local function _restoreSelection(self, snapshot)
	if not snapshot.selection then self:_clearSelection(); return end
	self._state.selection.primary = snapshot.selection.primary
	self._state.selection.indices = {}
	if snapshot.selection.indices then
		for k, v in pairs(snapshot.selection.indices) do self._state.selection.indices[k] = v end
	end
end

-- The entry undo and redo push for the state as it stands now.
local function _entryNow(self)
	return {
		keypoints = self:_snapshotKps(),
		selection = _snapSelection(self._state),
		handlesEnabled = self._state.handlesEnabled,
		envelopeEnabled = self._state.envelopeEnabled,
		smooth = self._state.smooth,
	}
end

-- Takes an entry off one stack, after keeping the state as it stands on the other.
local function _stepHistory(self, from, to)
	if #from == 0 then return end
	table.insert(to, _entryNow(self))
	local snapshot = table.remove(from)
	self._state.keypoints = snapshot.keypoints
	if snapshot.handlesEnabled ~= nil then self._state.handlesEnabled = snapshot.handlesEnabled end
	if snapshot.envelopeEnabled ~= nil then self._state.envelopeEnabled = snapshot.envelopeEnabled end
	self._state.smooth = snapshot.smooth or 0
	self:_showSmooth(self._state.smooth)
	_restoreSelection(self, snapshot)
	self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_adaptRange(); self:_syncUIToState(); self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
	self:_updateUndoRedoBtns()
end

function GraphEditor:_undo()
	_stepHistory(self, self._undoStack, self._redoStack)
end
function GraphEditor:_redo()
	_stepHistory(self, self._redoStack, self._undoStack)
end
-- Header buttons with nothing to act on are drawn in the theme's muted text, faded, so they follow
-- the theme like every other button. Also run by RefreshTheme.
local DISABLED_TEXT_TRANSPARENCY = 0.55
function GraphEditor:_paintHeaderButton(button, enabled, enabledColor)
	button.TextColor3 = enabled and enabledColor or self._T.MutedGold
	button.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or DISABLED_TEXT_TRANSPARENCY
end
function GraphEditor:_updateUndoRedoBtns()
	self:_paintHeaderButton(self._undoBtn, #self._undoStack > 0, self._T.Gold)
	self:_paintHeaderButton(self._redoBtn, #self._redoStack > 0, self._T.Gold)
end
-- Keeps a keypoint's handle X within its neighbours' times (0 and 1 at the ends) so the bezier stays
-- a function of time, and re-clamps the neighbours' facing handles.
function GraphEditor:_reclampHandles(idx)
	local kps = self._state.keypoints; local n = #kps
	if not kps[idx] then return end
	local kp = kps[idx]
	local prev = kps[idx - 1]; local nxt = kps[idx + 1]
	local minInX = prev and (prev.time - kp.time) or -kp.time
	local maxOutX = nxt and (nxt.time - kp.time) or (1 - kp.time)
	if kp.handleInX then kp.handleInX = U.round(math.clamp(kp.handleInX, minInX, 0), 4) end
	if kp.handleOutX then kp.handleOutX = U.round(math.clamp(kp.handleOutX, 0, maxOutX), 4) end
	if prev and prev.handleOutX then
		prev.handleOutX = U.round(math.clamp(prev.handleOutX, 0, kp.time - prev.time), 4)
	end
	if nxt and nxt.handleInX then
		nxt.handleInX = U.round(math.clamp(nxt.handleInX, kp.time - nxt.time, 0), 4)
	end
end

-- _reclampHandles on every keypoint: on load, and after edits that move many.
function GraphEditor:_reclampAllHandles()
	for i = 1, #self._state.keypoints do self:_reclampHandles(i) end
end

function GraphEditor:_toggleHandles()
	local s = self._state
	self:_pushUndo()
	s.handlesEnabled = not s.handlesEnabled
	if not s.handlesEnabled then
		s.smooth = 0
		self._smoothTurnedHandlesOn = false
		self:_showSmooth(0)
	end
	if s.handlesEnabled and not self._handlesEverEnabled then
		self:_initLinearHandles()
		self._handlesEverEnabled = true
	end
	-- Handles off keeps their data so turning them on restores the curve; drawing and baking skip them.
	self:_syncUIToState(); self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
end
-- The Smooth slider (ViewCompact/BottomRow). Above 0 the handles are laid from the keypoints at
-- every redraw and bake (_laySmooth), so the curve eases through each keypoint and keeps easing as
-- they move; dragging a handle by hand gives the handles back (InputWiring). At 0 they lie along the
-- straight segments again, and go off if Smooth turned them on. One undo step a drag.
function GraphEditor:_setSmooth(amount)
	local s = self._state
	if not self._smoothDragging then
		self:_pushUndo()
		self._smoothDragging = true
	end
	s.smooth = math.clamp(amount, 0, 1)
	if s.smooth > 0 and not s.handlesEnabled then
		s.handlesEnabled = true
		self._handlesEverEnabled = true
		self._smoothTurnedHandlesOn = true
	elseif s.smooth == 0 then
		Smooth.lay(s.keypoints, 0)
		if self._smoothTurnedHandlesOn then
			s.handlesEnabled = false
			self._smoothTurnedHandlesOn = false
		end
	end
	self:_syncUIToState(); self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
end

function GraphEditor:_endSmoothDrag()
	self._smoothDragging = false
end

-- While Smooth is above 0, the handles follow the keypoints.
function GraphEditor:_laySmooth()
	local s = self._state
	if s.smooth > 0 and s.handlesEnabled then
		Smooth.lay(s.keypoints, s.smooth)
	end
end

-- Hands the handles back to the user: their next drag is theirs to keep.
function GraphEditor:_releaseSmooth()
	if self._state.smooth > 0 then
		self._state.smooth = 0
		self._smoothTurnedHandlesOn = false
		self:_showSmooth(0)
	end
end

-- Shows the amount on the view's slider; a view without one (Classic) shows nothing.
function GraphEditor:_showSmooth(_amount)
end

function GraphEditor:_toggleEnvelope()
	self:_pushUndo()
	local s = self._state
	s.envelopeEnabled = not s.envelopeEnabled
	self:_syncUIToState()
	if self._editPanelOpen then self:_layoutEditPanel() end
	self:_redraw()
	self:_tryPreview()
end
function GraphEditor:_toggleSync()
	self._state.syncHandles = not self._state.syncHandles
	self._syncBtn.TextColor3 = self._state.syncHandles and self._T.Green or self._T.DarkGold
end
function GraphEditor:_toggleHelp()
	if self._helpVisible then self:_hideHelp()
	else self._helpVisible = true; self._helpOverlay.Visible = true; self._helpBtn.TextColor3 = self._T.Green end
end
function GraphEditor:_hideHelp()
	self._helpVisible = false; self._helpOverlay.Visible = false; self._helpBtn.TextColor3 = self._T.DarkGold
end
-- Presets are authored normalized (0..1); map them into the user's current range so applying
-- one never moves the view. value = rangeMin + v*span; handle Y offsets scale by span only.
function GraphEditor:_applyPreset(presetIndex)
	local preset = C.PRESETS[presetIndex]
	if not preset then return end
	self:_pushUndo()
	local s = self._state
	local rMin, rMax = s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax
	if rMax <= rMin then rMin, rMax = 0, 1 end
	local span = rMax - rMin
	s.keypoints = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(preset.kps) do
		table.insert(s.keypoints, {
			time = kp[1], value = rMin + kp[2] * span, envelope = 0,
			handleInX = kp.hInX or -0.05, handleInY = (kp.hInY or 0) * span,
			handleOutX = kp.hOutX or 0.05, handleOutY = (kp.hOutY or 0) * span,
		})
	end
	s.handlesEnabled = preset.handles; self._handlesEverEnabled = preset.handles
	s.smooth = 0
	self._smoothTurnedHandlesOn = false
	self:_showSmooth(0)
	if not preset.handles then self:_initLinearHandles() end
	self:_reclampAllHandles() -- a preset's handles may pass a neighbour
	self:_syncUIToState(); self:_clearSelection(); self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_layoutEditPanel()
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
	self:_showActionPopup("Applied: " .. preset.name)
end
function GraphEditor:_load(seq, bezierJSON)
	U.poolReleaseAll(self._linePool); U.poolReleaseAll(self._dotPool)
	U.poolReleaseAll(self._stripPool); U.poolReleaseAll(self._labelPool)
	self._undoStack = {}; self._redoStack = {}
	local s = self._state; s.keypoints = {}
	-- Stored handle data first: it round-trips exactly.
	local loadedBezier = false
	s.smooth = 0
	self._smoothTurnedHandlesOn = false
	self._smoothDragging = false
	if bezierJSON and bezierJSON ~= "" then
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(bezierJSON) end)
		if ok and typeof(data) == "table" and #data >= 2 then
			s.smooth = Smooth.amountOf(data)
			for _, kp in ipairs(data) do
				table.insert(s.keypoints, {
					time = kp.t, value = kp.v, envelope = kp.e or 0,
					handleInX = kp.hix or -0.05, handleInY = kp.hiy or 0,
					handleOutX = kp.hox or 0.05, handleOutY = kp.hoy or 0,
				})
			end
			loadedBezier = true
		end
	end
	-- Handles saved beside the graph are fitted to it: a writer that scaled or shifted the graph
	-- alone (any tool, any version) gets them moved onto it; ones that draw another curve would
	-- open a curve the item does not play, and Apply would write it over the graph: the graph wins.
	if loadedBezier and seq then
		local seqKps = {}
		for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
			table.insert(seqKps, { time = kp.Time, value = kp.Value })
		end
		local fitted = U.fitHandles(seqKps, s.keypoints)
		if fitted then
			s.keypoints = fitted
		else
			s.keypoints = {}
			s.smooth = 0
			loadedBezier = false
		end
	end
	if not loadedBezier then
		if not seq then
			s.keypoints = {
				{time=0, value=0, envelope=0, handleInX=-0.05, handleInY=0, handleOutX=0.05, handleOutY=0},
				{time=1, value=0, envelope=0, handleInX=-0.05, handleInY=0, handleOutX=0.05, handleOutY=0},
			}
		else
			for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
				table.insert(s.keypoints, {
					time = kp.Time, value = kp.Value, envelope = kp.Envelope,
					handleInX = -0.05, handleInY = 0, handleOutX = 0.05, handleOutY = 0,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	local detectedBezier = loadedBezier
	if not detectedBezier and self:_isBezierBaked(s.keypoints) then
		local bezKps = self:_reconstructBezier(s.keypoints)
		if bezKps then s.keypoints = bezKps; detectedBezier = true end
	end
	-- Open auto-detect: include [0,1] for normalized properties (Transparency, etc.).
	s.rangeMin, s.rangeMax = U.autoRange(s.keypoints, detectedBezier, true)
	self._rMinIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMin)
	self._rMaxIn.Text = string.format("%.3g", s.rangeMax)
	if detectedBezier then
		s.handlesEnabled = true; self._handlesEverEnabled = true
	else
		for i = 1, #s.keypoints do self:_initH(i) end
		s.handlesEnabled = false; self._handlesEverEnabled = false
	end
	local hasEnv = false
	for _, kp in ipairs(s.keypoints) do
		if kp.envelope > 0.001 then hasEnv = true; break end
	end
	s.envelopeEnabled = hasEnv
	-- Stored handles may pass their neighbours: re-clamped on open.
	self:_reclampAllHandles()
	self:_showSmooth(s.smooth)
	self:_syncUIToState(); self:_clearSelection(); self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_layoutEditPanel(); self:_updateUndoRedoBtns()
	-- A no-op (Util.viewFitAll).
	U.viewFitAll(self._view)
end
-- A baked bezier opens as 8 or more evenly spaced keypoints with no envelope; such a graph is
-- refitted to bezier handles, and _verifyBezierFit rejects a fit outside its tolerance (it then
-- loads as linear).
function GraphEditor:_isBezierBaked(kps)
	local n = #kps
	if n < 8 then return false end
	local step = 1 / (n - 1)
	for i, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		if math.abs(kp.time - (i - 1) * step) > 0.005 then return false end
		if kp.envelope > 0.001 then return false end
	end
	return true
end
function GraphEditor:_reconstructBezier(kps)
	local n = #kps; if n < 3 then return nil end
	local slopes = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		if i == 1 then slopes[i] = (kps[2].value - kps[1].value) / math.max(0.001, kps[2].time - kps[1].time)
		elseif i == n then slopes[i] = (kps[n].value - kps[n-1].value) / math.max(0.001, kps[n].time - kps[n-1].time)
		else slopes[i] = (kps[i+1].value - kps[i-1].value) / math.max(0.001, kps[i+1].time - kps[i-1].time) end
	end
	local anchorSet = { [1] = true, [n] = true }
	for i = 2, n - 1 do
		if (slopes[i-1] > C.SLOPE_THRESHOLD and slopes[i+1] < -C.SLOPE_THRESHOLD) or
		   (slopes[i-1] < -C.SLOPE_THRESHOLD and slopes[i+1] > C.SLOPE_THRESHOLD) then anchorSet[i] = true end
	end
	for i = 3, n - 2 do
		if (slopes[i] - slopes[i-1]) * (slopes[i+1] - slopes[i]) < 0 then anchorSet[i] = true end
	end
	local anchors = {}
	for idx in pairs(anchorSet) do table.insert(anchors, idx) end
	table.sort(anchors)
	local filtered = { anchors[1] }
	for i = 2, #anchors do
		if anchors[i] - filtered[#filtered] >= 3 or anchors[i] == n then table.insert(filtered, anchors[i]) end
	end
	if filtered[#filtered] ~= n then table.insert(filtered, n) end
	anchors = filtered
	if #anchors < 2 then return nil end
	local result = {}
	for j, idx in ipairs(anchors) do
		local kp = kps[idx]; local slope = slopes[idx]
		local prevTime = kps[anchors[j-1] or idx].time
		local nextTime = kps[anchors[j+1] or idx].time
		local dtIn = (kp.time - prevTime) / 3; local dtOut = (nextTime - kp.time) / 3
		table.insert(result, {
			time = kp.time, value = kp.value, envelope = 0,
			handleInX = -dtIn, handleInY = -slope * dtIn,
			handleOutX = dtOut, handleOutY = slope * dtOut,
		})
	end
	if not self:_verifyBezierFit(kps, result) then return nil end
	return result
end
function GraphEditor:_verifyBezierFit(originalKps, bezKps)
	local vMin, vMax = math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, kp in ipairs(originalKps) do vMin = math.min(vMin, kp.value); vMax = math.max(vMax, kp.value) end
	local valRange = vMax - vMin
	local tolerance = math.max(0.02, valRange * 0.03)
	for _, orig in ipairs(originalKps) do
		if math.abs(orig.value - U.bezierAtTime(bezKps, orig.time)) > tolerance then return false end
	end
	return true
end
end

--[[
	RenderSimplify mixin: the Simplify popover: RDP reduction, error measurement, Minimize and the live
	preview.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)

return function(GraphEditor)


-- Opening clears the preview anchor; closing without Minimize cancels, restoring the curve from
-- before the slider moved.
function GraphEditor:_toggleSimplifyPanel()
	local vis = not self._simpPanel.Visible
	self._simpPanel.Visible = vis
	if vis then
		self._simpOrigKps = nil
		self._simpOrigSamples = nil
		self._simpSliderValue = 0
		self._simpSliderThumb.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		self._simpDevLabel.Text = ""
	else
		if self._simpOrigKps then
			self._state.keypoints = self:_deepCopyKps(self._simpOrigKps)
			self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
		end
		self._simpOrigKps = nil
		self._simpOrigSamples = nil
	end
end

function GraphEditor:_onSimpSliderInput(inputPos)
	if not self._simpSliderTrack then return end
	local trackPos = self._simpSliderTrack.AbsolutePosition
	local trackSize = self._simpSliderTrack.AbsoluteSize
	if trackSize.X < 1 then return end
	local fraction = U.clamp((inputPos.X - trackPos.X) / trackSize.X, 0, 1)
	self._simpSliderValue = fraction
	self._simpSliderThumb.Position = UDim2.new(fraction, 0, 0.5, 0)
	self:_previewReduce(fraction)
end

function GraphEditor:_sampleCurve(n, kps)
	local s = self._state
	kps = kps or s.keypoints
	local samples = {}
	if s.handlesEnabled then
		samples = U.sampleBezier(kps, n)
	else
		for si = 0, n do
			local t = si / n
			local val = kps[#kps].value
			for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
				if t >= kps[i].time and (t <= kps[i+1].time or i == #kps - 1) then
					local k1, k2 = kps[i], kps[i+1]
					local sr = k2.time - k1.time
					local lt = sr > 0 and ((t - k1.time) / sr) or 0
					val = U.lerp(k1.value, k2.value, U.clamp(lt, 0, 1))
					break
				end
			end
			table.insert(samples, { time = t, value = val })
		end
	end
	return samples
end

function GraphEditor:_measureError(samples, simplified)
	local maxErr = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(samples) do
		local val = simplified[#simplified].value
		for i = 1, #simplified - 1 do
			if s.time >= simplified[i].time and (s.time <= simplified[i+1].time or i == #simplified - 1) then
				local sr = simplified[i+1].time - simplified[i].time
				local lt = sr > 0 and ((s.time - simplified[i].time) / sr) or 0
				val = U.lerp(simplified[i].value, simplified[i+1].value, U.clamp(lt, 0, 1))
				break
			end
		end
		maxErr = math.max(maxErr, math.abs(s.value - val))
	end
	return maxErr
end

function GraphEditor:_rdpSimplify(kps, epsilon)
	if #kps <= 2 then
		local result = {}
		for i = 1, #kps do table.insert(result, i) end
		return result
	end
	-- epsilon is in value units; time is scaled by the value range so both axes share them, or the
	-- slider's effect would depend on the range.
	local valRange = math.max(1e-9, (self._state.rangeMax or 1) - (self._state.rangeMin or 0))

	-- Distance from p to the segment ls..le (point distance when it has no length), time scaled as above.
	local function perpDist(p, ls, le)
		local pt, lst, let = p.time * valRange, ls.time * valRange, le.time * valRange
		local dx = let - lst
		local dy = le.value - ls.value
		local len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
		if len2 < 1e-20 then
			local ddx = pt - lst
			local ddy = p.value - ls.value
			return math.sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy)
		end
		return math.abs(dy * pt - dx * p.value + let * ls.value - le.value * lst) / math.sqrt(len2)
	end

	local keep = {}
	keep[1] = true
	keep[#kps] = true

	local function rdp(startIdx, endIdx)
		local maxDist, maxIdx = 0, 0
		for i = startIdx + 1, endIdx - 1 do
			local d = perpDist(kps[i], kps[startIdx], kps[endIdx])
			if d > maxDist then maxDist = d; maxIdx = i end
		end
		if maxDist > epsilon then
			keep[maxIdx] = true
			rdp(startIdx, maxIdx)
			rdp(maxIdx, endIdx)
		end
	end

	rdp(1, #kps)

	local result = {}
	for i = 1, #kps do
		if keep[i] then table.insert(result, i) end
	end
	return result
end

function GraphEditor:_deepCopyKps(kps)
	local copy = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		table.insert(copy, {
			time = kp.time, value = kp.value, envelope = kp.envelope,
			handleInX = kp.handleInX, handleInY = kp.handleInY,
			handleOutX = kp.handleOutX, handleOutY = kp.handleOutY,
		})
	end
	return copy
end

function GraphEditor:_buildSimplified(keepIndices, srcKps)
	local simplified = {}
	for _, idx in ipairs(keepIndices) do
		local kp = srcKps[idx]
		table.insert(simplified, {
			time = kp.time, value = kp.value, envelope = kp.envelope,
			handleInX = kp.handleInX or -0.05, handleInY = kp.handleInY or 0,
			handleOutX = kp.handleOutX or 0.05, handleOutY = kp.handleOutY or 0,
		})
	end
	return simplified
end

-- Bisects the RDP epsilon for the largest one whose result stays within tolerance (5% of the range,
-- at least 0.01) over 200 samples. In bezier mode the error is measured on straight lines, so it is
-- approximate.
function GraphEditor:_minimize()
	local s = self._state
	local kps = s.keypoints
	if #kps <= 2 then
		self:_showActionPopup("Already minimal")
		return
	end

	self:_pushUndo()
	local origCount = #kps

	local samples = self:_sampleCurve(200, kps)
	local valRange = s.rangeMax - s.rangeMin
	local tolerance = math.max(0.01, valRange * 0.05)

	local lo, hi = 0, valRange
	local bestKps = kps

	for _ = 1, 30 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) / 2
		local keepIndices = self:_rdpSimplify(kps, mid)
		local simplified = self:_buildSimplified(keepIndices, kps)
		local maxError = self:_measureError(samples, simplified)
		if maxError <= tolerance then
			bestKps = simplified
			lo = mid
		else
			hi = mid
		end
	end

	if #bestKps >= origCount then
		self:_showActionPopup("Already minimal")
	else
		s.keypoints = bestKps
		if not s.handlesEnabled then
			self:_initLinearHandles()
		end
		self:_showActionPopup("Reduced to " .. #bestKps .. " keypoints")
	end

	self:_clearSelection()
	self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_layoutEditPanel()
	self:_adaptRange()
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()

	self._simpPanel.Visible = false
	self._simpOrigKps = nil
	self._simpOrigSamples = nil
end

function GraphEditor:_previewReduce(fraction)
	if fraction <= 0.001 then
		if self._simpOrigKps then
			self._state.keypoints = self:_deepCopyKps(self._simpOrigKps)
			self:_redraw()
			self._simpDevLabel.Text = ""
		end
		return
	end

	if not self._simpOrigKps then
		self:_pushUndo()
		self._simpOrigKps = self:_deepCopyKps(self._state.keypoints)
		self._simpOrigSamples = self:_sampleCurve(200, self._simpOrigKps)
	end

	-- Cubic response (fraction^3): the fine end of the epsilon range takes most of the slider, and the
	-- collapse to 2 keypoints comes only near its end. Max epsilon is 15% of the range.
	local valRange = self._state.rangeMax - self._state.rangeMin
	local epsilon = (fraction ^ 3) * valRange * 0.15

	local keepIndices = self:_rdpSimplify(self._simpOrigKps, epsilon)
	local simplified = self:_buildSimplified(keepIndices, self._simpOrigKps)

	self._state.keypoints = simplified
	if not self._state.handlesEnabled then
		self:_initLinearHandles()
	end

	local maxErr = self:_measureError(self._simpOrigSamples, simplified)
	self._simpDevLabel.Text = string.format("Keypoints: %d  Max deviation: %.3f", #simplified, maxErr)
	self:_redraw()
end

end

--[[
	Smooth: the Smooth slider's handles. Eases a keypoint graph through every keypoint without rising
	above or dipping below them.
	  Smooth.lay(keypoints, amount)  writes handleInX/Y and handleOutX/Y (offsets from the keypoint)
	    amount 0 lays each arm along its own segment (straight lines); 1 lays both arms of a keypoint
	    on one tangent, so the slope eases through it; between, the slopes blend. Each arm is a third
	    of its segment, so a segment is the cubic Hermite curve with those end slopes. The tangents are
	    monotone, so neither they nor any blend with the straight slopes leave the range of a segment's
	    two keypoints: a flat segment stays flat, a peak stays the top, a jump stays a jump.
	  Smooth.amountOf(data) -> number  the amount stored with a graph's handle data (`sm` of its first
	    entry), or 0
	Pure: keypoints are plain tables.
]]

local Smooth = {}

-- Segments shorter than this are jumps: they get no arms and carry no slope.
local JUMP = 1e-6

local function sign(value)
	if value > 0 then
		return 1
	elseif value < 0 then
		return -1
	end
	return 0
end

-- The slope of every segment, or nil for a jump; and every segment's length.
local function secants(keypoints)
	local slopes, lengths = {}, {}
	for index = 1, #keypoints - 1 do
		local length = keypoints[index + 1].time - keypoints[index].time
		lengths[index] = length
		if length > JUMP then
			slopes[index] = (keypoints[index + 1].value - keypoints[index].value) / length
		end
	end
	return slopes, lengths
end

-- Monotone tangent at an interior keypoint: zero where the graph turns or is flat, else a weighted
-- harmonic mean of the two slopes, which never exceeds three times either.
local function interiorTangent(slopeBefore, slopeAfter, lengthBefore, lengthAfter)
	if not slopeBefore or not slopeAfter then
		return 0
	end
	if sign(slopeBefore) * sign(slopeAfter) <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local weightBefore = 2 * lengthAfter + lengthBefore
	local weightAfter = lengthAfter + 2 * lengthBefore
	return (weightBefore + weightAfter) / (weightBefore / slopeBefore + weightAfter / slopeAfter)
end

-- Tangent at an end, from its segment and the next: kept to the end segment's sign and to three
-- times its slope, so the end segment does not overshoot either.
local function endTangent(slopeNear, slopeNext, lengthNear, lengthNext)
	if not slopeNear then
		return 0
	end
	if not slopeNext then
		return slopeNear
	end
	local tangent = ((2 * lengthNear + lengthNext) * slopeNear - lengthNear * slopeNext) / (lengthNear + lengthNext)
	if sign(tangent) ~= sign(slopeNear) then
		return 0
	end
	if sign(slopeNear) ~= sign(slopeNext) and math.abs(tangent) > 3 * math.abs(slopeNear) then
		return 3 * slopeNear
	end
	return tangent
end

local function tangents(keypoints, slopes, lengths)
	local count = #keypoints
	local result = {}
	if count == 2 then
		result[1] = slopes[1] or 0
		result[2] = slopes[1] or 0
		return result
	end
	result[1] = endTangent(slopes[1], slopes[2], lengths[1], lengths[2])
	result[count] = endTangent(slopes[count - 1], slopes[count - 2], lengths[count - 1], lengths[count - 2])
	for index = 2, count - 1 do
		result[index] = interiorTangent(slopes[index - 1], slopes[index], lengths[index - 1], lengths[index])
	end
	return result
end

function Smooth.lay(keypoints, amount)
	local count = #keypoints
	if count < 2 then
		return
	end
	amount = math.clamp(amount, 0, 1)
	local slopes, lengths = secants(keypoints)
	local eased = tangents(keypoints, slopes, lengths)
	for index, keypoint in ipairs(keypoints) do
		local lengthIn = lengths[index - 1]
		local slopeIn = slopes[index - 1]
		if lengthIn and slopeIn then
			local arm = lengthIn / 3
			keypoint.handleInX = -arm
			keypoint.handleInY = -(slopeIn + (eased[index] - slopeIn) * amount) * arm
		else
			keypoint.handleInX = 0
			keypoint.handleInY = 0
		end
		local lengthOut = lengths[index]
		local slopeOut = slopes[index]
		if lengthOut and slopeOut then
			local arm = lengthOut / 3
			keypoint.handleOutX = arm
			keypoint.handleOutY = (slopeOut + (eased[index] - slopeOut) * amount) * arm
		else
			keypoint.handleOutX = 0
			keypoint.handleOutY = 0
		end
	end
end

function Smooth.amountOf(data)
	local first = typeof(data) == "table" and data[1]
	local amount = typeof(first) == "table" and tonumber(first.sm) or nil
	if amount == nil then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp(amount, 0, 1)
end

return Smooth

--[[
	GraphEditor Util: stateless helpers: maths and snapping, bezier sampling and handle fitting, range
	fitting, line clipping, instance pools, the viewport transform, drawing primitives and UI
	constructors.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)

local U = {}

-- Maths.

function U.clamp(x, lo, hi) return math.max(lo, math.min(hi, x)) end
function U.round(x, d) local m = 10 ^ (d or 3); return math.floor(x * m + 0.5) / m end
function U.lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
function U.invY(y) return 1 - y end

-- Ctrl snaps: time to 0.1 steps; value to a round step (1, 2 or 5 x 10^n) near a tenth of the
-- visible range, counted from 0 so 0 and round values stay reachable.
function U.snapTime(t, step) step = step or 0.1; return math.floor(t / step + 0.5) * step end
function U.snapValue(v, rangeMin, rangeMax, divisions)
	divisions = divisions or 10
	local rough = (rangeMax - rangeMin) / divisions
	if rough <= 0 then return v end
	-- The round step closest to `rough` on a log scale.
	local magnitude = 10 ^ math.floor(math.log10(rough))
	local step = magnitude
	for _, multiple in ipairs({ 2, 5, 10 }) do
		local candidate = magnitude * multiple
		if math.abs(math.log(candidate / rough)) < math.abs(math.log(step / rough)) then step = candidate end
	end
	return math.floor(v / step + 0.5) * step
end

function U.cubicBez(t, p0, p1, p2, p3)
	local u = 1 - t
	return u*u*u*p0 + 3*u*u*t*p1 + 3*u*t*t*p2 + t*t*t*p3
end

-- The handles' curve as about n {time, value} points: each segment's parameter is swept for the
-- true 2D points, as RenderDraw draws and _toSeq bakes it (uniform time would ignore the handles'
-- X easing). A running clamp guards small overhangs.
function U.sampleBezier(kps, n)
	local samples = {}
	local perSeg = math.max(3, math.ceil(n / math.max(1, #kps - 1)))
	local lastT = 0
	for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
		local k1, k2 = kps[i], kps[i+1]
		local uStart = (i == 1) and 0 or 1
		for ui = uStart, perSeg do
			local u = ui / perSeg
			local ct = U.cubicBez(u, k1.time, k1.time + (k1.handleOutX or 0), k2.time + (k2.handleInX or 0), k2.time)
			local cv = U.cubicBez(u, k1.value, k1.value + k1.handleOutY, k2.value + k2.handleInY, k2.value)
			ct = U.clamp(ct, lastT, 1)
			lastT = ct
			table.insert(samples, { time = ct, value = cv })
		end
	end
	return samples
end

-- The handles' curve at time t, with the parameter taken as the time fraction of its segment (X
-- easing ignored): how a by-time bake laid its keypoints, and the cheap fit test of
-- Rendering._verifyBezierFit.
function U.bezierAtTime(kps, t)
	for i = 1, #kps - 1 do
		local k1, k2 = kps[i], kps[i+1]
		if t >= k1.time and (t <= k2.time or i == #kps - 1) then
			local sr = k2.time - k1.time
			local lt = sr > 0 and ((t - k1.time) / sr) or 0
			return U.cubicBez(U.clamp(lt, 0, 1), k1.value, k1.value + k1.handleOutY, k2.value + k2.handleInY, k2.value)
		end
	end
	return kps[1].value
end

-- Value at time t of points { time, value } in ascending time joined by lines (a curve's samples,
-- a graph's keypoints).
local function polylineAt(samples, t)
	for i = 2, #samples do
		local a, b = samples[i - 1], samples[i]
		if t <= b.time then
			local span = b.time - a.time
			if span <= 0 then return b.value end
			return U.lerp(a.value, b.value, U.clamp((t - a.time) / span, 0, 1))
		end
	end
	return samples[#samples].value
end

-- Fits stored handles (bezKps) to the graph saved beside them (seqKps: {time, value}): as they are
-- when the graph lies on their curve, moved when it is their curve scaled and shifted (Resize,
-- Retime, the Shifter), or nil when it is another curve (a paste, a typed value, a clamp). A fit
-- holds when every keypoint lies within FIT_ON of the span from the moved curve, read as either
-- bake lays keypoints. A graph of two keypoints also needs the curve along its line (FIT_BACK).
local FIT_ON = 0.01
local FIT_BACK = 0.05

-- Least squares scale and shift taking `curve` (values at the keypoints) to the keypoints' values.
local function scaleAndShift(seqKps, curve)
	local n = #seqKps
	local meanC, meanV = 0, 0
	for i = 1, n do
		meanC += curve[i]
		meanV += seqKps[i].value
	end
	meanC /= n
	meanV /= n
	local covariance, variance = 0, 0
	for i = 1, n do
		covariance += (curve[i] - meanC) * (seqKps[i].value - meanV)
		variance += (curve[i] - meanC) ^ 2
	end
	if variance < 1e-12 then
		return 1, meanV - meanC
	end
	local scale = covariance / variance
	return scale, meanV - scale * meanC
end

-- The largest gap between the keypoints and `curve` (values at them) taken by scale and shift.
local function worstGap(seqKps, curve, scale, shift)
	local worst = 0
	for i, kp in ipairs(seqKps) do
		worst = math.max(worst, math.abs(curve[i] * scale + shift - kp.value))
	end
	return worst
end

-- Whether the curve's samples, taken by scale and shift, lie on the graph's lines; asked of a
-- graph of two keypoints only (see FIT_BACK).
local function liesAlong(seqKps, samples, scale, shift, tolerance)
	if #seqKps >= 3 then
		return true
	end
	for _, sample in ipairs(samples) do
		if math.abs(sample.value * scale + shift - polylineAt(seqKps, sample.time)) > tolerance then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function U.fitHandles(seqKps, bezKps)
	if #seqKps == 0 or #bezKps < 2 then return nil end
	local swept = U.sampleBezier(bezKps, 384)
	local byTime = {}
	for step = 0, 384 do
		local t = step / 384
		byTime[step + 1] = { time = t, value = U.bezierAtTime(bezKps, t) }
	end
	local vMin, vMax = math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, kp in ipairs(seqKps) do
		vMin = math.min(vMin, kp.value)
		vMax = math.max(vMax, kp.value)
	end
	local onTolerance = math.max(1e-3, (vMax - vMin) * FIT_ON)
	local backTolerance = math.max(1e-3, (vMax - vMin) * FIT_BACK)
	local readings = {}
	for index, samples in ipairs({ swept, byTime }) do
		local curve = {}
		for i, kp in ipairs(seqKps) do curve[i] = polylineAt(samples, kp.time) end
		readings[index] = { samples = samples, curve = curve }
		-- Drawn as they are, by either bake: kept untouched.
		if worstGap(seqKps, curve, 1, 0) <= onTolerance and liesAlong(seqKps, samples, 1, 0, backTolerance) then
			return bezKps
		end
	end
	local best, bestGap = nil, math.huge
	for _, reading in ipairs(readings) do
		local scale, shift = scaleAndShift(seqKps, reading.curve)
		local gap = worstGap(seqKps, reading.curve, scale, shift)
		if gap <= onTolerance and gap < bestGap and liesAlong(seqKps, reading.samples, scale, shift, backTolerance) then
			best, bestGap = { scale = scale, shift = shift }, gap
		end
	end
	if not best then return nil end
	local moved = {}
	for i, kp in ipairs(bezKps) do
		moved[i] = table.clone(kp)
		moved[i].value = kp.value * best.scale + best.shift
		moved[i].handleInY = (kp.handleInY or 0) * best.scale
		moved[i].handleOutY = (kp.handleOutY or 0) * best.scale
	end
	return moved
end

function U.niceStep(range)
	if range <= 0 then return 1 end
	local rough = range / 5
	local pow = math.floor(math.log10(rough))
	local mag = 10 ^ pow
	local norm = rough / mag
	if norm <= 1 then return mag
	elseif norm <= 2 then return 2 * mag
	elseif norm <= 5 then return 5 * mag
	else return 10 * mag end
end

-- Tight [lo, hi] over every value +/- envelope and, with considerHandles, every handle end.
-- forceUnit also includes 0..1 (opening a normalized property); Fit passes false for a tight crop.
function U.autoRange(kps, considerHandles, forceUnit)
	local lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		lo = math.min(lo, kp.value - math.abs(kp.envelope))
		hi = math.max(hi, kp.value + math.abs(kp.envelope))
		if considerHandles then
			if kp.handleInY then
				local y = kp.value + kp.handleInY
				if y < lo then lo = y end; if y > hi then hi = y end
			end
			if kp.handleOutY then
				local y = kp.value + kp.handleOutY
				if y < lo then lo = y end; if y > hi then hi = y end
			end
		end
	end
	local rawLo, rawHi = lo, hi
	-- 5% padding around data, with a 0.1 floor so flat-line graphs don't end up zero-tall.
	local pad = (hi - lo) * 0.05
	if pad < 0.1 then pad = 0.1 end
	lo = math.floor((lo - pad) * 100) / 100
	hi = math.ceil((hi + pad) * 100) / 100
	-- Padding does not push data already inside 0..1 out of it.
	if rawLo >= 0 then lo = math.max(lo, 0) end
	if rawHi <= 1 then hi = math.min(hi, 1) end
	if forceUnit then return math.min(lo, 0), math.max(hi, 1) end
	return lo, hi
end

function U.fmtVal(v)
	if v == 0 then return "0" end
	local abs = math.abs(v)
	if abs >= 100 then return string.format("%.0f", v)
	elseif abs >= 10 then return string.format("%.1f", v)
	elseif abs >= 1 then return string.format("%.2f", v)
	elseif abs >= 0.1 then return string.format("%.3f", v)
	else return string.format("%.4g", v) end
end

-- Line clipping (Cohen-Sutherland).

local CLIP_LEFT, CLIP_RIGHT, CLIP_BOTTOM, CLIP_TOP = 1, 2, 4, 8

local function clipOutcode(x, y, lo, hi)
	local code = 0
	if x < lo then code = code + CLIP_LEFT elseif x > hi then code = code + CLIP_RIGHT end
	if y < lo then code = code + CLIP_TOP elseif y > hi then code = code + CLIP_BOTTOM end
	return code
end

function U.clipLine(nx1, ny1, nx2, ny2)
	local LO = -C.LINE_CLAMP_MARGIN
	local HI = 1 + C.LINE_CLAMP_MARGIN
	local c1 = clipOutcode(nx1, ny1, LO, HI)
	local c2 = clipOutcode(nx2, ny2, LO, HI)
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		if bit32.band(c1, c2) ~= 0 then return nil end
		if c1 == 0 and c2 == 0 then return nx1, ny1, nx2, ny2 end
		local co = c1 ~= 0 and c1 or c2
		local dx, dy = nx2 - nx1, ny2 - ny1
		local x, y
		if bit32.band(co, CLIP_BOTTOM) ~= 0 then
			x = nx1 + dx * (HI - ny1) / dy; y = HI
		elseif bit32.band(co, CLIP_TOP) ~= 0 then
			x = nx1 + dx * (LO - ny1) / dy; y = LO
		elseif bit32.band(co, CLIP_RIGHT) ~= 0 then
			y = ny1 + dy * (HI - nx1) / dx; x = HI
		else
			y = ny1 + dy * (LO - nx1) / dx; x = LO
		end
		if co == c1 then
			nx1 = x; ny1 = y; c1 = clipOutcode(nx1, ny1, LO, HI)
		else
			nx2 = x; ny2 = y; c2 = clipOutcode(nx2, ny2, LO, HI)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Instance pools.

function U.createPool()
	return { available = {}, inUse = {} }
end

function U.poolAcquire(pool, parent)
	local inst
	local avail = pool.available
	if #avail > 0 then
		inst = avail[#avail]
		avail[#avail] = nil
		inst.Visible = true
		inst.Parent = parent
	else
		inst = Instance.new("Frame")
		inst.BorderSizePixel = 0
		inst.Parent = parent
	end
	table.insert(pool.inUse, inst)
	return inst
end

function U.poolAcquireLabel(pool, parent)
	local inst
	local avail = pool.available
	if #avail > 0 then
		inst = avail[#avail]
		avail[#avail] = nil
		inst.Visible = true
		inst.Parent = parent
	else
		inst = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		inst.BorderSizePixel = 0
		inst.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		-- Grid labels keep the size the renderer gives them: carrying a text role stops the UI's
		-- text adoption (UIBuilder/TypeScale.adopt) from enlarging them on every reuse.
		inst:SetAttribute("_typeRole", "Caption")
		inst.Parent = parent
	end
	table.insert(pool.inUse, inst)
	return inst
end

function U.poolReleaseAll(pool)
	local inUse = pool.inUse
	local avail = pool.available
	for i = #inUse, 1, -1 do
		local inst = inUse[i]
		inst.Visible = false
		inst.Parent = nil
		table.insert(avail, inst)
		inUse[i] = nil
	end
end

-- Viewport transform: X is 0..1, Y is rangeMin..rangeMax.

function U.viewDefaults()
	return {}
end

function U.dataToNorm(view, time, value, rangeMin, rangeMax)
	local dataRange = math.max(0.001, rangeMax - rangeMin)
	local nx = time
	local ny = 1 - (value - rangeMin) / dataRange
	return nx, ny
end

function U.normToData(view, nx, ny, rangeMin, rangeMax)
	local dataRange = math.max(0.001, rangeMax - rangeMin)
	local time = nx
	local value = rangeMin + (1 - ny) * dataRange
	return time, value
end

function U.viewFitAll(view)
	-- No-op: the range lives in rangeMin / rangeMax.
end

function U.viewClamp(view)
	-- No-op.
end

-- Drawing primitives (pooled).

function U.setupDot(f, nx, ny, sizePx, color, zIdx)
	f.Name = "D"
	f.BackgroundColor3 = color
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizePx, 0, sizePx)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, ny, 0)
	f.ZIndex = zIdx or 5
	f.Rotation = 0
	local corner = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if not corner then
		corner = Instance.new("UICorner", f)
	end
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.ceil(sizePx / 2))
	local stroke = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if stroke then stroke:Destroy() end
end

function U.setupBar(f, nx, ny, widthPx, heightPx, color, alpha, zIdx)
	f.Name = "Bar"
	f.BackgroundColor3 = color
	f.BackgroundTransparency = alpha or 0
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(0, widthPx, 0, heightPx)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, ny, 0)
	f.ZIndex = zIdx or 5
	f.Rotation = 0
	local corner = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner then corner:Destroy() end
	local stroke = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if stroke then stroke:Destroy() end
end

function U.setupRing(f, nx, ny, sizePx, color, strokeThick, alpha, zIdx)
	f.Name = "Ring"
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizePx, 0, sizePx)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, ny, 0)
	f.ZIndex = zIdx or 5
	f.Rotation = 0
	local corner = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if not corner then
		corner = Instance.new("UICorner", f)
	end
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.ceil(sizePx / 2))
	local stroke = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if not stroke then
		stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
		stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	end
	stroke.Color = color
	stroke.Transparency = alpha or 0
	stroke.Thickness = strokeThick or 1.5
end

-- A segment as a rotated thin Frame: the screen length is divided by uiScale for Position.Offset,
-- and +1 on Size leaves no gap where segments meet.
function U.setupLine(f, nx1, ny1, nx2, ny2, color, thick, alpha, absW, absH, uiScale)
	local midNx, midNy = (nx1 + nx2) / 2, (ny1 + ny2) / 2
	local dx = (nx2 - nx1) * absW
	local dy = (ny2 - ny1) * absH
	local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	if len < 0.1 then
		f.Visible = false
		return false
	end
	f.Name = "L"
	f.BackgroundColor3 = color
	f.BackgroundTransparency = alpha or 0
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.ceil(len / uiScale) + 1, 0, thick or 1)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(midNx, 0, midNy, 0)
	f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
	f.ZIndex = 2
	local corner = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner then corner:Destroy() end
	local stroke = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if stroke then stroke:Destroy() end
	return true
end

function U.setupStrip(f, posX, posY, sizeX, sizeY, color, alpha, zIdx)
	f.Name = "E"
	f.BackgroundColor3 = color
	f.BackgroundTransparency = alpha or 0.82
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(posX, 0, posY, 0)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(sizeX, 0, sizeY, 0)
	f.ZIndex = zIdx or 1
	f.Rotation = 0
	local corner = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner then corner:Destroy() end
	local stroke = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if stroke then stroke:Destroy() end
end

-- drawLine without a pool, for static UI (preset thumbnails).
function U.drawLineStatic(parent, nx1, ny1, nx2, ny2, color, thick, alpha, absW, absH, uiScale)
	local midNx, midNy = (nx1 + nx2) / 2, (ny1 + ny2) / 2
	local dx = (nx2 - nx1) * absW
	local dy = (ny2 - ny1) * absH
	local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	if len < 0.1 then return nil end
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = "L"; f.BackgroundColor3 = color; f.BackgroundTransparency = alpha or 0
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.ceil(len / (uiScale or 1)) + 1, 0, thick or 1)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(midNx, 0, midNy, 0)
	f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
	f.ZIndex = 2; f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

-- UI helpers.

function U.ac(p, r) Instance.new("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0, 5) end

function U.addStroke(p, T)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", p)
	s.Color = T.Border; s.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha; s.Thickness = 1
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	return s
end

function U.blob(n, par, sz, T)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame"); f.Name = n
	f.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; f.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.Size = sz or UDim2.new(1,0,0,24)
	if par then f.Parent = par end
	U.ac(f)
	local stroke = U.addStroke(f, T)
	return f, stroke

-- A region of the Classic view's panel `height` tall and as wide as the panel inside its side

	local frame, stroke = U.blob(name, panel, size, T)

function U.lbl(par, txt, T, w)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = txt
	l.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; l.Font = T.Font; l.TextSize = 8
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	l.Size = UDim2.new(0, w or 14, 1, 0); l.BorderSizePixel = 0
	l.Parent = par
	return l
end

return U

--[[
	ViewClassic: the graph editor's Classic layout: a header of tools, the folding preset strip, the
	plot, a status bar and a footer.
	  ViewClassic.prepare(editor)               the layout table and saved state the build reads
	  ViewClassic.build(screenGui, T, editor)   -> refs (BuildUI)
	  ViewClassic.panelScale(editor)            the scale of the panel's own UIScale
	  ViewClassic.methods                       copied onto the editor by GraphEditor.new
	A view owns where things sit. Its methods are the ones the behaviour mixins call without knowing
	the layout: _calcGraphRegion, _layoutGraph, _layoutStatusBar, _syncUIToState, _togglePresetStrip,
	_onOpened, _closeTransient. Every view provides the same names.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local Layout = require(script.Parent.Layout)
local buildUI = require(script.Parent.BuildUI)

local ViewClassic = {}
local methods = {}
ViewClassic.methods = methods
ViewClassic.build = buildUI

-- Must run before build: BuildUI reads _layout, _presetStripExpanded, _gY and _gH.
function ViewClassic.prepare(editor)
	editor._layout = Layout.CLASSIC
	editor._plotSunken = false
	editor._presetStripExpanded = editor:_savedPresetsOpen()
	editor:_calcGraphRegion()
end

function methods:_calcGraphRegion()
	local L = self._layout
	self._gY = Layout.graphY(L, self._presetStripExpanded)
	self._gH = Layout.graphH(L, self._presetStripExpanded)
end
function methods:_layoutGraph()
	self:_calcGraphRegion()
	self._graphFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, self._layout.side, 0, self._gY)
	self._graphFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self._layout.side * 2, 0, self._gH)
	if self._helpOverlay then
		self._helpOverlay.Position = UDim2.new(0, self._layout.side, 0, self._gY)
		self._helpOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self._layout.side * 2, 0, self._gH)
	end
	task.defer(function()
		self:_redraw()
		if self._editPanelOpen then self:_positionEditPanel() end
	end)
end
function methods:_layoutStatusBar()
	local s = self._state
	local isHandles = s.handlesEnabled
	local x = 4
	self._showBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 2); x = x + self._showBtn.Size.X.Offset + 4
	self._syncBtn.Visible = isHandles
	self._segLbl.Visible = isHandles
	self._segW.Visible = isHandles
	if isHandles then
		self._syncBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 2); x = x + 38
		self._segLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0); x = x + 24
		self._segW.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 2); x = x + 34
	end
end
function methods:_syncUIToState()
	local s = self._state; local T = self._T
	self._showBtn.TextColor3 = (s.handlesEnabled or s.envelopeEnabled) and T.Green or T.DarkGold
	self._envCheck.Text = s.envelopeEnabled and "\xe2\x98\x91" or "\xe2\x98\x90"
	self._envCheck.TextColor3 = s.envelopeEnabled and T.Green or T.DarkGold
	self._handlesCheck.Text = s.handlesEnabled and "\xe2\x98\x91" or "\xe2\x98\x90"
	self._handlesCheck.TextColor3 = s.handlesEnabled and T.Green or T.DarkGold
	self._syncBtn.TextColor3 = s.syncHandles and T.Green or T.DarkGold
	self:_layoutStatusBar(); self:_layoutEditPanel()
end
function methods:_togglePresetStrip()
	self._presetStripExpanded = not self._presetStripExpanded
	self._presetStrip.Visible = self._presetStripExpanded
	self._collapseBtn.Text = self._presetStripExpanded and "\xE2\x96\xBC" or "\xE2\x96\xB6"
	self._presetBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self._layout.side * 2, 0, self._presetStripExpanded and self._layout.presetH or self._layout.presetCollapsedH)
	self:_savePresetsOpen()
	self:_layoutGraph()
end
-- Whether the preset strip was left open (plugin setting GraphEditorPresetsOpen); the layout's
-- default when nothing is saved.
function methods:_savedPresetsOpen()
	local saved = nil
	if self._plugin then
		pcall(function()
			saved = self._plugin:GetSetting("GraphEditorPresetsOpen")
		end)
	end
	if saved ~= nil then
		return saved == true
	end
	return self._layout.presetsOpen
end

function methods:_savePresetsOpen()
	if self._plugin then
		pcall(function()
			self._plugin:SetSetting("GraphEditorPresetsOpen", self._presetStripExpanded)
		end)
	end
end

-- The header's size slider, saved as GraphEditorScale, times the factor that undoes the UI's base scale.
function ViewClassic.panelScale(editor)
	return editor:_savedPanelScale() * C.PANEL_BASE_SCALE
end

-- Open: the title and the panel's size.
function methods:_onOpened()
	self._title.Text = "Graph - " .. self._state.propName
	self._panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, self._layout.panelW, 0, self._layout.panelH)
end

-- Close: whatever of this view's own must not be showing at the next Open.
function methods:_closeTransient()
	if self._showPopup then self._showPopup.Visible = false end
	if self._showShield then self._showShield.Visible = false end
end

return ViewClassic

--[[
	ViewCompact: the graph editor as a small window, in the theme modes other than Classic. One frame
	around the plot: the property's name in a band along the top of the plot's surface; under the plot
	undo, redo, the value range, Cancel and Apply. A tab on the frame's top edge holds the Curve |
	Presets switch, the "..." menu (every other tool) and close; Shell draws the frame and the tab.
	Everything that is not a control or the plot moves the window; its edges resize it.
	  ViewCompact.prepare(editor)
	  ViewCompact.build(screenGui, T, editor) -> refs
	  ViewCompact.panelScale(editor) -> 1       drawn at the UI's own scale
	  ViewCompact.methods                       layout methods copied onto the editor (Methods)
	refs carry the names the mixins read (the plot, the popovers, undoBtn, pasteBtn, rMinIn ...) and
	refs.view, the handles Methods works through. The chrome uses the shared widgets, so the UI's theme
	registries repaint it; the plot and popovers register in refs.themeRefs for RefreshTheme. The
	plugin setting GraphWindowSize = { width, height } keeps the size. The switch, bottom row and menu
	are caption-sized at any text size, so the plot keeps the room (Metrics).
]]

-- A yield after each require spreads start-up over frames, as GraphEditor/init does.
local buildPlot = require(script.Parent.BuildPlot)
task.wait()
local buildPopups = require(script.Parent.BuildPopups)
task.wait()
local metrics = require(script.Metrics)
local Shell = require(script.Shell)
local Menu = require(script.Menu)
task.wait()
local Presets = require(script.Presets)
task.wait()
local BottomRow = require(script.BottomRow)
task.wait()
local methods = require(script.Methods)
task.wait()
local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local UIConstants = require(UIBuilder.Constants)
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(UIBuilder.TypeScale)
local LAYOUT = UIConstants.LAYOUT

-- Between the plot and the bottom row.
local GAP = 6
-- Between the tab's controls.
local TAB_GAP = 2
-- The name's inset from the plot surface's left edge.
local NAME_INSET = 8
-- The Presets page keeps this far from the plot surface's edges.
local PAGE_INSET = 6
local SIZE_SETTING = "GraphWindowSize"
-- The curve and keypoint layers are clipped this far outside the plot's range, so a keypoint or
-- a flat curve lying on the top or bottom of the range is drawn whole (a keypoint dot's radius).
local PLOT_BLEED = 6
-- Right of the curve: half a time label and a little air, so the last label is not cut.
local PLOT_RIGHT_PAD = 18
-- The shortcuts card is this big where the plot has the room, smaller where it has not.
local HELP_CARD_MARGIN = 8
local HELP_CARD_MOST = Vector2.new(300, 230)

local ViewCompact = {}
ViewCompact.methods = methods

function ViewCompact.prepare(editor)
	editor._plotSunken = true
end

function ViewCompact.panelScale()
	return 1
end

-- The size the window was left at, never under the smallest it resizes to.
local function openingSize(editor)
	local saved = nil
	if editor._plugin then
		pcall(function()
			saved = editor._plugin:GetSetting(SIZE_SETTING)
		end)
	end
	if type(saved) == "table" and tonumber(saved[1]) and tonumber(saved[2]) then
		return math.max(saved[1], metrics.MinWidth), math.max(saved[2], metrics.MinHeight)
	end
	return metrics.Width, metrics.Height
end

-- The rows of the "..." menu. Returns the refs the mixins read and the view's handles on them.
local function fillMenu(menu, editor, showCurve)
	-- A tool acts on the curve: the Curve page comes forward, and the menu shuts unless it is a
	-- toggle, whose tick is the feedback.
	local function onUse(item, keepOpen, action)
		item.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not keepOpen then
				menu.close()
			end
			showCurve()
			action()
		end)
	end

	local copy, paste = menu.addPair("Copy", "Copy", "Paste", "Paste")
	onUse(copy, false, function()
		editor:_copyToClipboard()
	end)
	onUse(paste, false, function()
		editor:_pasteFromClipboard()
	end)
	local invert, fit = menu.addPair("Invert", "Invert", "Fit", "Fit range")
	onUse(invert, false, function()
		editor:_invertGraph()
	end)
	onUse(fit, false, function()
		editor:_adaptRange(false)
		editor:_redraw()
	end)
	local simplify, code = menu.addPair("Simplify", "Simplify...", "Code", "Code...")
	onUse(simplify, false, function()
		editor:_toggleSimplifyPanel()
	end)
	onUse(code, false, function()
		editor:_openCodePopup()
	end)
	menu.addDivider()

	local envelope = menu.addTick("Envelope", "Envelope")
	onUse(envelope, true, function()
		editor:_toggleEnvelope()
	end)
	local handles = menu.addTick("Handles", "Bezier handles")
	onUse(handles, true, function()
		editor:_toggleHandles()
	end)
	local mirror = menu.addTick("Mirror", "Mirror handles")
	onUse(mirror, true, function()
		editor:_toggleSync()
	end)
	local segments, segmentsRow = menu.addNumber("Segments", "Segments", "19")
	segments.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		editor:_onSegmentsIn()
	end)
	local envelopeAdd = menu.addNumber("EnvelopeAdd", "Add to envelope", "")
	envelopeAdd.PlaceholderText = "+"
	envelopeAdd.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		editor:_onAddEnvelope()
	end)
	menu.addDivider()

	onUse(menu.addItem("Revert", "Revert to saved"), false, function()
		editor:_reload()
	end)
	onUse(menu.addItem("Shortcuts", "Shortcuts"), false, function()
		editor:_toggleHelp()
	end)

	return {
		pasteBtn = paste,
		segIn = segments,
		envAddIn = envelopeAdd,
	}, {
		ticks = { envelope = envelope, handles = handles, mirror = mirror },
		segmentsRow = segmentsRow,
	}
end

-- The tab's controls, right to left: close, the "..." menu button, the Curve | Presets switch.
-- The grip dots keep the tab's left end.
local function buildTabControls(tab)
	-- slots: how many icon slots stand between the button and the tab's right padding.
	local function makeGlyphButton(name, glyph, slots)
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Name = name
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		button.Text = glyph
		button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		W.layProps(button, function()
			return {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -(metrics.TabPad + LAYOUT.IconSlot * slots), 0, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0),
			}
		end)
		button.ZIndex = 3
		TypeScale.style(button, "Glyph")
		W.paint(button, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		button.Parent = tab
		return button
	end

	local close = makeGlyphButton("Close", "\u{00D7}", 0)
	local more = makeGlyphButton("More", "\u{22EF}", 1)

	local switch = W.makeSegmentStrip(tab, "View")
	switch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	W.lay(switch, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -(metrics.TabPad + LAYOUT.IconSlot * 2 + TAB_GAP), 0.5, 0)
	end)
	switch.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.Switch - TAB_GAP, 0, metrics.SwitchHeight)
	switch.ZIndex = 3
	-- A quiet switch: the lit page is a faint tint, not a block of accent.
	local curveTab = W.makeSegment(switch, "Curve", "Curve", 1, { fill = true, soft = true })
	local presetsTab = W.makeSegment(switch, "Presets", "Presets", 2, { fill = true, soft = true })
	TypeScale.style(curveTab, "Caption")
	TypeScale.style(presetsTab, "Caption")

	return { close = close, more = more, curveTab = curveTab, presetsTab = presetsTab }
end

-- The band along the top of the plot's surface: the property's name, and over it a handle the
-- window is moved by. The band is outside the plot proper, so a press on it is not plot input.
-- Returns the name label and the handle.
local function buildNameBand(header)
	local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	name.Name = "Title"
	name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	name.Text = ""
	name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	name.Position = UDim2.new(0, NAME_INSET, 0, 0)
	name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -NAME_INSET * 2, 1, 0)
	name.ZIndex = 2
	TypeScale.style(name, "Caption")
	W.paint(name, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	name.Parent = header

	local handle = Instance.new("TextButton")
	handle.Name = "DragHandle"
	handle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	handle.Text = ""
	handle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	handle.ZIndex = 3
	handle.Parent = header
	return name, handle
end

function ViewCompact.build(screenGui, T, editor)
	local pad = metrics.FramePad

	local themeRefs = { panels = {}, blobs = {}, strokes = {}, scrollbars = {}, colored = {} }
	local track = {
		blob = function(instance)
			table.insert(themeRefs.blobs, instance)
		end,
		stroke = function(instance)
			table.insert(themeRefs.strokes, instance)
		end,
		scrollbar = function(instance)
			table.insert(themeRefs.scrollbars, instance)
		end,
		color = function(instance, property, colorKey)
			table.insert(themeRefs.colored, { instance, property, colorKey })
		end,
	}

	local width, height = openingSize(editor)
	local shell = Shell.build(screenGui, metrics, width, height)
	local panel, body, content = shell.panel, shell.body, shell.content
	local grips = shell.grips

	local controls = buildTabControls(shell.tab)
	controls.close.Activated:Connect(function()
		editor:Close()
	end)
	local menu = Menu.new(screenGui, controls.more, metrics, editor._conns)
	local curveTab, presetsTab = controls.curveTab, controls.presetsTab

	-- The plot's surface fills the frame down to the bottom row; its top band carries the name.
	local belowPlot = metrics.BottomRow + GAP
	local plot = buildPlot(content, T, track, {
		position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -belowPlot),
		sunken = true,
		bleed = PLOT_BLEED,
		header = metrics.Header,
		rightPad = PLOT_RIGHT_PAD,
	})
	local name, nameGrip = buildNameBand(plot.plotHeader)
	table.insert(grips, nameGrip)

	local gapGrip = Instance.new("TextButton")
	gapGrip.Name = "GripGap"
	gapGrip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	gapGrip.Text = ""
	gapGrip.AutoButtonColor = false
	gapGrip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -belowPlot)
	gapGrip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, GAP)
	gapGrip.Parent = content
	table.insert(grips, gapGrip)

	-- One page shows at a time, under the name. Coming back to the curve redraws it; leaving
	-- it shuts the keypoint edit panel, which would otherwise hang over the tiles.
	local page = nil
	local onCurve = true
	local function showTab(tabName)
		onCurve = tabName ~= "presets"
		plot.graphFrame.Visible = onCurve
		page.Visible = not onCurve
		W.paintSegment(curveTab, onCurve)
		W.paintSegment(presetsTab, not onCurve)
		if onCurve then
			editor:_layoutGraph()
		else
			editor:_hideEditPanel()
		end
	end

	page = Presets.build(plot.plotSurface, metrics, T, function(index)
		editor:_applyPreset(index)
		showTab("curve")
	end)
	page.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAGE_INSET, 0, metrics.Header)
	page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PAGE_INSET * 2, 1, -(metrics.Header + PAGE_INSET))
	curveTab.Activated:Connect(function()
		showTab("curve")
	end)
	presetsTab.Activated:Connect(function()
		showTab("presets")
	end)
	W.paintSegment(curveTab, true)

	local rowRefs, _, rowGrip = BottomRow.build(content, editor, metrics, T, track)
	table.insert(grips, rowGrip)
	W.makeDraggable(panel, grips)

	-- The popovers are children of the body, so they can lie over any of it.
	local popups = buildPopups(body, T, editor, track, {
		helpPosition = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0, pad),
		helpSize = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2, 1, -(pad * 2 + belowPlot)),
		simplifyPosition = UDim2.new(1, -pad, 1, -(pad + belowPlot)),
	})
	popups.simpPanel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	popups.helpCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, -HELP_CARD_MARGIN * 2, 1, -HELP_CARD_MARGIN * 2)
	local cardLimit = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	cardLimit.MaxSize = HELP_CARD_MOST
	cardLimit.Parent = popups.helpCard

	local menuRefs, menuHandles = fillMenu(menu, editor, function()
		if not onCurve then
			showTab("curve")
		end
	end)

	-- The curve is drawn in pixels: a new size needs a redraw, once per frame of the drag.
	local redrawQueued = false
	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		if redrawQueued or not panel.Visible then
			return
		end
		redrawQueued = true
		task.defer(function()
			redrawQueued = false
			if panel.Visible then
				editor:_layoutGraph()
			end
		end)
	end)
	-- The menu hangs from the "..." button: it does not follow a window that moves.
	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(menu.close)

	local function saveSize()
		if not editor._plugin then
			return
		end
		local size = panel.Size
		pcall(function()
			editor._plugin:SetSetting(SIZE_SETTING, { size.X.Offset, size.Y.Offset })
		end)
	end

	local refs = {
		themeRefs = themeRefs,
		panel = panel,
		title = name,
		view = {
			menu = menu,
			showTab = showTab,
			onCurveTab = function()
				return onCurve
			end,
			ticks = menuHandles.ticks,
			segmentsRow = menuHandles.segmentsRow,
			saveSize = saveSize,
			smoothSlider = rowRefs.smoothSlider,
		},
	}
	for _, group in ipairs({ plot, popups, rowRefs, menuRefs }) do
		for key, value in pairs(group) do
			refs[key] = value
		end
	end
	return refs
end

return ViewCompact

--[[
	ViewCompact/BottomRow: the row under the plot of the compact graph window: undo and redo, the Min
	and Max of the visible range, the Smooth slider, then Cancel and Apply at the right end.
	  BottomRow.build(content, editor, metrics, theme, track) -> refs, row, gap
	    refs: undoBtn, redoBtn, rMinIn, rMaxIn, applyBtn (read by the mixins) and smoothSlider (a
	    MiniSlider, 0 to 100: Rendering:_setSmooth); track registers the slider for RefreshTheme
	    gap: the row's empty stretch, a handle the view moves the window by
	Anchored to the bottom of `content`; the flexible gap keeps Cancel and Apply right at any width.
	Controls are caption-sized at both text sizes, leaving the room to the plot.
]]

local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(UIBuilder.TypeScale)
local MiniSlider = require(UIBuilder.MiniSlider)

local GAP = 4
-- Between the undo pair and the range fields.
local GROUP_GAP = 6
-- Between the Smooth caption and its track: half of MiniSlider's handle.
local HANDLE_ROOM = 4
-- Plain arrows: the theme fonts have no curved undo / redo arrows (they draw blank or as emoji).
local UNDO_GLYPH = "\u{2190}"
local REDO_GLYPH = "\u{2192}"

local BottomRow = {}

local function makeSquareButton(row, name, glyph, order, side)
	local button = W.makeActionButton(row, name, glyph, order)
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, side, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(button, "Caption")
	return button
end

-- Cancel and Apply are one fixed width: a button sized to its text ends up exactly as wide as
-- the text at a fractional UI scale, which leaves the text no margin.
local function makeFooterButton(row, name, text, order, textRole, width)
	local button = W.makeActionButton(row, name, text, order, textRole)
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(button, "Caption")
	return button
end

local function makeSpacer(row, name, width, order)
	local spacer = Instance.new("Frame")
	spacer.Name = name
	spacer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	spacer.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
	spacer.LayoutOrder = order
	spacer.Parent = row
	return spacer
end

-- A caption in the row, as wide as its text.
local function makeCaption(row, name, text, order)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	label.LayoutOrder = order
	TypeScale.style(label, "Caption")
	W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
	label.Parent = row
	return label
end

local function makeRangeField(row, name, labelText, defaultText, width, order)
	makeCaption(row, name .. "Label", labelText, order)

	local box, field = W.makeTextField(row, name, defaultText, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
	TypeScale.style(box, "Caption")
	field.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
	field.LayoutOrder = order + 1
	return box
end

-- The Smooth slider: how far the curve eases through its keypoints, 0 (straight lines) to 100%.
-- It answers the drag directly; the curve above redraws as it moves.
local function makeSmoothSlider(row, editor, metrics, theme, track, order)
	makeCaption(row, "SmoothLabel", "Smooth", order)
	-- Half the handle stands left of the track's start at 0%: room for it beside the caption.
	makeSpacer(row, "SmoothInset", HANDLE_ROOM, order + 1)

	local slider = MiniSlider.new(row, theme, {
		name = "Smooth", min = 0, max = 100, default = 0, fmt = "%.0f%%",
		width = metrics.SmoothSlider, height = metrics.BottomRow, labelWidth = metrics.SmoothValue,
	})
	slider.frame.LayoutOrder = order + 2
	TypeScale.style(slider.label, "Caption")
	W.paint(slider.label, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	track.blob(slider.track)
	track.color(slider.fill, "BackgroundColor3", "SliderFill")
	track.color(slider.handle, "BackgroundColor3", "BrightGold")
	for _, connection in ipairs(slider.conns) do
		table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), connection)
	end
	slider.onChanged = function(value)
		editor:_setSmooth(value / 100)
	end
	slider.onRelease = function()
		editor:_endSmoothDrag()
	end
	return slider
end

function BottomRow.build(content, editor, metrics, theme, track)
