--[[
	ViewCompact/Menu: the "..." menu of the compact graph window, a small list of caption-sized rows.
	A popup of the ScreenGui, not of the window, so the small window cannot clip it; its layer is above
	every panel's.
	  Menu.new(screenGui, anchor, metrics, connections) -> menu
	    menu.frame                                      the popup surface
	    menu.addItem(name, text) -> button              an action row
	    menu.addPair(name, text, name, text) -> button, button   two actions side by side
	    menu.addTick(name, text) -> button              a row with a tick at its right end while on
	    menu.setTick(button, on) / menu.isTicked(button)
	    menu.addNumber(name, label, text) -> box, row   a label and a small number field
	    menu.addDivider()
	    menu.setShown(row, shown)                       hides or shows a row, then refits
	    menu.open() / menu.close() / menu.toggle() / menu.isOpen()
	Opens under `anchor` from its left edge (mostly beside the window, off the plot), or right-aligned
	to it when there is no room; stays on screen, as tall as its rows up to the room below, then
	scrolls. A press outside closes it. `connections` receives the input connection, dropped on Destroy.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local C = require(UIBuilder.Constants)
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(UIBuilder.TypeScale)

-- PanelStack leaves layers of 20 and up alone; dialogs sit at 200.
local MENU_LAYER = 60
local SCREEN_MARGIN = 8
local SURFACE_PAD = 3
local ROW_GAP = 1
local SCROLLBAR = 3
-- Rows always shown, however little room there is under the anchor.
local LEAST_ROWS = 3
local TICK = "\u{2713}"
local TICK_WIDTH = 12
-- A number row's label starts where the items' text does.
local LABEL_INSET = 8
local FIELD_INSET = 2

local Menu = {}

local function contains(object, point)
	local origin = object.AbsolutePosition
	local size = object.AbsoluteSize
	return point.X >= origin.X and point.Y >= origin.Y and point.X <= origin.X + size.X and point.Y <= origin.Y + size.Y
end

function Menu.new(screenGui, anchor, metrics, connections)
	local menu = {}
	local order = 0
	local width = metrics.MenuWidth
	local rowHeight = metrics.MenuRow
	local tickOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "GraphMenu"
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Active = true
	frame.Visible = false
	frame.ZIndex = MENU_LAYER
	-- The window's own colour, solid: the menu reads as a part of the window it hangs from.
	W.paint(frame, "BackgroundColor3", "PanelBg")
	frame.Parent = screenGui
	W.addCorner(frame)
	W.addStroke(frame)
	menu.frame = frame

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "Rows"
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.Position = UDim2.new(0, SURFACE_PAD, 0, SURFACE_PAD)
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -SURFACE_PAD * 2, 1, -SURFACE_PAD * 2)
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	list.ScrollBarThickness = SCROLLBAR
	list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.T.ScrollBar
	list.Parent = frame
	W.addListLayout(list, ROW_GAP)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, list)

	local function nextOrder()
		order += 1
		return order
	end

	-- The shared menu row at this menu's size: caption text, a shorter row.
	local function makeRowButton(parent, name, text, rowOrder)
		local item = W.makeMenuItem(parent, name, text, rowOrder)
		item.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight)
		TypeScale.style(item, "Caption")
		return item
	end

	local function makeRowFrame(name)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = name
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight)
		row.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
		row.Parent = list
		return row
	end

	-- Height of the showing rows. Counted from the rows' own sizes: they are fixed offsets.
	local function rowsHeight()
		local height = 0
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
				height += child.Size.Y.Offset
				count += 1
			end
		end
		return height + math.max(count - 1, 0) * ROW_GAP
	end

	-- Everything here is in the ScreenGui's own units: screen pixels over its UIScale.
	local function place()
		local guiScale = screenGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local scale = (guiScale and guiScale.Scale > 0) and guiScale.Scale or 1
		local screen = screenGui.AbsoluteSize / scale
		local corner = (anchor.AbsolutePosition - screenGui.AbsolutePosition) / scale
		local anchorSize = anchor.AbsoluteSize / scale

		local wanted = rowsHeight() + SURFACE_PAD * 2
		local least = LEAST_ROWS * (rowHeight + ROW_GAP) + SURFACE_PAD * 2
		local roomBelow = screen.Y - (corner.Y + anchorSize.Y) - SCREEN_MARGIN
		local height = math.min(wanted, math.max(roomBelow, least))

		local left = corner.X
		if left + width > screen.X - SCREEN_MARGIN then
			left = corner.X + anchorSize.X - width
		end
		left = math.clamp(left, SCREEN_MARGIN, math.max(screen.X - width - SCREEN_MARGIN, SCREEN_MARGIN))
		local top = math.min(corner.Y + anchorSize.Y, math.max(screen.Y - height - SCREEN_MARGIN, SCREEN_MARGIN))
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left, top)
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	end

	function menu.addItem(name, text)
		return makeRowButton(list, name, text, nextOrder())
	end

	function menu.addPair(firstName, firstText, secondName, secondText)
		local row = makeRowFrame(firstName .. secondName)
		local first = makeRowButton(row, firstName, firstText, 1)
		first.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
		local second = makeRowButton(row, secondName, secondText, 2)
		second.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
		second.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
		return first, second
	end

	function menu.addTick(name, text)
		local item = makeRowButton(list, name, text, nextOrder())
		local tick = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		tick.Name = "Tick"
		tick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tick.Text = TICK
		tick.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		tick.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		tick.Size = UDim2.new(0, TICK_WIDTH, 1, 0)
		tick.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(tick, "Caption")
		W.paint(tick, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
		tick.Parent = item
		tickOf[item] = tick
		return item
	end

	function menu.setTick(item, on)
		tickOf[item].Visible = on == true
	end

	function menu.isTicked(item)
		return tickOf[item].Visible
	end

	function menu.addNumber(name, labelText, defaultText)
		local row = makeRowFrame(name)
		local fieldRoom = metrics.MenuField + FIELD_INSET

		local label = W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, 0)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, LABEL_INSET, 0, 0)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LABEL_INSET + fieldRoom), 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(label, "Caption")

		local box, field = W.makeTextField(row, name, defaultText, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
		TypeScale.style(box, "Caption")
		field.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		field.Position = UDim2.new(1, -FIELD_INSET, 0.5, 0)
		field.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.MenuField, 1, -FIELD_INSET)
		return box, row
	end

	function menu.addDivider()
		return W.makeDivider(list, nextOrder())
	end

	function menu.setShown(row, shown)
		row.Visible = shown
		if frame.Visible then
			place()
		end
	end

	function menu.isOpen()
		return frame.Visible
	end

	function menu.open()
		place()
		list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		frame.Visible = true
	end

	function menu.close()
		frame.Visible = false
	end

	function menu.toggle()
		if frame.Visible then
			menu.close()
		else
			menu.open()
		end
	end

	anchor.Activated:Connect(menu.toggle)
	table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if not frame.Visible then
			return
		end
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			return
		end
		-- A press on the anchor is left to its Activated, which closes the menu itself.
		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		if contains(frame, mouse) or contains(anchor, mouse) then
			return
		end
		menu.close()
	end))

	return menu
end

return Menu

--[[
	ViewCompact/Methods  -  the compact view's versions of the editor methods that depend on where
	things sit. GraphEditor.new copies them onto the editor, where each takes the place of the
	Classic method of the same name (ViewClassic.methods, or the mixin's own).
	They reach the view through editor._viewHandles (ViewCompact.build, refs.view):
	  menu, showTab(name), onCurveTab(), ticks { envelope, handles, mirror }, segmentsRow, saveSize(),
	  smoothSlider
	Mutates the LIVE editor panel and its menu. Refreshed by: the editor's own state changes
	(_syncUIToState), Open and Close.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)

-- A tool with nothing to act on keeps its colour and fades.
local DISABLED_TEXT_TRANSPARENCY = 0.55
-- Edit panel: space kept to the window's edges, and between the panel and its keypoint.
local EDIT_MARGIN = 8
local KEYPOINT_CLEARANCE = 14
local CARET_INSET = 10

local methods = {}

local function setUsable(button, usable)
	button.TextTransparency = usable and 0 or DISABLED_TEXT_TRANSPARENCY
end

-- The plot is anchored to the window by its build; there is no region to work out.
function methods:_calcGraphRegion()
end

function methods:_layoutGraph()
	task.defer(function()
		self:_redraw()
		if self._editPanelOpen then
			self:_positionEditPanel()
		end
	end)
end

-- Mirror handles and Segments only mean something while bezier handles are on.
function methods:_layoutStatusBar()
	local view = self._viewHandles
	local handlesOn = self._state.handlesEnabled
	view.menu.setShown(view.ticks.mirror, handlesOn)
	view.menu.setShown(view.segmentsRow, handlesOn)
end

function methods:_syncUIToState()
	local view = self._viewHandles
	local state = self._state
	view.menu.setTick(view.ticks.envelope, state.envelopeEnabled)
	view.menu.setTick(view.ticks.handles, state.handlesEnabled)
	view.menu.setTick(view.ticks.mirror, state.syncHandles)
	self:_layoutStatusBar()
	self:_layoutEditPanel()
end

-- The Smooth slider shows the editor's amount without answering it.
function methods:_showSmooth(amount)
	local slider = self._viewHandles.smoothSlider
	if slider then
		slider.set(amount * 100, true)
	end
end

function methods:_toggleSync()
	self._state.syncHandles = not self._state.syncHandles
	self._viewHandles.menu.setTick(self._viewHandles.ticks.mirror, self._state.syncHandles)
end

-- The presets are a page of the window here, not a strip: the toggle switches pages.
function methods:_togglePresetStrip()
	local view = self._viewHandles
	view.showTab(view.onCurveTab() and "presets" or "curve")
end

function methods:_onOpened()
	self._title.Text = self._state.propName
	self._viewHandles.showTab("curve")
end

function methods:_closeTransient()
	self._viewHandles.menu.close()
	self._viewHandles.saveSize()
end

function methods:_flashCopied()
	self:_showActionPopup("Copied")
end

function methods:_updateUndoRedoBtns()
	setUsable(self._undoBtn, #self._undoStack > 0)
	setUsable(self._redoBtn, #self._redoStack > 0)
end

function methods:_updatePasteBtn()
	local hasClip = self._onGetClip ~= nil and self._onGetClip() ~= nil
	setUsable(self._pasteBtn, hasClip)
end

function methods:_toggleHelp()
	if self._helpVisible then
		self:_hideHelp()
		return
	end
	self._helpVisible = true
	self._helpOverlay.Visible = true
end

function methods:_hideHelp()
	self._helpVisible = false
	self._helpOverlay.Visible = false
end

-- Places the edit panel by its keypoint from the plot's live rectangle, so it is right at any
-- window size: under the keypoint, or above it when the window's bottom edge is too close.
function methods:_positionEditPanel()
	local primary = self:_getPrimary()
	if not primary then
		return
	end
	local keypoint = self._state.keypoints[primary]
	if not keypoint then
		return
	end

	local normX, normY = self:_kpToNorm(keypoint)
	local host = self._editPanel.Parent
	local scale = self:_getUIScale()
	local drawOrigin = (self._drawArea.AbsolutePosition - host.AbsolutePosition) / scale
	local drawSize = self._drawArea.AbsoluteSize / scale
	local hostSize = host.AbsoluteSize / scale
	local pointX = drawOrigin.X + normX * drawSize.X
	local pointY = drawOrigin.Y + normY * drawSize.Y

	local height = self._editPanelFullH or 60
	local farLeft = math.max(hostSize.X - C.EDITPANEL_W - EDIT_MARGIN, EDIT_MARGIN)
	local left = math.clamp(pointX - C.EDITPANEL_W / 2, EDIT_MARGIN, farLeft)
	local top = pointY + KEYPOINT_CLEARANCE
	local above = top + height > hostSize.Y - EDIT_MARGIN
	if above then
		top = math.max(pointY - KEYPOINT_CLEARANCE - height, EDIT_MARGIN)
	end
	self._editPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, top)

	local caretX = math.clamp(pointX - left, CARET_INSET, C.EDITPANEL_W - CARET_INSET)
	if above then
		self._editCaret.Position = UDim2.new(0, caretX, 1, 2)
	else
		self._editCaret.Position = UDim2.new(0, caretX, 0, -2)
	end
end

return methods

--[[
	ViewCompact/Presets  -  the Presets page of the compact graph window: every preset curve as a
	tile with its name under it, in a grid that wraps to the window's width and scrolls. As many
	columns as fit at the metrics' tile size, each tile then grown to fill the row (square, its
	curve drawn again at the new size).
	  Presets.build(parent, metrics, T, onPick) -> page
	    onPick(index) runs on a click, with the preset's index in Constants.PRESETS.
	The page is hidden as built; the view shows it on the plot's surface in place of the plot,
	so a tile is a field-coloured card on that sunken surface.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local PresetThumb = require(script.Parent.Parent.PresetThumb)
local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local UIConstants = require(UIBuilder.Constants)
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(UIBuilder.TypeScale)

local SCROLLBAR = 3
local TILE_CORNER = 6
local CAPTION_GAP = 2
-- The curve sits in the middle of its tile: the name is under the tile, not inside it.
local TILE_INSET = { Left = 0.14, Width = 0.72, Top = 0.16, Height = 0.68 }

local Presets = {}

local function paintLine(line, property, role)
	W.paint(line, property, role)
end

-- Returns relay(size): lays the tile out at `size` pixels square, its curve drawn for it.
local function buildTile(page, preset, index, metrics, T, onPick)
	local cell = Instance.new("Frame")
	cell.Name = preset.name
	cell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cell.LayoutOrder = index
	cell.Parent = page

	local backing = Instance.new("TextButton")
	backing.Name = "Tile"
	backing.Text = ""
	backing.AutoButtonColor = false
	backing.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.paint(backing, "BackgroundColor3", "Field")
	backing.Parent = cell
	W.addCorner(backing, UDim.new(0, TILE_CORNER))
	local outline = W.addStroke(backing)

	local curve = Instance.new("Frame")
	curve.Name = "Curve"
	curve.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	curve.ClipsDescendants = true
	curve.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	curve.Parent = backing

	local caption = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	caption.Name = "Name"
	caption.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	caption.Text = preset.name
	caption.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	TypeScale.style(caption, "Caption")
	W.paint(caption, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	caption.Parent = cell

	backing.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if W.pointerBlocked(backing) then
			return
		end
		outline.Color = T.OutlineHover
	end)
	backing.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		outline.Color = T.Border
	end)
	backing.Activated:Connect(function()
		onPick(index)
	end)

	local drawnAt = nil
	return function(size)
		if size == drawnAt then
			return
		end
		drawnAt = size
		backing.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
		caption.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, size + CAPTION_GAP)
		caption.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, metrics.Caption)
		curve:ClearAllChildren()
		PresetThumb.draw(curve, preset, size, size, T, paintLine, 2, TILE_INSET)
	end
end

function Presets.build(parent, metrics, T, onPick)
	local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	page.Name = "Presets"
	page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	page.BorderSizePixel = 0
	page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	page.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	page.ScrollBarThickness = SCROLLBAR
	page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = UIConstants.T.ScrollBar
	page.Visible = false
	page.Parent = parent
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, page)

	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, metrics.TileGap, 0, metrics.TileGap)
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	grid.Parent = page

	local relays = {}
	for index, preset in ipairs(C.PRESETS) do
		relays[index] = buildTile(page, preset, index, metrics, T, onPick)
	end

	-- The page's width in the UI's own units (its window, less the scroll bar, over the UI scale).
	local function fit()
		local scale = W._getScale(page)
		local room = page.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / (scale > 0 and scale or 1)
		local size = metrics.Tile
		if room > 0 then
			local gap = metrics.TileGap
			local columns = math.max(1, math.floor((room + gap) / (metrics.Tile + gap)))
			size = math.floor((room - (columns - 1) * gap) / columns)
		end
		grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size + CAPTION_GAP + metrics.Caption)
		for _, relay in ipairs(relays) do
			relay(size)
		end
	end
	page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"):Connect(fit)
	fit()
	return page
end

return Presets

--[[
	ViewCompact/Shell: the outline of the compact graph window: one frame for the plot and the bottom
	row, with a tab for the window's controls on its top edge at the right.
	  Shell.build(screenGui, metrics, width, height) -> shell
	    shell.panel    the rectangle around frame and tab, as the rest of the UI knows the window:
	                   moved, resized, stacked and kept on screen as one
	    shell.body     the visible frame under the tab; the popovers are its children
	    shell.content  the body inside its padding (Metrics.FramePad)
	    shell.tab      the tab's surface, for the window's controls
	    shell.grips    the move handles: the tab behind its controls (dotted grip at its left end)
	                   and the frame's border on all four sides
	The panel draws nothing and takes no input, so the 3D view left of the tab stays clickable. Body
	and tab register as panels for theme repaints; a theme's background image lies under the body
	alone (Widgets.attachPanelBackground), the tab stays solid. Widgets.makeResizable gets the tab's
	height as top inset and grabMoves: the tab is layered above the resize handles, and a border
	pressed before its resize glow shows moves the window.
]]

local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local UIConstants = require(UIBuilder.Constants)
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local T = UIConstants.T
local LAYOUT = UIConstants.LAYOUT

-- The outlines are drawn one offset outside their frames; the panel clips, so its frames keep
-- that far from its edges.
local OUTLINE = 1
-- Above the resize handles' layer (8).
local TAB_LAYER = 9
-- The grip: a block of dots in the middle of the room kept for it at the tab's left end.
local DOT = 2
local DOT_GAP = 2
local DOT_ROWS = 3
local DOT_COLUMNS = 4

local Shell = {}

local function makeHandle(parent, name, position, size)
	local handle = Instance.new("TextButton")
	handle.Name = name
	handle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	handle.Text = ""
	handle.AutoButtonColor = false
	handle.Position = position
	handle.Size = size
	handle.Parent = parent
	return handle
end

-- Returns the dots, for the hover feedback.
local function buildGripDots(tab, metrics)
	local width = DOT_COLUMNS * DOT + (DOT_COLUMNS - 1) * DOT_GAP
	local height = DOT_ROWS * DOT + (DOT_ROWS - 1) * DOT_GAP

	local block = Instance.new("Frame")
	block.Name = "GripDots"
	block.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	block.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	block.Position = UDim2.new(0, metrics.TabPad + math.floor((metrics.Grip - width) / 2), 0.5, 0)
	block.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	block.Parent = tab

	local dots = {}
	for row = 0, DOT_ROWS - 1 do
		for column = 0, DOT_COLUMNS - 1 do
			local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
			dot.Name = "Dot"
			dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
			dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(column * (DOT + DOT_GAP), row * (DOT + DOT_GAP))
			dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(DOT, DOT)
			W.paint(dot, "BackgroundColor3", "TextSecondary")
			dot.Parent = block
			table.insert(dots, dot)
		end
	end
	return dots
end

-- The tab: a rounded surface taller than the strip it shows in, so its bottom corners and its
-- bottom outline are cut off and its sides run straight down onto the body's top edge. It ends
-- where the body's own corner starts to round.
local function buildTab(panel, metrics)
	local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
	strip.Name = "TabStrip"
	strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	strip.ClipsDescendants = true
	strip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	W.lay(strip, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.BigCorner, 0, 0)
	end)
	-- Grip, switch, "..." and close, with the padding at both ends.
	W.lay(strip, "Size", function()
		local width = metrics.TabPad * 2 + metrics.Grip + metrics.Switch + LAYOUT.IconSlot * 2
		return UDim2.fromOffset(width + OUTLINE * 2, metrics.TabHeight)
	end)
	strip.ZIndex = TAB_LAYER
	strip.Parent = panel

	local tab = Instance.new("Frame")
	tab.Name = "Tab"
	tab.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	tab.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(OUTLINE, OUTLINE)
	W.lay(tab, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -OUTLINE * 2, 1, LAYOUT.BigCorner)
	end)
	tab.Active = true
	tab:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	tab.Parent = strip
	W.addCorner(tab, "Big")
	W.addStroke(tab)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, tab)

	-- The controls sit in the showing part of the tab, not in the part cut off below it.
	local face = Instance.new("Frame")
	face.Name = "Face"
	face.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	face.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.TabHeight - OUTLINE)
	face.Parent = tab

	local grip = makeHandle(face, "Grip", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	local dots = buildGripDots(face, metrics)

	-- The dots light up under the cursor: the tab is where the window is picked up.
	local function paintDots(role)
		for _, dot in ipairs(dots) do
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = T[role]
		end
	end
	grip.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if W.pointerBlocked(grip) then
			return
		end
		paintDots("TextPrimary")
	end)
	grip.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		paintDots("TextSecondary")
	end)

	return face, grip
end

-- The frame's border as handles: a strip along each side of the body, as wide as its padding.
local function buildBorderHandles(body, pad)
	return {
		makeHandle(body, "GripTop", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, pad)),
		makeHandle(body, "GripBottom", UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -pad), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, pad)),
		makeHandle(body, "GripLeft", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, pad), UDim2.new(0, pad, 1, -pad * 2)),
		makeHandle(body, "GripRight", UDim2.new(1, -pad, 0, pad), UDim2.new(0, pad, 1, -pad * 2)),
	}
end

function Shell.build(screenGui, metrics, width, height)
	local pad = metrics.FramePad

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "GraphEditor"
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2, 0.5, -height / 2)
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.ZIndex = 6
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true
	panel.Parent = screenGui

	local body = Instance.new("Frame")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	body.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	body.BorderSizePixel = 0
	body.Position = UDim2.new(0, OUTLINE, 0, metrics.TabHeight)
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -OUTLINE * 2, 1, -(metrics.TabHeight + OUTLINE))
	body.ClipsDescendants = true
	body.Active = true
	body.Parent = panel
	W.addCorner(body, "Big")
	W.addStroke(body)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, body)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel, body)
	W.makeResizable(panel, metrics.MinWidth, metrics.MinHeight, { topInset = metrics.TabHeight, grabMoves = true })

	local grips = buildBorderHandles(body, pad)

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0, pad)
	content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2, 1, -pad * 2)
	content.Parent = body

	local tab, tabGrip = buildTab(panel, metrics)
	table.insert(grips, tabGrip)

	return {
		panel = panel,
		body = body,
		content = content,
		tab = tab,
		grips = grips,
	}
end

return Shell

--[[
	HueShift  -  the Hue tool's work: turns the hue and shifts saturation and value of every colour of
	a snapshotted selection (hue in turns -0.5..0.5, saturation and value -1..1; maths in ColorMath).
	  shiftColorSequence(sequence, hue, saturation, value, mayAddPoints) -> ColorSequence
	  shiftColor(color, hue, saturation, value) -> Color3
	  applyToSnapshots / applyToBlender(snapshots, hue, saturation, value)
	  snapshotTints(items, highlights) -> tints; applyToTints(tints, hue, saturation, value); restoreTints(tints)
	Mutates the LIVE items, always from the snapshot's colours. QOL takes and restores the snapshots,
	QOLWiring the tints. A colour gains keypoints where its blend would drift, up to 20; Blender
	states keep theirs, as blending two states merges their times (Graph.BlendColorGraphWithTime)
	within those 20. Requires TypeRegistry and ColorMath only.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry)
local ColorMath = require(script.ColorMath)
local Tints = require(script.Tints)

-- ColorSequence.new throws above this many keypoints.
local MOST_KEYPOINTS = 20

local HueShift = {}

function HueShift.shiftColorSequence(sequence, hue, saturation, value, mayAddPoints)
	if typeof(sequence) ~= "ColorSequence" then
		return sequence
	end
	local keypoints = sequence.Keypoints
	local points = table.create(#keypoints)
	for index, keypoint in ipairs(keypoints) do
		local color = keypoint.Value
		points[index] = { keypoint.Time, color.R, color.G, color.B }
	end

	local most = mayAddPoints and MOST_KEYPOINTS or #points
	local shifted = ColorMath.shiftGradient(points, hue, saturation, value, most)
	local result = table.create(#shifted)
	for index, point in ipairs(shifted) do
		result[index] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], Color3.new(point[2], point[3], point[4]))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(result)
end

function HueShift.shiftColor(color, hue, saturation, value)
	return Color3.new(ColorMath.shift(color.R, color.G, color.B, hue, saturation, value))
end

-- A colour whose keypoints carry bezier handles keeps its keypoints: the handles are stored by
-- keypoint index.
local function hasHandles(snapshot, propertyName)
	local handles = snapshot._bezierHandles
	return handles ~= nil and handles[propertyName .. "_BezierHandles"] ~= nil
end

function HueShift.applyToSnapshots(snapshots, hue, saturation, value)
	for item, snapshot in pairs(snapshots) do
		if not item.Parent then
			continue
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local original = snapshot._peColor
			if typeof(original) == "ColorSequence" then
				local mayAdd = not hasHandles(snapshot, "Color")
				pcall(function()
					item.Color = HueShift.shiftColorSequence(original, hue, saturation, value, mayAdd)
				end)
			end
		else
			-- Every ColorSequence of the snapshot is shifted, whatever the property is called:
			-- Color, TintColor, FillColor, ImageColor3 and the rest, with no list to keep in step.
			for propertyName, original in pairs(snapshot) do
				if typeof(original) == "ColorSequence" then
					local mayAdd = not hasHandles(snapshot, propertyName)
					TypeRegistry.write(item, propertyName, HueShift.shiftColorSequence(original, hue, saturation, value, mayAdd))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function HueShift.applyToBlender(blenderSnapshots, hue, saturation, value)
	for _, states in pairs(blenderSnapshots) do
		for _, state in ipairs(states) do
			if state.config and state.config.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					state.config:SetAttribute("Color", HueShift.shiftColorSequence(state.origColor, hue, saturation, value, false))
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

HueShift.snapshotTints = Tints.collect
HueShift.restoreTints = Tints.restore

function HueShift.applyToTints(tints, hue, saturation, value)
	Tints.apply(tints, function(sequence, mayAddPoints)
		return HueShift.shiftColorSequence(sequence, hue, saturation, value, mayAddPoints)
	end, function(color)
		return HueShift.shiftColor(color, hue, saturation, value)
	end)
end

return HueShift

--[[
	HueShift/ColorMath  -  the Hue tool's colour maths on plain numbers (sRGB channels 0 to 1), so it
	runs outside Roblox too.
	  ColorMath.shift(r, g, b, hueTurns, saturationShift, valueShift, greyHue) -> r, g, b
	    HSV shifts, as the colour picker uses. A hue turn alone keeps saturation and value, so a
	    full-strength colour stays full at every angle. A grey has no hue to turn, so saturation
	    colours it with `greyHue` when given, else with red turned by hueTurns.
	  ColorMath.shiftGradient(points, hueTurns, saturationShift, valueShift, mostPoints) -> points
	    points = { { time, r, g, b }, ... } in time order, blended linearly in RGB as a ColorSequence
	    is. Shifting the points alone lets the blend drift from the shifted original, so points are
	    added where it drifts most, until within TOLERANCE or at `mostPoints`. A grey point takes the
	    hue of the nearest coloured point, so a white-to-red fire gains no pink end.
]]

local ColorMath = {}

-- Channels closer together than this make a grey: half a step of 255.
local GREY_RANGE = 0.5 / 255
-- Largest channel difference a blend may have from the shifted original (about 3 of 255).
local TOLERANCE = 0.012
-- No stretch shorter than twice this is split.
local LEAST_SPAN = 0.01
-- Where along a stretch the blend is compared with the shifted original.
local PROBES = { 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 }

local function clamp01(value)
	return math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
end

local function toHsv(r, g, b)
	local highest = math.max(r, g, b)
	local range = highest - math.min(r, g, b)
	if range <= 0 then
		return 0, 0, highest
	end
	local hue
	if highest == r then
		hue = ((g - b) / range) % 6
	elseif highest == g then
		hue = (b - r) / range + 2
	else
		hue = (r - g) / range + 4
	end
	return hue / 6, range / highest, highest
end

local function fromHsv(hue, saturation, value)
	local sector = (hue % 1) * 6
	local index = math.floor(sector)
	local within = sector - index
	local low = value * (1 - saturation)
	local falling = value * (1 - saturation * within)
	local rising = value * (1 - saturation * (1 - within))
	if index == 0 then
		return value, rising, low
	elseif index == 1 then
		return falling, value, low
	elseif index == 2 then
		return low, value, rising
	elseif index == 3 then
		return low, falling, value
	elseif index == 4 then
		return rising, low, value
	end
	return value, low, falling
end

local function isGrey(r, g, b)
	return math.max(r, g, b) - math.min(r, g, b) < GREY_RANGE
end

function ColorMath.shift(r, g, b, hueTurns, saturationShift, valueShift, greyHue)
	local grey = isGrey(r, g, b)
	local turned = hueTurns ~= 0 and not grey
	if not turned and saturationShift == 0 and valueShift == 0 then
		return r, g, b
	end
	local hue, saturation, value = toHsv(r, g, b)
	if grey then
		hue = greyHue or (hueTurns % 1)
	else
		hue = hue + hueTurns
	end
	return fromHsv(hue, clamp01(saturation + saturationShift), clamp01(value + valueShift))
end

-- The gradient `points` at `time`: a linear blend of the two points around it.
local function sample(points, time)
	local last = #points
	if time <= points[1][1] then
		return points[1][2], points[1][3], points[1][4]
	end
	for index = 2, last do
		local after = points[index]
		if time <= after[1] then
			local before = points[index - 1]
			local span = after[1] - before[1]
			local share = span > 0 and (time - before[1]) / span or 0
			return before[2] + (after[2] - before[2]) * share,
				before[3] + (after[3] - before[3]) * share,
				before[4] + (after[4] - before[4]) * share
		end
	end
	return points[last][2], points[last][3], points[last][4]
end

function ColorMath.shiftGradient(points, hueTurns, saturationShift, valueShift, mostPoints)
	-- The turned hue of every coloured point. A grey of this gradient borrows the nearest one;
	-- a gradient of greys alone has none, and its greys are coloured from red by the hue shift.
	local coloured = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do
		if not isGrey(point[2], point[3], point[4]) then
			local hue = toHsv(point[2], point[3], point[4])
			table.insert(coloured, { time = point[1], hue = (hue + hueTurns) % 1 })
		end
	end
	local function greyHueAt(time)
		local nearest = nil
		for _, entry in ipairs(coloured) do
			if nearest == nil or math.abs(entry.time - time) < math.abs(nearest.time - time) then
				nearest = entry
			end
		end
		return nearest and nearest.hue or nil
	end

	local function shifted(time, r, g, b)
		local red, green, blue = ColorMath.shift(r, g, b, hueTurns, saturationShift, valueShift, greyHueAt(time))
		return { time, red, green, blue }
	end

	local result = {}
	for index, point in ipairs(points) do
		result[index] = shifted(point[1], point[2], point[3], point[4])
	end

	-- Where the blend over the stretch after result[index] is furthest from the shifted original,
	-- looked for at its quarter points, and the point that would correct it. Worked out once per
	-- stretch: a split only changes its own two halves.
	local function candidate(index)
		local before = result[index]
		local after = result[index + 1]
		local span = after[1] - before[1]
		if span < LEAST_SPAN * 2 then
			return nil
		end
		local best = nil
		for _, share in ipairs(PROBES) do
			local time = before[1] + span * share
			local exact = shifted(time, sample(points, time))
			local drift = math.max(
				math.abs(exact[2] - (before[2] + (after[2] - before[2]) * share)),
				math.abs(exact[3] - (before[3] + (after[3] - before[3]) * share)),
				math.abs(exact[4] - (before[4] + (after[4] - before[4]) * share))
			)
			if best == nil or drift > best.drift then
				best = { point = exact, drift = drift }
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local candidates = {}
	for index = 1, #result - 1 do
		candidates[index] = candidate(index) or false
	end
	while #result < mostPoints do
		local worst = nil
		for index, entry in ipairs(candidates) do
			if entry and entry.drift > TOLERANCE and (worst == nil or entry.drift > candidates[worst].drift) then
				worst = index
			end
		end
		if not worst then
			break
		end
		table.insert(result, worst + 1, candidates[worst].point)
		candidates[worst] = candidate(worst) or false
		table.insert(candidates, worst + 1, candidate(worst + 1) or false)
	end
	return result
end

return ColorMath

--[[
	HueShift/Tints  -  the colours of a selection that are not type properties, as a flat list the
	Hue tool can shift and put back:
	  - a transformed Part's decal layers (each Decal / Texture in its RenderTemplate): the LayerColor
	    graph when it has one, and its Color3 (Part/DecalLayers reads the graph, else the Color3)
	  - plain Highlights (never transformed): FillColor and OutlineColor, selected or anywhere under
	    a transformed item
	  Tints.collect(items, highlights) -> tints
	  Tints.apply(tints, shiftSequence, shiftColor)   writes every tint shifted from its original
	  Tints.restore(tints)                            writes the originals back
	A tint is { instance, attribute | property, original, mayAddPoints }.
	Mutates the LIVE decals and Highlights (a RenderTemplate is the item's source, not a clone).
	A Highlight under a nested transformed item is left to that item's own entry.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry)

local TEMPLATE_NAME = "RenderTemplate"
local LAYER_COLOR = "LayerColor"
-- Bezier handles of a layer graph are stored on its decal, as the graph is (PopulateDecals); a
-- colour that has them keeps its keypoints, because handles are indexed by keypoint.
local LAYER_COLOR_HANDLES = LAYER_COLOR .. "_BezierHandles"

local Tints = {}

local function isPlainHighlight(instance)
	return instance:IsA("Highlight") and instance:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME) == nil
end

local function addHighlight(tints, seen, highlight)
	if seen[highlight] then
		return
	end
	seen[highlight] = true
	table.insert(tints, { instance = highlight, property = "FillColor", original = highlight.FillColor })
	table.insert(tints, { instance = highlight, property = "OutlineColor", original = highlight.OutlineColor })
end

-- Plain Highlights anywhere under `parent`, without entering a nested transformed item.
local function addHighlightsUnder(tints, seen, parent)
	for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			continue
		end
		if isPlainHighlight(child) then
			addHighlight(tints, seen, child)
		end
		addHighlightsUnder(tints, seen, child)
	end
end

local function addDecalLayers(tints, item, template)
	for _, child in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then
			local graph = child:GetAttribute(LAYER_COLOR)
			if typeof(graph) == "ColorSequence" then
				local hasHandles = child:GetAttribute(LAYER_COLOR_HANDLES) ~= nil
				table.insert(tints, { instance = child, attribute = LAYER_COLOR, original = graph, mayAddPoints = not hasHandles })
			end
			table.insert(tints, { instance = child, property = "Color3", original = child.Color3 })
		end
	end
end

function Tints.collect(items, highlights)
	local tints = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		local template = item:FindFirstChild(TEMPLATE_NAME)
		if template and item:IsA("BasePart") then
			addDecalLayers(tints, item, template)
		end
		addHighlightsUnder(tints, seen, item)
	end
	for _, highlight in ipairs(highlights) do
		if isPlainHighlight(highlight) then
			addHighlight(tints, seen, highlight)
		end
	end
	return tints
end

local function write(tint, value)
	local instance = tint.instance
	if not instance.Parent then
		return
	end
	if tint.attribute then
		instance:SetAttribute(tint.attribute, value)
	else
		instance[tint.property] = value
	end
end

function Tints.apply(tints, shiftSequence, shiftColor)
	for _, tint in ipairs(tints) do
		if tint.attribute then
			write(tint, shiftSequence(tint.original, tint.mayAddPoints))
		else
			write(tint, shiftColor(tint.original))
		end
	end
end

function Tints.restore(tints)
	for _, tint in ipairs(tints) do
		write(tint, tint.original)
	end
end

return Tints

--[[
	InventoryAutosave  -  every AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL seconds, when the local inventory changed, shows a
	countdown banner (Now / Skip), then writes the export into ServerStorage._PartIclesInventoryAutosave
	(tagged ExportPart_Icle, which Import scans for). The explicit-save backup is untouched. Ends when
	the plugin ScreenGui is destroyed.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Part.Log)

local AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL = 30 * 60
local COUNTDOWN = 30
local MODULE_NAME = "_PartIclesInventoryAutosave"
local HASH_YIELD_EVERY = 200000

return function(ctx, deps)
	local LocalInventoryData = deps.LocalInventoryData
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local lastHash = nil

	local function alive()
		return ctx.UI ~= nil and ctx.UI.ScreenGui ~= nil and ctx.UI.ScreenGui.Parent ~= nil
	end

	-- FNV-1a over the export text, yielding periodically so a large inventory never hitches a frame.
	local function hashOf(text)
		local h = 2166136261
		for i = 1, #text do
			h = bit32.bxor(h, string.byte(text, i))
			h = (h * 16777619) % 4294967296
			if i % HASH_YIELD_EVERY == 0 then task.wait() end
		end
		return #text .. ":" .. h
	end

	-- Same shape the Export button produces: plain JSON when it fits, else the PICZ: compressed form.
	local function exportText(json)
		if #json <= LocalInventoryData.getMaxTextbox() then return json end
		return LocalInventoryData.compressExport(json)
	end

	local function writeModule(text)
		local serverStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		local mod = serverStorage:FindFirstChild(MODULE_NAME)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Inventory Autosave")
		if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
			if mod then mod.Parent = nil end
			mod = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
			mod.Name = MODULE_NAME
			mod:SetAttribute("ExportPart_Icle", true)
		end
		-- A fresh write is importable again by everyone (Import stamps UsedBy_<uid> after a read).
		for name in pairs(mod:GetAttributes()) do
			if string.sub(name, 1, 7) == "UsedBy_" then mod:SetAttribute(name, nil) end
		end
		mod.Source = text
		mod.Parent = serverStorage
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Inventory Autosave")
	end

	-- Non-modal top banner with a countdown; resolves true (save) or false (skip).
	local function prompt()
		local coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
		local existing = coreGui:FindFirstChild("PartIclesAutosave")
		if existing then existing:Destroy() end
		local banner = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		banner.Name = "PartIclesAutosave"
		banner.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		banner.Parent = coreGui
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 50, 20)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame.Parent = banner
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 1, 0)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextSize = 12
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.Parent = frame
		local decision = nil
		local function makeButton(text, x, value)
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			btn.Text = text
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 160)
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			btn.TextSize = 11
			btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 1, 0)
			btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0, 0)
			btn.Parent = frame
			btn.Activated:Connect(function() decision = value end)
		end
		makeButton("Now", -140, true)
		makeButton("Skip", -70, false)
		local deadline = os.clock() + COUNTDOWN
		while decision == nil and alive() do
			local left = math.max(0, math.ceil(deadline - os.clock()))
			label.Text = ("Part-Icles: autosaving the local inventory to ServerStorage in %ds"):format(left)
			if left <= 0 then decision = true end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		banner:Destroy()
		return decision == true
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local baseline = LocalInventoryData.exportJSON()
		lastHash = hashOf(baseline)
		while alive() do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL)
			if not alive() then break end
			local json = LocalInventoryData.exportJSON()
			local currentHash = hashOf(json)
			if currentHash ~= lastHash and json ~= "{}" then
				if prompt() and alive() then
					local ok, err = pcall(writeModule, exportText(json))
					if ok then
						lastHash = currentHash
					else
						Log.warn("[Part-Icles] inventory autosave failed: " .. tostring(err))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

--[[
	Loads the texture, flipbook and asset library from GitHub, caches it, and answers searches,
	filters, favourites and recents. No UI.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Part.Log)

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local VFX_DATA_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwinkleTee/QP2-Public-Assets/main/QP2_TextureLibrary.json"
local FLIPBOOK_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwinkleTee/QP2-Public-Assets/main/MeshFlipbooksLibrary.json"
local ASSETS_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwinkleTee/QP2-Public-Assets/main/assets.json"
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local MAX_RECENTS = 20

-- The library's categories (the upstream JSON's keywords) in the groups a VFX artist reaches for
-- first. The texture grid and the Filters menu follow this order; a new category sorts after.
local CATEGORY_GROUPS = {
	{ name = "Shockwaves", children = { "Impact", "Circle", "Crescents", "Spiral", "Slash" } },
	{ name = "Specs / Wisps", children = { "Wisp", "Star", "Rays", "Beam", "Misc" } },
	{ name = "Elements", children = { "Fire", "Smoke", "Water", "Wind", "Ground", "Lightning", "Aura" } },
	{ name = "Symbols", children = { "Abstract", "Text", "Grids", "UI", "Other" } },
}

-- Category -> its place in that order.
local CATEGORY_RANK = {}
do
	local rank = 0
	for _, group in ipairs(CATEGORY_GROUPS) do
		for _, category in ipairs(group.children) do
			rank += 1
			CATEGORY_RANK[category] = rank
		end
	end
end
local UNRANKED = math.huge

local InventoryData = {}

local _cache = nil -- {array = {}, categories = {}, map = {}}
local _flipbookCache = nil -- array of {name, textures, _type="meshflipbook", _search}
local _assetCache = nil -- array of {name, data, className, keywords, _type="asset", _search}
local _favourites = {} -- set: {[id] = true}
local _recents = {} -- ordered list, newest first
local _plugin = nil
local _loadStatus = "idle" -- "idle" | "loading" | "loaded" | "error"
local _loadError = nil
local _onStatusChange = nil


-- Favourites and recents are saved as a JSON array (a name may hold a comma); a comma-separated
-- value is still read.
function InventoryData.init(pluginRef)
	_plugin = pluginRef
	local saved = _plugin:GetSetting("InventoryFavourites")
	if saved and type(saved) == "string" and saved ~= "" then
		local ok, parsed = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(saved) end)
		if ok and typeof(parsed) == "table" then
			for _, id in ipairs(parsed) do
				if type(id) == "string" or type(id) == "number" then
					local s = tostring(id); if s ~= "" then _favourites[s] = true end
				end
			end
		else
			for id in saved:gmatch("[^,]+") do
				local trimmed = id:match("^%s*(.+)%s*$")
				if trimmed ~= "" then _favourites[trimmed] = true end
			end
		end
	end
	local savedRecents = _plugin:GetSetting("InventoryRecents")
	if savedRecents and type(savedRecents) == "string" and savedRecents ~= "" then
		local ok, parsed = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(savedRecents) end)
		if ok and typeof(parsed) == "table" then
			for _, id in ipairs(parsed) do
				if type(id) == "string" or type(id) == "number" then
					local s = tostring(id); if s ~= "" then table.insert(_recents, s) end
				end
			end
		else
			for id in savedRecents:gmatch("[^,]+") do
				local trimmed = id:match("^%s*(.+)%s*$")
				if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(_recents, trimmed) end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function notifyStatus()
	if _onStatusChange then _onStatusChange(_loadStatus, _loadError) end
end

function InventoryData.load()
	if _cache and #_cache.array > 0 then _loadStatus = "loaded"; return true end
	_loadStatus = "loading"; _loadError = nil; notifyStatus()

	local response
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:GetAsync(VFX_DATA_URL)
		end)
		if success then response = result; break end
		_loadError = tostring(result)
		if _loadError:lower():find("permission denied") then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles Inventory] HttpService permission needed. Go to Plugins > Manage Plugins and grant permission.")
			break -- No point retrying permission errors
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles Inventory] Fetch attempt " .. attempt .. " failed, retrying...")
			task.wait(2 ^ (attempt - 1))
		end
	end

	if not response then
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles Inventory] Failed to fetch texture data:", _loadError)
		_cache = { array = {}, categories = {}, map = {} }
		_loadStatus = "error"; notifyStatus()
		return false
	end

	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(response)
	end)
	if not ok or typeof(data) ~= "table" then
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles Inventory] Failed to decode JSON:", data)
		_cache = { array = {}, categories = {}, map = {} }
		_loadStatus = "error"; _loadError = "JSON decode failed"; notifyStatus()
		return false
	end

	local array = {}
	local catSet = {}
	local map = {}
	for name, entry in pairs(data) do
		local rawId = entry.Id or ""
		local id = rawId:gsub("rbxassetid://", "")
		local item = {
			id = id,
			name = entry.Name or name,
			keywords = entry.Keywords or {},
			grid = entry.Grid,
			resolution = entry.Resolution,
			fps = entry.FPS,
		}
		local parts = { item.name:lower(), item.id }
		for _, kw in ipairs(item.keywords) do
			table.insert(parts, kw:lower())
			catSet[kw] = true
		end
		if item.grid then table.insert(parts, tostring(item.grid) .. "x" .. tostring(item.grid)) end
		item._search = table.concat(parts, " ")
		-- An entry is listed under its first keyword, the one its name starts with.
		item._rank = CATEGORY_RANK[item.keywords[1]] or UNRANKED
		table.insert(array, item)
		map[item.id] = item
	end

	local categories = {}
	for cat in pairs(catSet) do table.insert(categories, cat) end
	table.sort(categories)

	InventoryData._sortArray(array)
	_cache = { array = array, categories = categories, map = map }
	_loadStatus = "loaded"; notifyStatus()
	return true
end

-- Reloads all three caches (textures, flipbooks, assets) for the inventory's Refresh.
function InventoryData.reload()
	_cache = nil; _flipbookCache = nil; _assetCache = nil
	_loadStatus = "idle"; _loadError = nil
	InventoryData.loadFlipbooks()
	InventoryData.loadAssets()
	return InventoryData.load()
end

function InventoryData.getLoadStatus() return _loadStatus, _loadError end
function InventoryData.onStatusChange(fn) _onStatusChange = fn end


-- Favourites first, then the library's category order (CATEGORY_GROUPS), then by name.
function InventoryData._sortArray(arr)
	table.sort(arr, function(a, b)
		local aFav = _favourites[a.id] and true or false
		local bFav = _favourites[b.id] and true or false
		if aFav ~= bFav then return aFav end
		local aRank = a._rank or UNRANKED
		local bRank = b._rank or UNRANKED
		if aRank ~= bRank then return aRank < bRank end
		return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
	end)
end


function InventoryData.getAll()
	if not _cache then return {} end
	return _cache.array
end

function InventoryData.getCategories()
	if not _cache then return {} end
	return _cache.categories
end

function InventoryData.getEntry(id)
	if not _cache then return nil end
	return _cache.map[tostring(id)]
end

function InventoryData.getCount()
	if not _cache then return 0 end
	return #_cache.array
end

-- The categories in CATEGORY_GROUPS' groups; any other falls into "Other".
function InventoryData.getGroupedCategories()
	if not _cache then return {} end
	local groups = {}
	local assigned = {}
	for _, groupDef in ipairs(CATEGORY_GROUPS) do
		local matched = {}
		for _, kw in ipairs(groupDef.children) do
			for _, cat in ipairs(_cache.categories) do
				if cat == kw then table.insert(matched, cat); assigned[cat] = true end
			end
		end
		if #matched > 0 then table.insert(groups, { name = groupDef.name, children = matched }) end
	end
	local other = {}
	for _, cat in ipairs(_cache.categories) do
		if not assigned[cat] then table.insert(other, cat) end
	end
	if #other > 0 then table.insert(groups, { name = "Other", children = other }) end
	return groups
end

-- tab: "All" | "Static" | "Flipbook" | "Favourites". categories: nil for all, or a set
-- {[name] = true}; an entry matches any of them. query: words that must all appear.
function InventoryData.search(query, categories, tab)
	if not _cache then return {} end

	local results = {}
	local q = query and query:lower():match("^%s*(.+)%s*$") or ""
	local hasFilter = categories and next(categories) ~= nil

	for _, item in ipairs(_cache.array) do
		if tab == "Static" and item.grid then continue end
		if tab == "Flipbook" and not item.grid then continue end
		if tab == "Favourites" and not _favourites[item.id] then continue end

		if hasFilter then
			local found = false
			for _, kw in ipairs(item.keywords) do
				if categories[kw] then found = true; break end
			end
			if not found then continue end
		end

		if q ~= "" then local miss = false
			for token in q:gmatch("%S+") do if not item._search:find(token, 1, true) then miss = true; break end end
			if miss then continue end
		end

		table.insert(results, item)
	end

	return results
end


function InventoryData.isFavourite(id)
	return _favourites[tostring(id)] == true
end

function InventoryData.toggleFavourite(id)
	id = tostring(id)
	if _favourites[id] then _favourites[id] = nil else _favourites[id] = true end
	if _plugin then
		local ids = {}
		for fid in pairs(_favourites) do table.insert(ids, fid) end
		_plugin:SetSetting("InventoryFavourites", HttpService:JSONEncode(ids))
	end
	if _cache then InventoryData._sortArray(_cache.array) end
end

function InventoryData.getFavouriteCount()
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(_favourites) do n = n + 1 end
	return n
end


function InventoryData.addRecent(id)
	id = tostring(id)
	for i, rid in ipairs(_recents) do
		if rid == id then table.remove(_recents, i); break end
	end
	table.insert(_recents, 1, id)
	while #_recents > MAX_RECENTS do table.remove(_recents) end
	if _plugin then
		_plugin:SetSetting("InventoryRecents", HttpService:JSONEncode(_recents))
	end
end

function InventoryData.getRecents()
	local results = {}
	for _, id in ipairs(_recents) do
		-- Textures first, then flipbooks, then assets by name.
		local entry = _cache and _cache.map[id]
		if not entry and _flipbookCache then
			for _, fb in ipairs(_flipbookCache) do if fb.name == id then entry = fb; break end end
		end
		if not entry and _assetCache then
			for _, asset in ipairs(_assetCache) do if asset.name == id then entry = asset; break end end
		end
		if entry then table.insert(results, entry) end
	end
	return results
end

function InventoryData.getRecentCount()
	return #_recents
end

-- Only a filled cache returns early: after a failed first fetch the next call fetches again.
function InventoryData.loadFlipbooks()
	if _flipbookCache and #_flipbookCache > 0 then return true end
	local response
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:GetAsync(FLIPBOOK_URL) end)
		if ok then response = result; break end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then task.wait(2 ^ (attempt - 1)) end
	end
	if not response then _flipbookCache = {}; return false end
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response) end)
	if not ok or typeof(data) ~= "table" then _flipbookCache = {}; return false end
	local entries = data.flipbooks or data -- {flipbooks = [...]} or a bare array
	local arr = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		if entry.name and entry.textures then
			table.insert(arr, { name = entry.name, textures = entry.textures,
				_type = "meshflipbook", _search = entry.name:lower() })
		end
	end
	table.sort(arr, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a.name) or 0) < (tonumber(b.name) or 0) end)
	_flipbookCache = arr; return true
end

function InventoryData.searchFlipbooks(query)
	if not _flipbookCache then return {} end
	local q = query and query:lower():match("^%s*(.+)%s*$") or ""
	if q == "" then return _flipbookCache end
	local results = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(_flipbookCache) do
		local miss = false
		for token in q:gmatch("%S+") do if not item._search:find(token, 1, true) then miss = true; break end end
		if not miss then results[#results+1] = item end
	end
	return results
end

function InventoryData.getFlipbookCount() return _flipbookCache and #_flipbookCache or 0 end

-- Like loadFlipbooks: only a filled cache returns early.
function InventoryData.loadAssets()
	if _assetCache and #_assetCache > 0 then return true end
	local response
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:GetAsync(ASSETS_URL) end)
		if ok then response = result; break end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then task.wait(2 ^ (attempt - 1)) end
	end
	if not response then _assetCache = {}; return false end
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response) end)
	if not ok or typeof(data) ~= "table" then _assetCache = {}; return false end
	local arr = {}
	-- { assets = [{name, data, className}, ...] } or a bare array
	local assetList = data.assets or data
	if typeof(assetList) == "table" then
		for _, entry in ipairs(assetList) do
			if entry.name and entry.data then
				table.insert(arr, {
					name = entry.name, data = entry.data, className = entry.className or "Instance",
					_type = "asset", _search = (entry.name .. " " .. (entry.className or "")):lower(),
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(arr, function(a, b) return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end)
	_assetCache = arr; return true
end

function InventoryData.searchAssets(query)
	if not _assetCache then return {} end
	local q = query and query:lower():match("^%s*(.+)%s*$") or ""
	if q == "" then return _assetCache end
	local results = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(_assetCache) do
		local miss = false
		for token in q:gmatch("%S+") do if not item._search:find(token, 1, true) then miss = true; break end end
		if not miss then results[#results+1] = item end
	end
	return results
end

function InventoryData.getAssetCache() return _assetCache or {} end
function InventoryData.getAssetCount() return _assetCache and #_assetCache or 0 end

return InventoryData

--[[
	Leftovers  -  removes what a plugin instance that ended without its teardown left behind.
	Studio aborts a plugin.Unloading handler at its first yield, and with deferred signals may not
	run it at all, so a reloaded plugin can leave unsaved helpers for the next one to clear.
	  Leftovers.sweep(camera, guiHost) -> how many were removed
	setup (init.server.lua) calls it before it builds anything. It removes the viewport helper
	folders under the camera (ForceGizmo, MotionPreview) and the texture pin guis in the gui host
	(Part/TexturePin). A runtime required from the command bar loses its pins.
	Mutates: unsaved instances of those classes and names only. A saved one is somebody else's.
]]

local Leftovers = {}

local HELPER_FOLDERS = { ForceGizmo = true, MotionPreview = true }
local PIN_GUI = "PartIclesTexturePin"

-- Destroys the unsaved children of `parent` that `isOurs` picks; returns how many.
local function removeFrom(parent, isOurs)
	if not parent then
		return 0
	end
	local removed = 0
	for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if not child.Archivable and isOurs(child) then
			child:Destroy()
			removed += 1
		end
	end
	return removed
end

function Leftovers.sweep(camera, guiHost)
	local folders = removeFrom(camera, function(child)
		return child:IsA("Folder") and HELPER_FOLDERS[child.Name] == true
	end)
	local guis = removeFrom(guiHost, function(child)
		return child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child.Name == PIN_GUI
	end)
	return folders + guis
end

return Leftovers

--[[
	The user's own filters of the local texture list: each a name and the ids of the textures put in
	it, listed in the Inventory's Filters menu after Favourites. No UI and no Roblox API.
	LocalInventoryData saves them under the JSON key "filters" as { { name, items = { "123", ... } }, ... }.
	  LocalFilters.names() -> { name, ... }           in the order they were made
	  LocalFilters.create(name) -> name | nil         trimmed; nil when empty, reserved or taken
	  LocalFilters.rename(old, new) -> name | nil
	  LocalFilters.remove(name) -> boolean            its textures stay in the inventory
	  LocalFilters.add(name, ids) -> number           how many were not in it yet
	  LocalFilters.take(name, ids) -> number          how many were taken out
	  LocalFilters.has(name, id) / LocalFilters.count(name)
	  LocalFilters.holdsAll(name, ids) -> boolean     false for no ids
	    LocalFilters.passes(active, id) -> boolean      active: the names ticked in the menu; true when
	                                                    none is a filter here, or the id is in one
	  LocalFilters.forget(id)                         a texture left the inventory; the caller saves
	  LocalFilters.serializeForSave() / loadFromSave(list)
	  LocalFilters.exportFor(ids) -> list             only the filters and items among those ids
	  LocalFilters.importList(list, known) -> number  merges by name; known(id) says the texture exists
]]

local LocalFilters = {}

LocalFilters.MAX_NAME = 24

-- Options the Filters menu already has under these names.
local RESERVED = { all = true, favourites = true }

-- { { name = string, items = { [id] = true }, size = number }, ... }
local _filters = {}
local _hooks = {
	change = function(fn, ...) return fn(...) end,
	save = function() end,
}

-- LocalInventoryData binds { change, save }: every change runs through `change`, which lays it on top
-- of what another Studio window saved.
function LocalFilters.bind(hooks)
	for key, hook in pairs(hooks) do
		_hooks[key] = hook
	end
end

local function clean(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local trimmed = string.match(name, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if trimmed == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return string.sub(trimmed, 1, LocalFilters.MAX_NAME)
end

local function find(name)
	local wanted = string.lower(name)
	for index, filter in ipairs(_filters) do
		if string.lower(filter.name) == wanted then
			return filter, index
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function LocalFilters.names()
	local names = table.create(#_filters)
	for index, filter in ipairs(_filters) do
		names[index] = filter.name
	end
	return names
end

local function make(name)
	local cleaned = clean(name)
	if not cleaned or RESERVED[string.lower(cleaned)] or find(cleaned) then
		return nil
	end
	local filter = { name = cleaned, items = {}, size = 0 }
	table.insert(_filters, filter)
	return filter
end

local function create(name)
	local filter = make(name)
	if not filter then
		return nil
	end
	_hooks.save()
	return filter.name
end
function LocalFilters.create(...) return _hooks.change(create, ...) end

local function rename(oldName, newName)
	local filter = find(oldName)
	local cleaned = clean(newName)
	if not filter or not cleaned or RESERVED[string.lower(cleaned)] then
		return nil
	end
	local taken = find(cleaned)
	if taken and taken ~= filter then
		return nil
	end
	filter.name = cleaned
	_hooks.save()
	return cleaned
end
function LocalFilters.rename(...) return _hooks.change(rename, ...) end

local function remove(name)
	local _, index = find(name)
	if not index then
		return false
	end
	table.remove(_filters, index)
	_hooks.save()
	return true
end
function LocalFilters.remove(...) return _hooks.change(remove, ...) end

local function put(filter, id)
	local key = tostring(id)
	if filter.items[key] then
		return false
	end
	filter.items[key] = true
	filter.size += 1
	return true
end

local function add(name, ids)
	local filter = find(name)
	if not filter then
		return 0
	end
	local added = 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		if put(filter, id) then
			added += 1
		end
	end
	if added > 0 then
		_hooks.save()
	end
	return added
end
function LocalFilters.add(...) return _hooks.change(add, ...) end

local function take(name, ids)
	local filter = find(name)
	if not filter then
		return 0
	end
	local taken = 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		local key = tostring(id)
		if filter.items[key] then
			filter.items[key] = nil
			filter.size -= 1
			taken += 1
		end
	end
	if taken > 0 then
		_hooks.save()
	end
	return taken
end
function LocalFilters.take(...) return _hooks.change(take, ...) end

function LocalFilters.has(name, id)
	local filter = find(name)
	return filter ~= nil and filter.items[tostring(id)] == true
end

function LocalFilters.count(name)
	local filter = find(name)
	return filter and filter.size or 0
end

function LocalFilters.holdsAll(name, ids)
	local filter = find(name)
	if not filter or #ids == 0 then
		return false
	end
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		if not filter.items[tostring(id)] then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function LocalFilters.passes(active, id)
	local key = tostring(id)
	local narrowed = false
	for _, filter in ipairs(_filters) do
		if active[filter.name] then
			if filter.items[key] then
				return true
			end
			narrowed = true
		end
	end
	return not narrowed
end

function LocalFilters.forget(id)
	local key = tostring(id)
	for _, filter in ipairs(_filters) do
		if filter.items[key] then
			filter.items[key] = nil
			filter.size -= 1
		end
	end
end

-- Items in a steady order, so an unchanged inventory saves to the same text.
local function serialize(filter, wanted)
	local items = {}
	for key in pairs(filter.items) do
		if wanted == nil or wanted[key] then
			table.insert(items, key)
		end
	end
	table.sort(items)
	return { name = filter.name, items = items }
end

function LocalFilters.serializeForSave()
	local list = table.create(#_filters)
	for index, filter in ipairs(_filters) do
		list[index] = serialize(filter, nil)
	end
	return list
end

function LocalFilters.exportFor(ids)
	local wanted = {}
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		wanted[tostring(id)] = true
	end
	local list = {}
	for _, filter in ipairs(_filters) do
		local saved = serialize(filter, wanted)
		if #saved.items > 0 then
			table.insert(list, saved)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Adds what `list` holds to the filters here; makes no save of its own.
local function merge(list, known)
	local added = 0
	if type(list) ~= "table" then
		return added
	end
	for _, saved in ipairs(list) do
		if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.items) == "table" then
			local cleaned = clean(saved.name)
			local filter = cleaned and (find(cleaned) or make(cleaned))
			if filter then
				for _, id in ipairs(saved.items) do
					if (known == nil or known(tostring(id))) and put(filter, id) then
						added += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return added
end

function LocalFilters.loadFromSave(list)
	_filters = {}
	merge(list, nil)
end

local function importList(list, known)
	local added = merge(list, known)
	_hooks.save()
	return added
end
function LocalFilters.importList(...) return _hooks.change(importList, ...) end

return LocalFilters
