--[[
	The user's local textures, flipbooks, serialized assets and mesh frame sets, saved as JSON in a
	plugin setting with a ServerStorage backup. LocalMeshFrames owns the mesh frame list (key
	"meshframes") and LocalFilters the texture filters (key "filters"); both are saved here. No UI.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Part.Log)
local LocalMeshFrames = require(script.Parent.LocalMeshFrames)
local LocalFilters = require(script.Parent.LocalFilters)

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SS = game:GetService("SerializationService")
local ES = game:GetService("EncodingService")

local LocalInventoryData = {}

local _plugin = nil
local _textures = {} -- { {id, name, grid?, gridRows?}, ... }
local _flipbooks = {} -- { {name, textures={...}}, ... }
local _assets = {} -- { {name, data, className, _type="asset"}, ... }

-- What is kept of a texture's grid: `grid`, its sheet's columns, and `gridRows` when the sheet
-- is not square. Nothing for what is not a sheet of two frames or more.
local function sheetShape(grid, rows)
	if typeof(grid) ~= "number" then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local columns = math.floor(grid)
	local down = columns
	if typeof(rows) == "number" then
		down = math.floor(rows)
	end
	if columns < 1 or down < 1 or columns * down < 2 then
		return nil, nil
	end
	if down == columns then
		return columns, nil
	end
	return columns, down
end


local BACKUP_NAME = "_PartIclesInventoryBackup"
local SETTING = "LocalInventory"
-- Names this settings store, so a place's backup it wrote is known as its own (_choose).
local OWNER_SETTING = "LocalInventoryOwner"
-- Older plugins set this around a save; the stored text decides which copy is newest instead.
local OLD_PENDING = "LocalInventory_Pending"
-- Another window writing can make a read come back nil for a moment (Plugin:GetSetting).
local READ_TRIES = 3
local READ_RETRY_SECONDS = 0.2
local RECHECK_SECONDS = 2
local WRITE_RETRY_SECONDS = 0.5
-- How often a save beaten by another window's is laid again on top of it.
local RELAY_TRIES = 2

-- Every Studio window runs its own copy of the plugin, each holding the whole list, and they share
-- the stored copy ("multiple instances of the same plugin can run simultaneously", Plugin:GetSetting).
-- A change first takes a copy another window stored since (its text is not the one this window last
-- read or wrote, and it is not older), then saves on top of it with the next revision, at least the
-- time in seconds, so windows that never read each other's copies still compare. The changes made
-- inside a batch, and the one behind a save, are kept as calls, so they can be laid again on a copy
-- another window stored meanwhile.
local _seenJson = nil -- the stored text this window last read or wrote
local _seenRevision = -1 -- its revision; -1: none
local _storedSeen = false -- the stored copy itself was read or written, not only a backup
local _owner = nil -- this settings store's name (OWNER_SETTING)
local _batches = {} -- [thread] = how many batches it has open
local _batchOps = {} -- the changes made inside the open batches: { fn, args }
local _threadOps = {} -- [thread] = the change it runs now; the changes that one calls are part of it
local _replaying = false -- laying changes again: one save after them all

local function _saveBackup(json)
	-- A backup ModuleScript in ServerStorage, so the data survives the plugin being replaced.
	local ss = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local existing = ss:FindFirstChild(BACKUP_NAME)
	if not existing then
		existing = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
		existing.Name = BACKUP_NAME
		existing.Parent = ss
	end
	existing.Source = "return " .. string.format("%q", json)
end

-- Decodes the `return "<json>"` text _saveBackup writes, reversing string.format("%q").
-- Returns nil for any other shape, so the backup is read as data and never executed.
local BACKUP_PREFIX = 'return "'
local function _decodeBackupSource(source)
	if #source <= #BACKUP_PREFIX then return nil end
	if string.sub(source, 1, #BACKUP_PREFIX) ~= BACKUP_PREFIX or string.sub(source, -1) ~= '"' then return nil end
	local body = string.sub(source, #BACKUP_PREFIX + 1, -2)
	local pieces = {}
	local index = 1
	while index <= #body do
		local special = string.find(body, '[\\"]', index)
		if not special then
			table.insert(pieces, string.sub(body, index))
			break
		end
		-- A bare quote would end the literal early; anything after it would be code.
		if string.sub(body, special, special) == '"' then return nil end
		table.insert(pieces, string.sub(body, index, special - 1))
		local escaped = string.sub(body, special + 1, special + 1)
		if escaped == "\\" or escaped == '"' or escaped == "\n" then
			table.insert(pieces, escaped)
			index = special + 2
		elseif escaped == "r" then
			table.insert(pieces, "\r")
			index = special + 2
		elseif string.sub(body, special + 1, special + 3) == "000" then
			table.insert(pieces, "\0")
			index = special + 4
		else
			return nil
		end
	end
	return table.concat(pieces)
end

local function _loadBackup()
	local ss = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local mod = ss:FindFirstChild(BACKUP_NAME)
	if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
	local ok, source = pcall(function() return mod.Source end)
	if not ok or type(source) ~= "string" then return nil end
	return _decodeBackupSource(source)
end

-- What a save and an export hold.
local function _snapshot()
	local data = { textures = {}, flipbooks = {}, assets = {}, meshframes = LocalMeshFrames.serializeForSave() }
	data.filters = LocalFilters.serializeForSave()
	for _, t in ipairs(_textures) do local te = { id = t.id, name = t.name }
		if t.grid then te.grid = t.grid; te.gridRows = t.gridRows end; table.insert(data.textures, te) end
	for _, f in ipairs(_flipbooks) do table.insert(data.flipbooks, { name = f.name, textures = f.textures }) end
	for _, a in ipairs(_assets) do local ae = { name = a.name, data = a.data, className = a.className }
		if a.itemCount then ae.itemCount = a.itemCount end
		if a.parentPath then ae.parentPath = a.parentPath end
		if a.paths then ae.paths = a.paths end; table.insert(data.assets, ae) end
	return data
end

local function _revisionOf(data)
	return tonumber(data.revision) or 0
end

local function _decode(json)
	if type(json) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(json) end)
	if ok and typeof(data) == "table" then return data end
	return nil
end

-- A setting's value; a nil is asked again, as it may only be another window writing.
local function _readSetting(key, tries)
	for attempt = 1, tries do
		local ok, value = pcall(function() return _plugin:GetSetting(key) end)
		if ok and value ~= nil then return value end
		if attempt < tries then task.wait(READ_RETRY_SECONDS) end
	end
	return nil
end

local function _readStored(tries)
	local value = _readSetting(SETTING, tries)
	return if type(value) == "string" then value else nil
end

local function _storedIs(json)
	local ok, value = pcall(function() return _plugin:GetSetting(SETTING) end)
	return ok and value == json
end

-- This settings store's name, made the first time a start finds none.
local function _ownerName()
	local value = _readSetting(OWNER_SETTING, 1) or _readSetting(OWNER_SETTING, READ_TRIES)
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		value = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
		pcall(function() _plugin:SetSetting(OWNER_SETTING, value) end)
	end
	return value
end

-- A copy other than this window's last one replaces the lists when an older plugin stored it (no
-- revision) or another window did at this revision or later. Lower: a copy this window's last write
-- should have replaced.
local function _isNewer(data)
	return data.revision == nil or _revisionOf(data) >= _seenRevision
end

-- The copy to start from. This place's backup wins over the stored copy only when this store wrote
-- it (a place is shared in Team Create, a store install keeps its own settings) and it is newer (a
-- write that did not take); a stored copy without a revision is an older plugin's later save.
-- Otherwise a backup counts only when nothing is stored.
local function _choose(stored, backup)
	if stored and backup and stored.revision ~= nil and _owner ~= nil and backup.owner == _owner
		and _revisionOf(backup) > _revisionOf(stored) then
		return backup
	end
	return stored or backup
end

local _buildSearch

-- Replaces the lists with a saved copy's. An entry still there keeps its table, as the open detail and
-- the selection hold it; a table goes to one entry only, as two can share a name. A copy an older
-- plugin stored (no revision) leaves this window's count as it was.
local function _loadData(data)
	local oldTextures, oldFlipbooks, oldAssets = {}, {}, {}
	for _, t in ipairs(_textures) do oldTextures[t.id] = t end
	for _, f in ipairs(_flipbooks) do oldFlipbooks[f.name] = f end
	for _, a in ipairs(_assets) do oldAssets[a.name] = a end
	_textures = {}; _flipbooks = {}; _assets = {}
	if data.textures then
		for _, t in ipairs(data.textures) do
			if t.id then
				local id = tostring(t.id)
				local entry = oldTextures[id] or { isCustom = true }
				oldTextures[id] = nil
				entry.id = id
				entry.name = t.name or id
				entry._search = _buildSearch({ t.name or "", t.id })
				entry.grid, entry.gridRows = sheetShape(t.grid, t.gridRows)
				table.insert(_textures, entry)
			end
		end
	end
	if data.flipbooks then
		for _, f in ipairs(data.flipbooks) do
			if f.name and f.textures and #f.textures > 0 then
				local entry = oldFlipbooks[f.name] or { _type = "meshflipbook" }
				oldFlipbooks[f.name] = nil
				entry.name = f.name
				entry.textures = f.textures
				entry._search = _buildSearch({ f.name, tostring(#f.textures) .. "f" })
				table.insert(_flipbooks, entry)
			end
		end
	end
	if data.assets then
		for _, a in ipairs(data.assets) do
			if a.name and a.data then
				local entry = oldAssets[a.name] or { _type = "asset", isCustom = true }
				oldAssets[a.name] = nil
				entry.name = a.name
				entry.data = a.data
				entry.className = a.className or "Instance"
				entry._search = _buildSearch({ a.name, a.className or "" })
				entry.itemCount = a.itemCount
				entry.parentPath = a.parentPath
				entry.paths = a.paths
				table.insert(_assets, entry)
			end
		end
	end
	LocalMeshFrames.loadFromSave(data.meshframes)
	LocalFilters.loadFromSave(data.filters)
	_seenRevision = if data.revision ~= nil then _revisionOf(data) else math.max(_seenRevision, 0)
end

-- Loads the stored text when another window stored it since; the first stored copy seen is chosen
-- against this place's backup, as at start. Returns whether it loaded.
local function _takeStored(json)
	if json == nil or json == _seenJson then return false end
	local data = _decode(json)
	if not data then return false end
	local take
	if _storedSeen then
		take = _isNewer(data)
	else
		take = _choose(data, _decode(_loadBackup())) == data
	end
	if take then _loadData(data) end
	_seenJson = json
	_storedSeen = true
	return take
end

-- Lays changes made on an older copy again on the lists, with one save after them (the caller's).
local function _replay(ops)
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	local outer = _threadOps[thread]
	_replaying = true
	_threadOps[thread] = ops
	for _, op in ipairs(ops) do
		pcall(op.fn, table.unpack(op.args, 1, op.args.n))
	end
	_threadOps[thread] = outer
	_replaying = false
end

local _finishBatch

-- Drops the batches of threads cancelled inside one (a closed panel, a teardown); whether one is open.
local function _pruneBatches()
	local open = false
	for thread in pairs(_batches) do
		if coroutine.status(thread) == "dead" then
			_batches[thread] = nil
		else
			open = true
		end
	end
	return open
end

-- Whether a batch is open; the last one's thread dead, it ends here as endBatch would have ended it.
local function _batchOpen()
	local had = next(_batches) ~= nil
	local open = _pruneBatches()
	if had and not open then _finishBatch() end
	return open
end

-- Before a change: a copy another window stored since replaces the lists.
local function _syncFromStored()
	if not _plugin or _batchOpen() then return end
	local json = _readStored(READ_TRIES)
	-- A batch that began while the read waited is laid on the newest copy when it ends.
	if _batchOpen() then return end
	_takeStored(json)
end

-- `ops`: the calls that made this change, laid again on a copy another window stores at the same
-- moment. Several windows: see above.
local function _save(ops, relays)
	if not _plugin or _replaying or _batchOpen() then return end
	ops = ops or _threadOps[coroutine.running()] or {}
	relays = relays or 0
	local data = _snapshot()
	local revision = math.max(_seenRevision + 1, os.time())
	data.revision = revision
	data.owner = _owner
	local ok, json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(data) end)
	if not ok then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Failed to encode inventory data"); return end
	-- The setting's size cap is not published (about 1 MB): warn near it.
	if #json > 950000 then
		Log.warn(string.format("[Part-Icles] Inventory near plugin storage limit (%d / ~1MB). Consider exporting + clearing some entries.", #json))
	end
	local setOk, setErr = pcall(function() _plugin:SetSetting(SETTING, json) end)
	if not setOk then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Failed to save inventory: " .. tostring(setErr)) end
	-- The backup write can fail (a read-only place, quotas): warned, as recovery then rests on the setting alone.
	local backupOk, backupErr = pcall(_saveBackup, json)
	if not backupOk then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Failed to save inventory backup: " .. tostring(backupErr)) end
	_seenRevision = revision
	_seenJson = json
	_storedSeen = true
	-- A write can fail without an error while another window writes, or past the size cap
	-- (Plugin:SetSetting); another window may store over it at once. Read back: a copy another window
	-- stored at this revision or later gets this change laid again on it; nothing readable or an older
	-- copy gets this one written once more. Neither working, a warning.
	if _storedIs(json) then return end
	local plugin = _plugin
	task.delay(WRITE_RETRY_SECONDS, function()
		if _plugin ~= plugin or _batchOpen() or _seenJson ~= json then return end
		local current = _readStored(READ_TRIES)
		if _seenJson ~= json or current == json then return end
		local data = _decode(current)
		if data and _isNewer(data) then
			if relays < RELAY_TRIES then
				_takeStored(current)
				_replay(ops)
				_save(ops, relays + 1)
			else
				Log.warn("[Part-Icles] An Inventory change could not be saved: another Studio window kept saving at the same moment. Make the change again.")
			end
			return
		end
		pcall(function() _plugin:SetSetting(SETTING, json) end)
		if not _storedIs(json) then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] The Inventory could not be saved to the plugin's settings (another Studio window was writing, or it is too big). This place's ServerStorage keeps a backup: save the place, or Export the Inventory.")
		end
	end)
end

-- A batch ended: a copy another window stored meanwhile gets the batch's changes laid on it.
function _finishBatch()
	if not _plugin then
		_batchOps = {}
		return
	end
	local json = _readStored(READ_TRIES)
	-- A batch that began while the read waited ends these changes with its own.
	if _pruneBatches() then return end
	local ops = _batchOps
	_batchOps = {}
	if _takeStored(json) then _replay(ops) end
	_save(ops)
end

-- One change to the lists (`fn` saves when it changed something), on top of any copy another window
-- stored; inside a batch it is kept with the batch's changes. The changes `fn` calls are part of it.
local function _change(fn, ...)
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	if _threadOps[thread] then return fn(...) end
	local op = { fn = fn, args = table.pack(...) }
	if not _batchOpen() then
		_syncFromStored()
	end
	-- A batch open now, perhaps since the read above waited, lays this change again when it ends.
	if _batchOpen() then
		table.insert(_batchOps, op)
	end
	_threadOps[thread] = { op }
	local results = table.pack(pcall(fn, ...))
	_threadOps[thread] = nil
	if not results[1] then error(results[2], 0) end
	return table.unpack(results, 2, results.n)
end

local function _changing(fn)
	return function(...) return _change(fn, ...) end
end

-- Brackets a bulk import: changes inside save once, when the last open batch ends.
function LocalInventoryData.beginBatch()
	if not _batchOpen() then _syncFromStored() end
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	_batches[thread] = (_batches[thread] or 0) + 1
end
function LocalInventoryData.endBatch()
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	local count = _batches[thread]
	if not count then return end
	_batches[thread] = if count > 1 then count - 1 else nil
	if not _batchOpen() then _finishBatch() end
end

LocalMeshFrames.bind({ change = _change, save = _save, beginBatch = LocalInventoryData.beginBatch, endBatch = LocalInventoryData.endBatch })
LocalFilters.bind({ change = _change, save = _save })

function _buildSearch(parts)
	local lower = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do table.insert(lower, tostring(p):lower()) end
	return table.concat(lower, " ")
end

function LocalInventoryData.init(pluginRef)
	-- A batch a teardown cancelled (a theme change during an upload) is saved before the lists reload.
	if _plugin and (next(_batches) ~= nil or #_batchOps > 0) then
		_batches = {}
		_finishBatch()
	end
	_plugin = pluginRef
	-- Emptied so a plugin re-toggle does not duplicate entries.
	_textures = {}; _flipbooks = {}; _assets = {}
	LocalMeshFrames.loadFromSave(nil)
	LocalFilters.loadFromSave(nil)
	_seenJson = nil
	_seenRevision = -1
	_storedSeen = false
	_batches = {}
	_batchOps = {}
	_threadOps = {}
	_replaying = false
	_owner = _ownerName()
	if _plugin:GetSetting(OLD_PENDING) ~= nil then
		pcall(function() _plugin:SetSetting(OLD_PENDING, nil) end)
	end
	local storedJson = _readStored(1)
	local stored = _decode(storedJson)
	local backup = _decode(_loadBackup())
	local chosen = _choose(stored, backup)
	if chosen then _loadData(chosen) end
	if chosen and chosen == backup then
		Log.print("[Part-Icles] Restored inventory from this place's backup")
	end
	if stored then
		_seenJson = storedJson
		_storedSeen = true
	else
		-- Nothing read: another window may have been writing at that moment.
		local plugin = _plugin
		task.delay(RECHECK_SECONDS, function()
			if _plugin == plugin and not _storedSeen then _syncFromStored() end
		end)
	end
end

local function _search(list, query)
	if not query or query == "" then return list end
	local q = query:lower():match("^%s*(.+)%s*$"); if q == "" then return list end
	local results = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(list) do local miss = false
		for token in q:gmatch("%S+") do if not item._search:find(token, 1, true) then miss = true; break end end
		if not miss then results[#results+1] = item end
	end; return results
end

LocalInventoryData.addTexture = _changing(function(id, name)
	id = tostring(id):match("%d+"); if not id or id == "" then return false end
	for _, t in ipairs(_textures) do if t.id == id then return false end end
	table.insert(_textures, { id = id, name = name or id, _search = _buildSearch({ name or "", id }), isCustom = true })
	_save(); return true
end)
LocalInventoryData.removeTexture = _changing(function(id)
	id = tostring(id)
	for i, t in ipairs(_textures) do
		if t.id == id then
			table.remove(_textures, i)
			LocalFilters.forget(id)
			_save()
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end)
LocalInventoryData.renameTexture = _changing(function(id, newName)
	if not newName or newName == "" then return false end
	for _, t in ipairs(_textures) do if t.id == tostring(id) then t.name = newName; t._search = _buildSearch({ newName, t.id }); _save(); return true end end; return false
end)
-- `grid` is the sheet's columns. `rows` left out: a square sheet. nil for both: no grid.
LocalInventoryData.setTextureGrid = _changing(function(id, grid, rows)
	for _, t in ipairs(_textures) do
		if t.id == tostring(id) then
			t.grid, t.gridRows = sheetShape(grid, rows)
			_save(); return true
		end
	end
	return false
end)
function LocalInventoryData.getTextures() return _textures end
function LocalInventoryData.searchTextures(query) return _search(_textures, query) end
function LocalInventoryData.getTextureCount() return #_textures end


local function _texturesMatch(a, b)
	if #a ~= #b then return false end
	for i = 1, #a do if a[i] ~= b[i] then return false end end
	return true
end

LocalInventoryData.addFlipbook = _changing(function(name, textureIds)
	if not name or name == "" or not textureIds or #textureIds == 0 then return false end
	-- The same name and textures: skip.
	for _, f in ipairs(_flipbooks) do
		if f.name == name and _texturesMatch(f.textures, textureIds) then return false end
	end
	-- A taken name gets a suffix instead of being replaced.
	local baseName, finalName = name, name
	local suffix = 2
	local function nameExists(n) for _, f in ipairs(_flipbooks) do if f.name == n then return true end end; return false end
	while nameExists(finalName) do finalName = baseName .. " (" .. suffix .. ")"; suffix = suffix + 1 end
	name = finalName
	table.insert(_flipbooks, {
		name = name, textures = textureIds,
		_search = _buildSearch({ name, tostring(#textureIds) .. "f" }),
		_type = "meshflipbook",
	})
	_save(); return true
end)

LocalInventoryData.removeFlipbook = _changing(function(name)
	for i, f in ipairs(_flipbooks) do
		if f.name == name then table.remove(_flipbooks, i); _save(); return true end
	end
	return false
end)

LocalInventoryData.renameFlipbook = _changing(function(oldName, newName)
	if not newName or newName == "" then return false end
	for _, f in ipairs(_flipbooks) do
		if f.name == oldName then f.name = newName; f._search = _buildSearch({ newName, tostring(#f.textures) .. "f" }); _save(); return true end
	end
	return false
end)

function LocalInventoryData.getFlipbooks()
	return _flipbooks
end

function LocalInventoryData.searchFlipbooks(query) return _search(_flipbooks, query) end
function LocalInventoryData.getFlipbookCount() return #_flipbooks end


function LocalInventoryData.serializeInstance(instance)
	local raw = SS:SerializeInstancesAsync({instance})
	local compressed = ES:CompressBuffer(raw, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
	return buffer.tostring(ES:Base64Encode(compressed)), instance.ClassName
end

-- Imported Events fail closed: every event's Configuration gets ImportedUntrusted=true and
-- Enabled=false. Only Trust (EventsSchema.trustEvent / trustAllEvents) lets the Module run;
-- turning Enabled on does not.
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Part.EventsSchema)

local function stampImportedTree(instances)
	for _, root in ipairs(instances) do
		EventsSchema.stampImportedUntrusted(root)
		for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			EventsSchema.stampImportedUntrusted(desc)
		end
	end
end

function LocalInventoryData.deserializeAsset(dataStr)
	local b64 = buffer.fromstring(dataStr)
	local compressed = ES:Base64Decode(b64)
	local raw = ES:DecompressBuffer(compressed, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
	local instances = SS:DeserializeInstancesAsync(raw)
	stampImportedTree(instances)
	return instances
end

-- Large exports: Zstd, then Base64 with a "PICZ:" prefix.
local MAX_TEXTBOX = 199000
function LocalInventoryData.compressExport(json)
	local raw = buffer.fromstring(json)
	local compressed = ES:CompressBuffer(raw, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
	return "PICZ:" .. buffer.tostring(ES:Base64Encode(compressed))
end
function LocalInventoryData.decompressImport(text)
	if not text or text == "" then return text end
	if text:sub(1, 5) == "PICZ:" then
		local b64 = buffer.fromstring(text:sub(6))
		local compressed = ES:Base64Decode(b64)
		local raw = ES:DecompressBuffer(compressed, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
		return buffer.tostring(raw)
	end
	return text
end
function LocalInventoryData.getMaxTextbox() return MAX_TEXTBOX end

-- The parent's DataModel path, so an import can put the item back in its folders.
local function _getParentPath(instance)
	local parts = {}; local current = instance.Parent
	while current and current ~= game do table.insert(parts, 1, current.Name); current = current.Parent end
	return #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ".") or nil
end


local function _assetNameExists(n) for _, a in ipairs(_assets) do if a.name == n then return true end end; return false end

LocalInventoryData.addAsset = _changing(function(name, base64Data, className, parentPath, paths, itemCount)
	if not name or name == "" or not base64Data or base64Data == "" then return false end
	-- Identical data: skip.
	for _, a in ipairs(_assets) do if a.data == base64Data then return false end end
	local baseName, finalName = name, name; local suffix = 2
	while _assetNameExists(finalName) do finalName = baseName .. " (" .. suffix .. ")"; suffix = suffix + 1 end
	local entry = { name = finalName, data = base64Data, className = className or "Instance",
		_search = _buildSearch({ finalName, className or "" }), _type = "asset", isCustom = true }
	if parentPath then entry.parentPath = parentPath end
	if paths then entry.paths = paths end
	if itemCount then entry.itemCount = itemCount end
	table.insert(_assets, entry); _save(); return true
end)

LocalInventoryData.removeAsset = _changing(function(name)
	for i, a in ipairs(_assets) do
		if a.name == name then table.remove(_assets, i); _save(); return true end
	end
	return false
end)

LocalInventoryData.renameAsset = _changing(function(oldName, newName)
	if not newName or newName == "" then return false end
	for _, a in ipairs(_assets) do
		if a.name == oldName then a.name = newName; a._search = _buildSearch({ newName, a.className or "" }); _save(); return true end
	end
	return false
end)

function LocalInventoryData.getAssets() return _assets end
function LocalInventoryData.searchAssets(query) return _search(_assets, query) end
function LocalInventoryData.getAssetCount() return #_assets end

function LocalInventoryData.importAssetFromSelection(selectionArray, storeDirs)
	local imported, skipped = 0, 0
	LocalInventoryData.beginBatch()
	for _, instance in ipairs(selectionArray) do
		local ok, dataStr, className = pcall(function()
			local d, c = LocalInventoryData.serializeInstance(instance)
			return d, c
		end)
		if ok and dataStr then
			local parentPath = storeDirs and _getParentPath(instance) or nil
			if LocalInventoryData.addAsset(instance.Name, dataStr, className, parentPath) then imported = imported + 1
			else skipped = skipped + 1 end
		else skipped = skipped + 1 end
	end
	LocalInventoryData.endBatch()
	return { imported = imported, skipped = skipped }
end

-- Each selected Folder of Decals / Textures becomes a flipbook, frames in numeric name order.

function LocalInventoryData.importFromSelection(selectionArray)
	local imported, skipped = 0, 0
	local names = {}
	LocalInventoryData.beginBatch()
	for _, instance in ipairs(selectionArray) do
		if not instance:IsA("Folder") then skipped = skipped + 1; continue end
		local decals = {}
		for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			pcall(function()
				if child.Texture and child.Texture ~= "" then
					table.insert(decals, { name = child.Name, texture = child.Texture })
				end
			end)
		end
		if #decals == 0 then skipped = skipped + 1; continue end
		table.sort(decals, function(a, b)
			local na, nb = tonumber(a.name), tonumber(b.name)
			if na and nb then return na < nb end
			if na then return true end
			if nb then return false end
			return a.name < b.name
		end)
		local textureIds = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(decals) do table.insert(textureIds, d.texture) end
		local fbName = instance.Name
		if LocalInventoryData.addFlipbook(fbName, textureIds) then
			imported = imported + 1; table.insert(names, fbName)
		else
			skipped = skipped + 1
		end
	end
	LocalInventoryData.endBatch()
	return { imported = imported, skipped = skipped, names = names }
end

-- The whole selection serialized as one asset.

function LocalInventoryData.importAssetGroupFromSelection(selectionArray, storeDirs)
	if not selectionArray or #selectionArray == 0 then return { imported = 0, skipped = 0 } end
	local ok, dataStr = pcall(function()
		local raw = SS:SerializeInstancesAsync(selectionArray)
		local compressed = ES:CompressBuffer(raw, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
		return buffer.tostring(ES:Base64Encode(compressed))
	end)
	if not ok or not dataStr then return { imported = 0, skipped = #selectionArray } end
	local name = #selectionArray == 1 and selectionArray[1].Name or (selectionArray[1].Name .. " +" .. (#selectionArray - 1))
	local paths = nil
	if storeDirs then paths = {}; for _, inst in ipairs(selectionArray) do paths[#paths+1] = _getParentPath(inst) or "Workspace" end end
	LocalInventoryData.addAsset(name, dataStr, "Group", nil, paths, #selectionArray)
	return { imported = 1, skipped = 0 }
end


function LocalInventoryData.exportSelectedJSON(entries)
	if not entries or #entries == 0 then return "{}" end
	local data = { textures = {}, flipbooks = {}, assets = {}, meshframes = {} }
	for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
		if e._type == "asset" then local ae = { name = e.name, data = e.data, className = e.className }
			if e.parentPath then ae.parentPath = e.parentPath end; if e.paths then ae.paths = e.paths end
			if e.itemCount then ae.itemCount = e.itemCount end; table.insert(data.assets, ae)
		elseif e._type == "meshflipbook" then table.insert(data.flipbooks, { name = e.name, textures = e.textures })
		elseif e._type == "meshframes" then table.insert(data.meshframes, LocalMeshFrames.exportEntry(e))
		elseif e.id then local te = { id = e.id, name = e.name }; if e.grid then te.grid = e.grid; te.gridRows = e.gridRows end; table.insert(data.textures, te) end
	end
	local textureIds = {}
	for _, texture in ipairs(data.textures) do
		table.insert(textureIds, texture.id)
	end
	data.filters = LocalFilters.exportFor(textureIds)
	local ok, json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(data) end)
	return ok and json or "{}"
end

function LocalInventoryData.exportJSON()
	local ok, json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(_snapshot()) end)
	return ok and json or "{}"
end

-- One save at the end (beginBatch / endBatch), not one per entry.
function LocalInventoryData.importJSON(jsonString)
	if not jsonString or jsonString == "" then return { imported = 0 } end
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(jsonString) end)
	if not ok or typeof(data) ~= "table" then return { imported = 0, error = "Invalid JSON" } end
	local count = 0
	LocalInventoryData.beginBatch()
	-- Textures by id, flipbooks and assets by name; duplicates skipped.
	if data.textures then
		for _, t in ipairs(data.textures) do
			if t.id and LocalInventoryData.addTexture(tostring(t.id), t.name) then
				count = count + 1
				if sheetShape(t.grid, t.gridRows) then LocalInventoryData.setTextureGrid(t.id, t.grid, t.gridRows) end
			end
		end
	end
	if data.flipbooks then
		for _, f in ipairs(data.flipbooks) do
			if f.name and f.textures and #f.textures > 0 then
				if LocalInventoryData.addFlipbook(f.name, f.textures) then count = count + 1 end
			end
		end
	end
	-- parentPath / paths / itemCount go along, so a group or a path-aware import keeps its folders.
	if data.assets then
		for _, a in ipairs(data.assets) do
			if a.name and a.data then
				if LocalInventoryData.addAsset(a.name, a.data, a.className, a.parentPath, a.paths, a.itemCount) then count = count + 1 end
			end
		end
	end
	count = count + LocalMeshFrames.importList(data.meshframes)
	-- After the textures: a filter only takes ids that are in the inventory now.
	local known = {}
	for _, texture in ipairs(_textures) do
		known[texture.id] = true
	end
	LocalFilters.importList(data.filters, function(id)
		return known[id] == true
	end)
	LocalInventoryData.endBatch()
	return { imported = count }
end

LocalInventoryData.clear = _changing(function()
	_textures = {}; _flipbooks = {}; _assets = {}
	LocalMeshFrames.loadFromSave(nil)
	LocalFilters.loadFromSave(nil)
	_save()
end)

return LocalInventoryData

--[[
	The local inventory's mesh frame sets: MeshParts named 1..N, serialized together, that fill a
	transformed Part's MeshFrames folder (Part/MeshFrames owns the folder's rules).
	Entry: { name, data, frameCount, _search, _type = "meshframes", isCustom = true }.
	LocalInventoryData saves the list under the JSON key "meshframes". No UI.
]]

local SerializationService = game:GetService("SerializationService")
local EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.Part.MeshFrames)

local LocalMeshFrames = {}

local _list = {}
local _hooks = {
	change = function(fn, ...) return fn(...) end,
	save = function() end,
	beginBatch = function() end,
	endBatch = function() end,
}

-- LocalInventoryData binds { change, save, beginBatch, endBatch } once at load: every change runs
-- through `change`, which lays it on top of what another Studio window saved.
function LocalMeshFrames.bind(hooks)
	for key, fn in pairs(hooks) do
		_hooks[key] = fn
	end
end

-- Same tokenizer as LocalInventoryData._buildSearch / _search so every local list matches alike.
local function buildSearch(parts)
	local lower = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		table.insert(lower, tostring(part):lower())
	end
	return table.concat(lower, " ")
end

local function matchesQuery(entry, query)
	for token in query:gmatch("%S+") do
		if not entry._search:find(token, 1, true) then return false end
	end
	return true
end

local function makeEntry(name, dataStr, frameCount)
	return {
		name = name,
		data = dataStr,
		frameCount = frameCount,
		_search = buildSearch({ name, tostring(frameCount) .. "f" }),
		_type = "meshframes",
		isCustom = true,
	}
end

local function nameExists(name)
	for _, entry in ipairs(_list) do
		if entry.name == name then return true end
	end
	return false
end


-- Skips an entry with identical data; a clashing name gets a " (2)" style suffix.
local function add(name, dataStr, frameCount)
	if not name or name == "" or not dataStr or dataStr == "" then return false end
	frameCount = math.floor(tonumber(frameCount) or 0)
	if frameCount < 1 then return false end
	for _, entry in ipairs(_list) do
		if entry.data == dataStr then return false end
	end
	local finalName = name
	local suffix = 2
	while nameExists(finalName) do
		finalName = name .. " (" .. suffix .. ")"
		suffix += 1
	end
	table.insert(_list, makeEntry(finalName, dataStr, frameCount))
	_hooks.save()
	return true
end
function LocalMeshFrames.add(...) return _hooks.change(add, ...) end

local function remove(name)
	for i, entry in ipairs(_list) do
		if entry.name == name then
			table.remove(_list, i)
			_hooks.save()
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
function LocalMeshFrames.remove(...) return _hooks.change(remove, ...) end

local function rename(oldName, newName)
	if not newName or newName == "" then return false end
	for _, entry in ipairs(_list) do
		if entry.name == oldName then
			entry.name = newName
			entry._search = buildSearch({ newName, tostring(entry.frameCount) .. "f" })
			_hooks.save()
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
function LocalMeshFrames.rename(...) return _hooks.change(rename, ...) end

function LocalMeshFrames.get()
	return _list
end

function LocalMeshFrames.count()
	return #_list
end

function LocalMeshFrames.search(query)
	if not query or query == "" then return _list end
	local trimmed = query:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if trimmed == "" then return _list end
	local results = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(_list) do
		if matchesQuery(entry, trimmed) then table.insert(results, entry) end
	end
	return results
end


function LocalMeshFrames.exportEntry(entry)
	return { name = entry.name, data = entry.data, frameCount = entry.frameCount }
end

function LocalMeshFrames.serializeForSave()
	local plain = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(_list) do
		table.insert(plain, LocalMeshFrames.exportEntry(entry))
	end
	return plain
end

-- Replaces the list from a saved array (nil empties it). Never saves.
-- An entry still there keeps its table, as the open detail and the selection hold it; a table goes to
-- one entry only, as two can share a name.
function LocalMeshFrames.loadFromSave(savedList)
	local old = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(_list) do
		old[entry.name] = entry
	end
	_list = {}
	if type(savedList) ~= "table" then return end
	for _, saved in ipairs(savedList) do
		local frameCount = math.floor(tonumber(saved.frameCount) or 0)
		if saved.name and saved.data and frameCount >= 1 then
			local fresh = makeEntry(tostring(saved.name), tostring(saved.data), frameCount)
			local entry = old[fresh.name]
			old[fresh.name] = nil
			if entry then
				for key, value in pairs(fresh) do
					entry[key] = value
				end
			else
				entry = fresh
			end
			table.insert(_list, entry)
		end
	end
end

-- Merges through add and returns how many were added; the caller brackets it with beginBatch / endBatch.
function LocalMeshFrames.importList(savedList)
	if type(savedList) ~= "table" then return 0 end
	local count = 0
	for _, saved in ipairs(savedList) do
		if saved.name and saved.data and LocalMeshFrames.add(saved.name, saved.data, saved.frameCount) then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end


local function frameNumber(name)
	return tonumber(name:match("(%d+)%D*$"))
end

-- A frame's number: its own name, else the nearest Model ancestor's name (the Importer wraps every
-- frame in a Model named after the file and calls the mesh inside it "default").
function LocalMeshFrames.frameNumberOf(part)
	local number = frameNumber(part.Name)
	local ancestor = part.Parent
	while number == nil and ancestor and ancestor:IsA("Model") do
		number = frameNumber(ancestor.Name)
		ancestor = ancestor.Parent
	end
	return number
end

-- Frame-number order (frame_001 < frame_002), numbered first, then the given order (stable), so a
-- set without numbers keeps its Explorer order. Returns true when no part carried a number.
-- InventoryMeshFramesDetail sorts deserialized frames the same way before renaming them 1..N.
function LocalMeshFrames.sortByFrameNumber(parts)
	local numbers = {}
	local positions = {}
	local anyNumber = false
	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		numbers[part] = LocalMeshFrames.frameNumberOf(part)
		positions[part] = index
		if numbers[part] then anyNumber = true end
	end
	table.sort(parts, function(a, b)
		local numberA, numberB = numbers[a], numbers[b]
		if numberA and numberB and numberA ~= numberB then return numberA < numberB end
		if numberA and not numberB then return true end
		if numberB and not numberA then return false end
		return positions[a] < positions[b]
	end)
	return not anyNumber
end

-- "frame_001" -> "frame"; a name that is only digits falls back to a generic name.
local function baseName(name)
	local stripped = name:gsub("[%s_%-%.]*%d+$", "")
	if stripped == "" then return "MeshFrames" end
	return stripped
end

local isFrame = MeshFramesMod.isFrame

-- MeshParts (or Parts with a SpecialMesh), the frames in selected Models, and both among a Folder's
-- children; `accept(part)` may veto one. Returns frames, the first Folder's name, how many selected
-- instances gave nothing, and whether no frame had a number.
function LocalMeshFrames.collectFrames(selection, accept)
	local frames = {}
	local folderName = nil
	local skipped = 0
	local function take(part)
		if accept and not accept(part) then return false end
		table.insert(frames, part)
		return true
	end
	local function fromModel(model)
		local found = 0
		for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if isFrame(descendant) and take(descendant) then found += 1 end
		end
		return found
	end
	local function fromInstance(instance)
		if isFrame(instance) then return take(instance) and 1 or 0 end
		if instance:IsA("Model") then return fromModel(instance) end
		return 0
	end
	for _, instance in ipairs(selection) do
		if instance:IsA("Folder") then
			local found = 0
			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do found += fromInstance(child) end
			if found > 0 then folderName = folderName or instance.Name else skipped += 1 end
		elseif fromInstance(instance) == 0 then
			skipped += 1
		end
	end
	local unnumbered = LocalMeshFrames.sortByFrameNumber(frames)
	return frames, folderName, skipped, unnumbered
end

-- Clones renamed 1..N are serialized together and destroyed afterwards. Non-archivable frames
-- cannot be cloned and are left out. Returns the data string and the frame count.
local function serializeClones(frames)
	local clones = {}
	for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
		local clone = frame:Clone()
		if clone then
			clone.Name = tostring(#clones + 1)
			table.insert(clones, clone)
		end
	end
	if #clones == 0 then return nil, 0 end
	local ok, dataStr = pcall(function()
		local raw = SerializationService:SerializeInstancesAsync(clones)
		local compressed = EncodingService:CompressBuffer(raw, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
		return buffer.tostring(EncodingService:Base64Encode(compressed))
	end)
	for _, clone in ipairs(clones) do
		clone:Destroy()
	end
	if not ok then return nil, 0 end
	return dataStr, #clones
end

-- Yields (SerializeInstancesAsync). Returns { imported, skipped, names } for the status label.
function LocalMeshFrames.importFromSelection(selection)
	local frames, folderName, skipped, unnumbered = LocalMeshFrames.collectFrames(selection or {})
	if #frames == 0 then return { imported = 0, skipped = skipped, names = {} } end
	local note = unnumbered and " (no frame numbers found: Explorer order kept)" or nil
	local first = frames[1]
	local source = (first.Parent and first.Parent:IsA("Model")) and first.Parent or first
	local name = folderName or baseName(source.Name)
	_hooks.beginBatch()
	local dataStr, frameCount = serializeClones(frames)
	local added = dataStr ~= nil and LocalMeshFrames.add(name, dataStr, frameCount)
	_hooks.endBatch()
	if not added then return { imported = 0, skipped = skipped + 1, names = {} } end
	return { imported = 1, skipped = skipped, names = { name }, note = note }
end

return LocalMeshFrames

--[[
	The lockout window a blocked account sees (Auth.buildLockoutUI). Owns its ScreenGui so setup()
	and teardown() share one handle.

	  require(Lockout)({ Auth = Auth, plugin = pluginn }) (init.server.lua)
	    -> { showLockout(authResult, onVerified, onClose), destroyLockout() }
]]

return function(deps)
	local Auth = deps.Auth
	local pluginn = deps.plugin

	local Lockout = {}
	local _lockoutGui = nil

	function Lockout.showLockout(authResult, onVerified, onClose)

			_lockoutGui = nil; onVerified()

	end

	return Lockout
end

--[[
	The only module that knows the older saved formats, and the Scan / Fix tool's checks:
	- Factors folders (unbaked: ParticleEmitters used as curve holders)
	- BakedFactors configurations (baked attributes)
	- older physics units (speed x10, drag / avgLifetime, accel x 10 / avgLifetime)
	- the older GraphBlender DurationOfBlend / BlendSpeed shape
	A converted item has one PartIcleProperties Configuration; the older structures are removed.
	  Migrate.detect(item) -> "new" | "old_baked" | "old_unbaked" | "old_old" | nil
	  Migrate.getIssues(item) -> issues        Migrate.scanAll() -> fixItems, migrateItems
	  Migrate.convert(item) -> boolean         Migrate.fix(item) -> updated
]]

-- task.wait between requires spreads the start-up work across frames.
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry); task.wait()
local Convert = require(script.Convert); task.wait()
local AxisLinks = require(script.Parent.Part.AxisLinks); task.wait()

local Migrate = {}
-- Sub-modules. DecalLayers and GraphBlender require nothing; Drag requires Part/DragModel and
-- Natives Part/AtRest, both leaves.
Migrate.DecalLayers = require(script.DecalLayers)
Migrate.Drag = require(script.Drag)
Migrate.Natives = require(script.Natives)
local GraphBlender = require(script.GraphBlender)
Migrate._hasGraphBlenderIssues = GraphBlender.hasIssues
Migrate._migrateGraphBlender = GraphBlender.migrate


-- The Transformed attribute first, else Factors / BakedFactors as evidence.
function Migrate.detect(item)
	local hasTransformed = item:GetAttribute("Transformed") == true
	if not hasTransformed then
		if not item:FindFirstChild("Factors") and not item:FindFirstChild("BakedFactors") then return nil end
	end

	if item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME) then return "new" end

	local hasQwinkle = item:GetAttribute("Qwinkle") == true
	local isBaked = item:GetAttribute("IsBaked") == true

	if isBaked and item:FindFirstChild("BakedFactors") then
		return hasQwinkle and "old_baked" or "old_old"
	end

	if item:FindFirstChild("Factors") then
		return hasQwinkle and "old_unbaked" or "old_old"
	end

	return nil
end


-- Issues for Scan; takes transformed items and items in an older format.
function Migrate.getIssues(item)
	-- A Reactor keeps its parts as built: it has none of the structure checked below.
	if item:GetAttribute("IsReactor") == true then return {} end
	local format = Migrate.detect(item)
	if not format and not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return {} end
	local issues = {}

	if format == "old_old" then
		table.insert(issues, "Old version (needs migration + physics conversion)")
	elseif format == "old_baked" or format == "old_unbaked" then
		table.insert(issues, "Old format (needs conversion to V4)")
	end

	if not item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then table.insert(issues, "Missing EmitParent") end
	if item:GetAttribute("IsEmitter") == nil then table.insert(issues, "Missing IsEmitter") end
	if item:GetAttribute("EmitCount") == nil then table.insert(issues, "Missing EmitCount") end
	if item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration") == nil then table.insert(issues, "Missing EmitDuration") end
	if item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") == nil then table.insert(issues, "Missing EmitDelay") end
	if item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") == nil then table.insert(issues, "Missing EmissionMode") end
	if item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == nil then table.insert(issues, "Missing AnimateLoop") end
	-- noLink: Rope, CameraShake and the rigs have no Link structure. noLinkStructure: Lightning has
	-- Link / LinkMode and none of the rest.
	local isLightning = item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") == true
	local noLink = item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsRope") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsContainer") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsMatte") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsForce") == true
	local noLinkStructure = isLightning or noLink
	if (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not noLink and item:GetAttribute("LinkMode") == nil then table.insert(issues, "Missing LinkMode") end

	-- Trails and unbaked items keep their data elsewhere.
	if not item:IsA("Trail") and not item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME) and format ~= "old_unbaked" and format ~= "old_old" then
		table.insert(issues, "Missing PartIcleProperties config")
	end

	if (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not noLink and not item:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		table.insert(issues, "Missing Link")
	end

	-- Only BaseParts have target acceleration.
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and not noLinkStructure and not item:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget") then
		table.insert(issues, "Missing AccelTarget")
	end

	-- Lightning's Point mode and Rope's end anchor.
	if (isLightning or item:GetAttribute("IsRope") == true) and not item:FindFirstChild("Target") then
		table.insert(issues, "Missing Target")
	end

	-- Matches what _fixStructure creates, so Scan shows it before Fix.
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and not noLinkStructure and not item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks") then
		table.insert(issues, "Missing MeshFlipbooks folder")
	end
	if Migrate.DecalLayers.needs(item) then table.insert(issues, "Legacy decal routing (Fix promotes to decal layers)") end
	if item:IsA("Beam") and not item:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks") then
		table.insert(issues, "Missing BeamFlipbooks folder")
	end
	if item:IsA("ImageLabel") and not item:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks") then
		table.insert(issues, "Missing ImageFlipbooks folder")
	end

	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		local gb = nil
		if format == "old_baked" or format == "new" or format == nil then
			gb = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		elseif format == "old_unbaked" then
			local f = item:FindFirstChild("Factors")
			gb = f and f:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		end
		if gb and Migrate._hasGraphBlenderIssues(gb) then
			table.insert(issues, "Old GraphBlender format")
		end
		if (format == "new" or format == nil) and not item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender") then
			table.insert(issues, "Missing GraphBlender")
		end
	end

	if format == "old_baked" or format == "new" or format == nil then
		if not item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate") then
			table.insert(issues, "Missing RenderTemplate")
		end
	elseif format == "old_unbaked" or format == "old_old" then
		local factors = item:FindFirstChild("Factors")
		if factors and not factors:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate") then
			table.insert(issues, "Missing RenderTemplate")
		end
	end

	if format == "new" then
		local missing = Migrate._getMissingConfigProps(item)
		if missing > 0 then
			table.insert(issues, missing .. " missing config properties")
		end
	end
	if Migrate.Drag.needs(item) then table.insert(issues, "Drag on the old formula (Fix converts the number, the motion stays)") end
	if Migrate.Natives.needs(item) then table.insert(issues, "A Beam or Light of the RenderTemplate is on at rest (Fix turns it off there, every copy keeps it)") end

	return issues
end


local TypeData = require(script.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry.TypeData)

function Migrate._getTypeProps(item)
	-- Through TypeRegistry, so every type is covered without a branch here.
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	return typeDef and typeDef.properties or nil
end

-- An optional property (TypeData) is never missing: its absence is its default.
function Migrate._getMissingConfigProps(item)
	local config = item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME)
	local props = Migrate._getTypeProps(item)
	if not config or not props then return 0 end
	local count = 0
	for propName, propDef in pairs(props) do
		local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
		local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)
		local stale = type(raw) == "number" and (propDef.type == "NumberSequence" or propDef.type == "NumberRange")
		if (raw == nil and not propDef.optional) or stale then count += 1 end
	end
	return count
end

-- Fills missing config properties. A boolean, number or enum takes the value the RenderTemplate
-- or item already has, so a setting made natively survives Fix.
function Migrate._fillConfigDefaults(item)
	local config = item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME)
	local props = Migrate._getTypeProps(item)
	if not config or not props then return false end
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	local sources = {}
	if rt then table.insert(sources, rt) end
	table.insert(sources, item)
	local updated = false

	-- DirMode absent: taken from VelocityVectored, the attribute it replaces, which is then removed.
	if props.DirMode and config:GetAttribute("DirMode") == nil then
		local legacy = config:GetAttribute("VelocityVectored")
		if legacy ~= nil then
			config:SetAttribute("DirMode", legacy and "Local" or "RigidLocal")
			config:SetAttribute("VelocityVectored", nil)
			updated = true
		end
	end

	-- DisplacementMode absent: "Local" when a PosOffset graph is set (those always ran spawn-local),
	-- else the "Global" default.
	if props.DisplacementMode and config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") == nil then
		local function hasNonZeroSequence(name)
			local seq = config:GetAttribute(name)
			if typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return false end
			for _, k in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
				if k.Value ~= 0 or k.Envelope ~= 0 then return true end
			end
			return false
		end
		if hasNonZeroSequence("PosOffsetX") or hasNonZeroSequence("PosOffsetY") or hasNonZeroSequence("PosOffsetZ") then
			config:SetAttribute("DisplacementMode", "Local")
			updated = true
		end
	end

	-- UseShape absent: an old ShapeInOut of InAndOut meant shape on, so it becomes UseShape = true with
	-- ShapeInOut Outward (the same look); Outward stays shape off.
	if props.UseShape and config:GetAttribute("UseShape") == nil then
		local sio = config:GetAttribute("ShapeInOut")
		local hadShape = sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut.Name
			or sio == "InAndOut"
			or sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut
		config:SetAttribute("UseShape", hadShape == true)
		if hadShape then
			config:SetAttribute("ShapeInOut", "Outward")
		end
		updated = true
	end
	-- LookAtInitially absent: false. An old ShapeStyle "Surface" is often stale, and Fix must not turn
	-- on what the user never used.
	if props.LookAtInitially and config:GetAttribute("LookAtInitially") == nil then
		config:SetAttribute("LookAtInitially", false)
		updated = true
	end
	for propName, propDef in pairs(props) do
		local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
		local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)
		-- Scalar saved before the property became a graph or a range: promote to the flat equivalent.
		if propDef.type == "NumberSequence" and type(raw) == "number" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, NumberSequence.new(raw))
			updated = true
		elseif propDef.type == "NumberRange" and type(raw) == "number" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, NumberRange.new(raw))
			updated = true
		elseif raw == nil and not propDef.optional then
			local val = nil
			-- A simple type takes the RenderTemplate's or source's own value.
			if propDef.type == "boolean" or propDef.type == "number" or propDef.type == "enum" then
				for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
					local ok, liveVal = pcall(function() return src[propName] end)
					if ok and liveVal ~= nil then
						if propDef.type == "enum" and typeof(liveVal) == "EnumItem" then
							val = liveVal.Name; break
						elseif propDef.type == "boolean" and type(liveVal) == "boolean" then
							val = liveVal; break
						elseif propDef.type == "number" and type(liveVal) == "number" then
							val = liveVal; break
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if val == nil then
				val = propDef.default
				if propDef.type == "enum" and val then val = val.Name end
			end
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, val)
			updated = true
		end
	end
	return updated
end

-- Adds the identity attributes and children an item needs.
function Migrate._fixStructure(item)
	local updated = false
	-- Lightning, Rope and CameraShake skip the AccelTarget / ShapePart / MeshFlipbooks structure.
	-- Lightning keeps Link / LinkMode / LinkSource.
	local isLightning = item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") == true
	local isCameraShake = item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") == true
	local isRocks = item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") == true
	local isRope = item:GetAttribute("IsRope") == true
	local isDistortion = item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true
	local noLinkStructure = isLightning or isCameraShake or isRocks or isRope or isDistortion or item:GetAttribute("IsContainer") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsMatte") == true or item:GetAttribute("IsForce") == true
	local noLink = noLinkStructure and not isLightning
	if not item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then
		local ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); ep.Name = "EmitParent"; ep.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	if (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not noLink and not item:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		local lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); lk.Name = "Link"; lk.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	if (isLightning or isRope) and not item:FindFirstChild("Target") then
		local tv = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); tv.Name = "Target"; tv.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	if item:GetAttribute("IsEmitter") == nil then item:SetAttribute("IsEmitter", true); updated = true end
	-- Same default as Transform, and what the runtime assumes for a missing EmitCount.
	if item:GetAttribute("EmitCount") == nil then item:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 1); updated = true end
	-- 0 for most types. A Trail stores EmitDuration as a STRING range ("0, 0"), which its directAccess
	-- readers parse.
	if item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration") == nil then
		local default = item:IsA("Trail") and "0, 0" or 0
		item:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", default); updated = true
	end
	if item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") == nil then item:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0); updated = true end
	if item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") == nil then item:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", "Emit"); updated = true end
	if item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == nil then item:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false); updated = true end
	if (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not noLink and item:GetAttribute("LinkMode") == nil then item:SetAttribute("LinkMode", "Follow"); updated = true end
	-- LinkSource absent: "None", or "Object" when Link already holds a pick.
	if (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not noLink and item:GetAttribute("LinkSource") == nil then
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
		local hasPick = lk and lk:IsA("ObjectValue") and lk.Value ~= nil
		item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", hasPick and "Object" or "None"); updated = true
	end
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and not noLinkStructure and not item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks") then
		local f = Instance.new("Folder"); f.Name = "MeshFlipbooks"; f.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	-- BaseParts only; empty until AccelerationTowardsInstance is used.
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and not noLinkStructure and not item:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget") then
		local at = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); at.Name = "AccelTarget"; at.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	-- ShapePart points at the source itself, so the picker shows it rather than "(none)"; the runtime
	-- falls back to the source anyway. Lightning too: it backs the spawn Shape.
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and not item:FindFirstChild("ShapePart") then
		local sp = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); sp.Name = "ShapePart"; sp.Value = item; sp.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	-- Only the source carries AccelTarget: one in the RenderTemplate is taken out
	-- (_ensureRenderTemplate strips fresh copies).
	if item:IsA("BasePart") then
		local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		local leaked = rt and rt:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget")
		-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
		if leaked then leaked.Parent = nil; updated = true end
	end
	if item:IsA("Beam") and not item:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks") then
		local f = Instance.new("Folder"); f.Name = "BeamFlipbooks"; f.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	-- ImageLabel: the source gets ImageFlipbooks (for Inventory inserts); a stray one in the
	-- RenderTemplate goes, as it would weigh down every emitted copy.
	if item:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		if not item:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks") then
			local f = Instance.new("Folder"); f.Name = "ImageFlipbooks"; f.Parent = item; updated = true
		end
		local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		if rt then local rtFF = rt:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks"); if rtFF then rtFF.Parent = nil; updated = true end end
	end
	-- PreloadTexture defaults to false on every type with textures, Models included.
	if (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Beam") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("Model"))
		and item:GetAttribute("PreloadTexture") == nil then
		item:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", false); updated = true
	end
	-- A source PE's or Trail's .Enabled is left alone: ambient streams and directAccess Trails use it,
	-- and emitted copies use :Emit(count).
	return updated
end

-- Makes a missing RenderTemplate for a BasePart (hides the parent, takes out its visual children)
-- or a PointLight (turns it off). Other types build theirs in their own Transform paths.
function Migrate._ensureRenderTemplate(item, parent)
	if parent:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate") then return false end
	local ok, t = pcall(function() return item:Clone() end)
	if not ok or not t then return false end
	t.Name = "RenderTemplate"
	for _, c in ipairs(t:GetChildren()) do
		if c:GetAttribute("Transformed") then continue end
		if c.Name == "Factors" or c.Name == "BakedFactors" or c.Name == TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME
			or c.Name == "EmitParent" or c.Name == "Link" or c.Name == "AccelTarget" or c.Name == "Target"
			or c.Name == "MeshFlipbooks" or c.Name == "MeshFrames" or c.Name == "BeamFlipbooks" or c.Name == "ImageFlipbooks" or c.Name == "GraphBlender"
			or c:IsA("BasePart") or c:IsA("Script") or c:IsA("LocalScript") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	for a in pairs(t:GetAttributes()) do t:SetAttribute(a, nil) end
	if t:IsA("BasePart") then
		t.Anchored = true; t.CanCollide = false; t.CanQuery = false
		t.CanTouch = false; t.CastShadow = false; t.Massless = true; t.Transparency = 1
		for _, c in ipairs(t:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture") then c.Transparency = 1 end end
	end
	t.Parent = parent
	-- Visual children are taken out with Parent = nil, not Destroy: Fix runs between waypoints.
	-- Transform moves the originals in instead (Part/Transform cloneWithout); kept alike by hand.
	if parent:IsA("BasePart") then
		parent.Transparency = 1
		for _, c in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if c ~= t and (c:IsA("SpecialMesh") or c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture")) then c.Parent = nil end
		end
	elseif parent:IsA("Light") then parent.Enabled = false end
	return true
end


-- Converts an item from any older format to the current one.
function Migrate.convert(item)
	local format = Migrate.detect(item)
	if not format or format == "new" then return false end
	local isPreQwinkle = (format == "old_old")
	-- An item in an older format may lack the Transformed attribute.
	if not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then item:SetAttribute("Transformed", true) end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if format == "old_baked" or (format == "old_old" and item:GetAttribute("IsBaked")) then
			local baked = item:FindFirstChild("BakedFactors")
			if not baked then error("Missing BakedFactors") end
			if item:IsA("Light") then Convert.convertBakedPointLight(item, baked)
			elseif item:IsA("Beam") then Convert.convertBakedBeam(item, baked, Migrate._migrateGraphBlender)
			else Convert.convertBakedPart(item, baked) end
		else
			local factors = item:FindFirstChild("Factors")
			if not factors then error("Missing Factors") end
			if item:IsA("Light") then Convert.convertUnbakedPointLight(item, factors)
			elseif item:IsA("Beam") then Convert.convertUnbakedBeam(item, factors, Migrate._migrateGraphBlender)
			else Convert.convertUnbakedPart(item, factors) end
		end
	end)

	if not ok then
		warn("Part-Icles [Migrate]: Failed to convert " .. item:GetFullName() .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		return false
	end

	if isPreQwinkle then Convert.convertPhysics(item) end
	-- AFTER conversion, so it does not make duplicate flipbook folders.
	Migrate._fixStructure(item)
	Migrate._ensureRenderTemplate(item, item)
	-- LightInfluence 0 on source and RenderTemplate, as Transform sets on new Beams.
	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		if item.LightInfluence ~= 0 then item.LightInfluence = 0 end
		local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		if rt and rt:IsA("Beam") and rt.LightInfluence ~= 0 then rt.LightInfluence = 0 end
	end
	-- As Migrate.fix does, so old attribute swaps (VelocityVectored -> DirMode) land now.
	Migrate._fillConfigDefaults(item)
	Migrate.Natives.migrate(item)
	item:SetAttribute("Qwinkle", true)
	return true
end

-- Every service's items with issues.
function Migrate.scanAll()
	local fixItems, migrateItems = {}, {}
	-- Lighting holds transformed Atmosphere / Blur / Bloom / CC, StarterGui the ImageLabels;
	-- StarterPack and ReplicatedFirst hold stashed templates.
	for _, service in ipairs({
		workspace,
		game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),
		game:GetService("ServerStorage"),
		game:GetService("Lighting"),
		game:GetService("StarterGui"),
		game:GetService("StarterPack"),
		game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst"),
	}) do
		-- Yields every 500 descendants so a big place does not stall the editor during Scan.
		local count = 0
		for _, obj in ipairs(service:GetDescendants()) do
			count = count + 1
			if count % 500 == 0 then task.wait() end
			if not obj:GetAttribute("Transformed") and not obj:FindFirstChild("Factors") and not obj:FindFirstChild("BakedFactors") then continue end
			local issues = Migrate.getIssues(obj)
			if #issues > 0 then
				print("Part-Icles [Scan]: " .. obj:GetFullName() .. "   -   " .. table.concat(issues, ", "))
				local fmt = Migrate.detect(obj)
				if fmt == "old_unbaked" or fmt == "old_baked" or fmt == "old_old" then
					table.insert(migrateItems, obj)
				else table.insert(fixItems, obj) end
			end
		end
	end
	return fixItems, migrateItems
end

-- Structural fixes for an item already in the current format.
function Migrate.fix(item)
	if item:GetAttribute("IsReactor") == true then return false end
	local fmt = Migrate.detect(item)
	if not fmt and not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return false end
	if not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then item:SetAttribute("Transformed", true) end
	local updated = Migrate._fixStructure(item)
	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		if item.LightInfluence ~= 0 then item.LightInfluence = 0; updated = true end
		local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		if rt and rt:IsA("Beam") and rt.LightInfluence ~= 0 then rt.LightInfluence = 0; updated = true end
		local gb = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		if gb then
			if Migrate._migrateGraphBlender(gb) then updated = true end
		else
			gb = Instance.new("Folder"); gb.Name = "GraphBlender"
			local s1 = Instance.new("Configuration"); s1.Name = "1"
			s1:SetAttribute("Time", 0); s1:SetAttribute("Transparency", NumberSequence.new(0)); s1:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)))
			s1:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
			s1.Parent = gb; gb.Parent = item; updated = true
		end
	end
	if Migrate._ensureRenderTemplate(item, item) then updated = true end
	if not item:IsA("Trail") and not item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME) then
		local config = Instance.new("Configuration"); config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME
		config.Parent = item; updated = true
	end
	if Migrate._fillConfigDefaults(item) then updated = true end
	if Migrate.DecalLayers.migrate(item) then updated = true end
	if Migrate.Drag.migrate(item) then updated = true end
	if Migrate.Natives.migrate(item) then updated = true end
	-- Writes back a cleaned AxisLinks topology: the runtime drops chains and cycles as it reads, but
	-- the raw *LinkedTo attributes stay until written, and the panel shows them.
	local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if cfg then
		local axisGroups = {
			{"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"},
			{"RotX","RotY","RotZ"},
			{"RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ"},
			{"PosX","PosY","PosZ"},
		}
		for _, axes in ipairs(axisGroups) do
			local raw = {}
			local hasAny = false
			for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
				local v = cfg:GetAttribute(axis .. "LinkedTo")
				if v ~= nil then hasAny = true end
				raw[axis] = v
			end
			if hasAny then
				local cleaned = AxisLinks.sanitize(raw)
				for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
					local newVal = cleaned[axis] or ""
					if cfg:GetAttribute(axis .. "LinkedTo") ~= newVal then
						cfg:SetAttribute(axis .. "LinkedTo", newVal)
						updated = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Repairs the Events tree (malformed children, default attributes, cached _CompiledEventModule
	-- copies, an empty folder). Looked up under pcall, so a build without Part/EventsSchema still runs.
	local _partFolder = script.Parent and script.Parent:FindFirstChild("Part")
	local _esModule = _partFolder and _partFolder:FindFirstChild("EventsSchema")
	local ok, EventsSchema = false, nil
	if _esModule then ok, EventsSchema = pcall(require, _esModule) end
	if ok and EventsSchema and EventsSchema.sanitize then
		if EventsSchema.sanitize(item) then updated = true end
	end
	return updated
end

return Migrate

--[[
	Converts the older saved formats (baked, unbaked, and the older physics units) to the current
	one. Called by Migrate.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry)

local Convert = {}


local function scaleSequence(seq, factor)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seq end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints
	local new = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value * factor, kp.Envelope * math.abs(factor)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end


-- Copies a BakedFactors config's attributes into a new config. A value missing under its
-- prefixed name (attrName) is read under the plain property name, as older saves stored it.
local function _convertBakedGeneric(item, baked, typeDef)
	local config = Instance.new("Configuration")
	config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME

	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
		local bakedAttrName = propDef.attrName or propName
		local raw = baked:GetAttribute(bakedAttrName)
		if raw == nil and bakedAttrName ~= propName then
			raw = baked:GetAttribute(propName)
		end
		if raw ~= nil then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, raw)
		elseif not propDef.optional then
			if propDef.type == "enum" then
				config:SetAttribute(attrName, propDef.default.Name)
			else
				config:SetAttribute(attrName, propDef.default)
			end
		end
	end

	config.Parent = item
	-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
	baked.Parent = nil
	item:SetAttribute("IsBaked", nil)
	return config
end

function Convert.convertBakedPart(item, baked)
	_convertBakedGeneric(item, baked, TypeRegistry.Types.Part)
end

function Convert.convertBakedBeam(item, baked, migrateGraphBlender)
	_convertBakedGeneric(item, baked, TypeRegistry.Types.Beam)
	local gb = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
	if gb then migrateGraphBlender(gb) end
end

function Convert.convertBakedPointLight(item, baked)
	_convertBakedGeneric(item, baked, TypeRegistry.Types.PointLight)
end


-- Fills missing defaults on a new config; an optional property stays absent.
local function _fillDefaults(config, typeDef)
	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
		if config:GetAttribute(attrName) == nil and not propDef.optional then
			if propDef.type == "enum" then
				config:SetAttribute(attrName, propDef.default.Name)
			else
				config:SetAttribute(attrName, propDef.default)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Convert.convertUnbakedPart(item, factors)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Part
	local config = Instance.new("Configuration")
	config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME

	local main = factors:FindFirstChild("Main")
	local sz = factors:FindFirstChild("Size")
	local rot = factors:FindFirstChild("Rotation")
	local rs = factors:FindFirstChild("RotationSpeed")

	if main then
		config:SetAttribute("Brightness", main.Size)
		config:SetAttribute("Color", main.Color)
		config:SetAttribute("Transparency", main.Transparency)
		config:SetAttribute("Speed", main.Squash)
		config:SetAttribute("Lifetime", main.Lifetime)
		config:SetAttribute("Rate", main.Rate)
		config:SetAttribute("SpreadAngle", main.SpreadAngle)
		config:SetAttribute("Acceleration", main.Acceleration)
		config:SetAttribute("Drag", main.Drag)
		config:SetAttribute("Shape", main.Shape.Name)
		config:SetAttribute("ShapeInOut", main.ShapeInOut.Name)
		-- The native ShapeStyle Surface becomes LookAtInitially; surface spawning is ShapePartial's job here.
		config:SetAttribute("LookAtInitially", main.ShapeStyle == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface)
		config:SetAttribute("ShapePartial", main.ShapePartial)
		config:SetAttribute("EmissionDirection", main.EmissionDirection.Name)
		config:SetAttribute("FlipbookMode", main.FlipbookMode.Name)
		config:SetAttribute("FlipbookFramerate", main.FlipbookFramerate)
		config:SetAttribute("FlipbookStartRandom", main.FlipbookStartRandom)
	end

	if sz then
		if sz:FindFirstChild("X") then config:SetAttribute("SizeX", sz.X.Size) end
		if sz:FindFirstChild("Y") then config:SetAttribute("SizeY", sz.Y.Size) end
		if sz:FindFirstChild("Z") then config:SetAttribute("SizeZ", sz.Z.Size) end
	end

	if rot then
		if rot:FindFirstChild("X") then config:SetAttribute("RotX", rot.X.Rotation) end
		if rot:FindFirstChild("Y") then config:SetAttribute("RotY", rot.Y.Rotation) end
		if rot:FindFirstChild("Z") then config:SetAttribute("RotZ", rot.Z.Rotation) end
	end

	if rs then
		if rs:FindFirstChild("X") then config:SetAttribute("RotSpeedX", rs.X.Squash) end
		if rs:FindFirstChild("Y") then config:SetAttribute("RotSpeedY", rs.Y.Squash) end
		if rs:FindFirstChild("Z") then config:SetAttribute("RotSpeedZ", rs.Z.Squash) end
	end

	local vv = factors:FindFirstChild("VelocityVectored")
	local vvBool = vv and vv.Value or false
	config:SetAttribute("VelocityVectored", vvBool)
	-- VelocityVectored becomes DirMode: true -> "Local", false -> "RigidLocal".
	config:SetAttribute("DirMode", vvBool and "Local" or "RigidLocal")
	local im = factors:FindFirstChild("InvertMotion")
	config:SetAttribute("InvertMotion", im and im.Value or false)
	local en = factors:FindFirstChild("Enabled")
	config:SetAttribute("Enabled", en and en.Value or false)
	local tkf = factors:FindFirstChild("TotalKeyFrames")
	config:SetAttribute("TotalKeyFrames", tkf and tkf.Value or 100)
	local pl = factors:FindFirstChild("PartLife")
	config:SetAttribute("PartLife", pl and pl.Value or 0)
	config:SetAttribute("RotMode", factors:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife")

	local rt = factors:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if rt then rt.Parent = item end
	local mf = factors:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
	if mf then mf.Parent = item end

	_fillDefaults(config, typeDef)
	config.Parent = item
	factors.Parent = nil
	item:SetAttribute("IsBaked", nil)
end

function Convert.convertUnbakedBeam(item, factors, migrateGraphBlender)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Beam
	local config = Instance.new("Configuration")
	config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME

	local lt = factors:FindFirstChild("LifeTime")
	if lt then
		config:SetAttribute("BeamLifetime", lt.Lifetime)
		config:SetAttribute("Rate", lt.Rate)
	end

	local tkf = factors:FindFirstChild("TotalKeyFrames")
	config:SetAttribute("TotalKeyFrames", tkf and tkf.Value or 100)
	local en = factors:FindFirstChild("Enabled")
	config:SetAttribute("Enabled", en and en.Value or false)

	local props = factors:FindFirstChild("Properties")
	if props then
		local propMap = {
			Brightness = "BeamBrightness", CurveSize0 = "CurveSize0", CurveSize1 = "CurveSize1",
			Width0 = "Width0", Width1 = "Width1", LightEmission = "LightEmission",
			Segments = "Segments", TextureLength = "TextureLength", TextureSpeed = "TextureSpeed",
		}
		for childName, attrName in pairs(propMap) do
			local obj = props:FindFirstChild(childName)
			if obj then config:SetAttribute(attrName, obj.Size) end
		end
	end

	local fb = factors:FindFirstChild("Flipbook")
	if fb then
		config:SetAttribute("BeamFlipbookMode", fb.FlipbookMode.Name)
		config:SetAttribute("BeamFlipbookFramerate", fb.FlipbookFramerate)
		config:SetAttribute("BeamFlipbookStartRandom", fb.FlipbookStartRandom)
	end

	local rt = factors:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if rt then rt.Parent = item end
	local gb = factors:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
	if gb then
		local existingGb = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		if existingGb then existingGb.Parent = nil end
		gb.Parent = item
		migrateGraphBlender(gb)
	end
	local bf = factors:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks")
	if bf then bf.Parent = item end

	_fillDefaults(config, typeDef)
	config.Parent = item
	factors.Parent = nil
	item:SetAttribute("IsBaked", nil)
end

function Convert.convertUnbakedPointLight(item, factors)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.PointLight
	local config = Instance.new("Configuration")
	config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME

	local lt = factors:FindFirstChild("Lifetime")
	if lt then
		config:SetAttribute("Lifetime", lt.Lifetime)
		config:SetAttribute("Rate", lt.Rate)
	end

	local tkf = factors:FindFirstChild("TotalKeyFrames")
	config:SetAttribute("TotalKeyFrames", tkf and tkf.Value or 100)
	local en = factors:FindFirstChild("Enabled")
	config:SetAttribute("Enabled", en and en.Value or false)

	local range = factors:FindFirstChild("Range")
	if range then config:SetAttribute("PLRange", range.Size) end
	local brightness = factors:FindFirstChild("Brightness")
	if brightness then config:SetAttribute("PLBrightness", brightness.Size) end
	local color = factors:FindFirstChild("Color")
	if color then config:SetAttribute("PLColor", color.Color) end

	local rt = factors:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if rt then rt.Parent = item end

	_fillDefaults(config, typeDef)
	config.Parent = item
	factors.Parent = nil
	item:SetAttribute("IsBaked", nil)
end

-- Older physics units: Speed x10, Drag / average life, Acceleration x 10 / average life.

function Convert.convertPhysics(item)
	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return end
	if not item:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	local lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime")
	local avgLife = 1
	if lifetime and typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then
		avgLife = (lifetime.Min + lifetime.Max) / 2
		if avgLife <= 0 then avgLife = 1 end
	end

	local speedSeq = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
	if speedSeq and typeof(speedSeq) == "NumberSequence" then
		config:SetAttribute("Speed", scaleSequence(speedSeq, 10))
	end

	local drag = config:GetAttribute("Drag")
	if drag and type(drag) == "number" and drag ~= 0 then
		config:SetAttribute("Drag", drag / avgLife)
	end

	local accel = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration")
	if accel and typeof(accel) == "Vector3" and accel.Magnitude > 0 then
		config:SetAttribute("Acceleration", accel * (10 / avgLife))
	end
end

return Convert
