--[[
	Migrate/DecalLayers  -  moves a Part's old first-decal routing onto decal layers
	(Part/DecalLayers) with the look unchanged: the part's Transparency / Color / Brightness graphs
	become the first decal's Layer* graphs, the part graphs become the RenderTemplate's flat look,
	other decals stay hidden (LayerTransparency 1), and flat MeshFlipbooks frames move into
	sub-folder "1" for the first decal.
	Called by Migrate.fix and by the Decals panel for an old item. No requires.
]]

local CONFIG_NAME = "PartIcleProperties"

local MigrateDecalLayers = {}

local RIG_FLAGS = { "IsLightning", "IsCameraShake", "IsRocks", "IsRope", "IsDistortion", "IsContainer", "IsMatte", "IsForce", "IsReactor" }

local function isPartEmitter(item)
	if not item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Terrain") then return false end
	for _, flag in ipairs(RIG_FLAGS) do
		if item:GetAttribute(flag) == true then return false end
	end
	return true
end

local function decalsOf(rt)
	local decals = {}
	if not rt then return decals end
	for _, child in ipairs(rt:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then table.insert(decals, child) end
	end
	return decals
end

-- True while the item still routes its graphs to the first decal.
function MigrateDecalLayers.needs(item)
	if not isPartEmitter(item) then return false end
	local config = item:FindFirstChild(CONFIG_NAME)
	return config ~= nil and config:GetAttribute("DecalLayers") ~= true
end

-- Numbered frames directly under MeshFlipbooks become sub-folder "1", assigned to the first decal.
local function liftFlatFrames(item, firstDecal)
	local folder = item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
	if not folder then return end
	local frames = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then table.insert(frames, child) end
	end
	if #frames == 0 then return end
	local target = folder:FindFirstChild("1")
	if not target or not target:IsA("Folder") then
		target = Instance.new("Folder")
		target.Name = "1"
		target.Parent = folder
	end
	for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do frame.Parent = target end
	firstDecal:SetAttribute("LayerFlipbook", "1")
end

function MigrateDecalLayers.migrate(item)
	if not MigrateDecalLayers.needs(item) then return false end
	local config = item:FindFirstChild(CONFIG_NAME)
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	local decals = decalsOf(rt)
	local hasSurface = rt ~= nil and rt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance") ~= nil
	if not hasSurface and decals[1] then
		local first = decals[1]
		local transparency = config:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		local color = config:GetAttribute("Color")
		local brightness = config:GetAttribute("Brightness")
		if typeof(transparency) == "NumberSequence" then first:SetAttribute("LayerTransparency", transparency) end
		if typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then first:SetAttribute("LayerColor", color) end
		if typeof(brightness) == "NumberSequence" then first:SetAttribute("LayerBrightness", brightness) end
		for i = 2, #decals do decals[i]:SetAttribute("LayerTransparency", NumberSequence.new(1)) end
		-- The mesh keeps the look the RenderTemplate had while the decal carried the animation.
		config:SetAttribute("Transparency", NumberSequence.new(rt.Transparency))
		config:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(rt.Color))
		config:SetAttribute("Brightness", NumberSequence.new(1))
		liftFlatFrames(item, first)
	elseif not hasSurface then
		-- Plain mesh: Brightness scales the mesh colour in this format, so 1 keeps the look.
		config:SetAttribute("Brightness", NumberSequence.new(1))
	end
	config:SetAttribute("DecalLayers", true)
	return true
end

return MigrateDecalLayers

--[[
	Migrate/Drag  -  moves an item's Drag from the plugin's first drag model to Roblox's
	(Part/DragModel) without changing how it moves: the number is rewritten (1 becomes 1.4427) and
	the config is marked, after which the runtime reads it the Roblox way.
	  Drag.needs(item) -> boolean     an unmarked item whose drag is not 0: what Fix reports
	  Drag.migrate(item) -> boolean   converts and marks; true when anything was written
	An unmarked item with no drag is marked silently; a marked item is never converted again.
	Mutates the LIVE item's config. Mesh Parts, Attachments and Models store "Drag", image particles
	"ImgDrag"; Lightning's and Rope's "Drag" is damping and is left alone.
]]

local DragModel = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.DragModel)

local DRAG_KEYS = { "Drag", "ImgDrag" }
local CONFIG_NAME = "PartIcleProperties"

local Drag = {}

-- The config whose drag is particle drag, or nil.
local function particleConfig(item)
	if item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") or item:GetAttribute("IsRope") then
		return nil
	end
	return item:FindFirstChild(CONFIG_NAME)
end

function Drag.needs(item)
	local config = particleConfig(item)
	if not config or DragModel.isRoblox(config) then
		return false
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(DRAG_KEYS) do
		local drag = config:GetAttribute(key)
		if type(drag) == "number" and drag ~= 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Drag.migrate(item)
	local config = particleConfig(item)
	if not config or DragModel.isRoblox(config) then
		return false
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(DRAG_KEYS) do
		local drag = config:GetAttribute(key)
		if type(drag) == "number" and drag ~= 0 then
			config:SetAttribute(key, DragModel.toRoblox(drag))
		end
	end
	DragModel.mark(config)
	return true
end

return Drag

--[[
	Migrate/GraphBlender  -  a Beam's GraphBlender in its two older shapes.
	  hasIssues(gb)  true when the folder holds the TransparencyGraphs / ColorGraphs layout or a
	                 state lacks Time, Transparency or Color
	  migrate(gb)    rewrites it as one Configuration per state; true when anything changed
	Called by Migrate (getIssues, fix) and handed to Migrate/Convert for Beams. No requires.
]]

local GraphBlender = {}

function GraphBlender.hasIssues(gb)
	if not gb then return false end
	if gb:FindFirstChild("TransparencyGraphs") or gb:FindFirstChild("ColorGraphs") then return true end
	for _, child in ipairs(gb:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("Configuration") then
		if child:GetAttribute("Time") == nil or child:GetAttribute("Transparency") == nil or child:GetAttribute("Color") == nil then return true end
	end end
	return false
end

function GraphBlender.migrate(gb)
	if not gb then return false end
	local converted = false
	local tg = gb:FindFirstChild("TransparencyGraphs")
	local cg = gb:FindFirstChild("ColorGraphs")
	-- The folder layout: rebuilt as one Configuration per state.
	if tg or cg then
		local allNames = {}
		-- Folders, or Configurations from a hand edit.
		if tg then for _, f in ipairs(tg:GetChildren()) do if f:IsA("Folder") or f:IsA("Configuration") then allNames[f.Name] = true end end end
		if cg then for _, f in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do if f:IsA("Folder") or f:IsA("Configuration") then allNames[f.Name] = true end end end
		local sorted = {}; for name in pairs(allNames) do table.insert(sorted, name) end
		table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a) or 0) < (tonumber(b) or 0) end)

		-- Each state's Time is the DurationOfBlend before it over the total, across the sorted states.
		-- With no DurationOfBlend anywhere the states are spaced evenly.
		local durations = {}
		local total = 0
		for _, name in ipairs(sorted) do
			local d
			local tf = tg and tg:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
			local cf = cg and cg:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
			local dv = (tf and tf:FindFirstChild("DurationOfBlend")) or (cf and cf:FindFirstChild("DurationOfBlend"))
			if dv and dv:IsA("NumberValue") then d = dv.Value end
			durations[name] = d or 0
			total = total + (d or 0)
		end

		local cumulative = 0
		for i, name in ipairs(sorted) do
			local trans = NumberSequence.new(0); local color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1))
			local time
			if total > 0 then
				time = (i == 1) and 0 or cumulative / total
			else
				time = (#sorted == 1) and 0 or (i - 1) / (#sorted - 1)
			end
			if tg then local tf = tg:FindFirstChild(name); if tf then
				if tf:GetAttribute("Time") ~= nil then time = tf:GetAttribute("Time") end
				local pe = tf:FindFirstChild("Transparency") or tf:FindFirstChildOfClass("ParticleEmitter")
				if pe then trans = pe.Transparency end
			end end
			if cg then local cf = cg:FindFirstChild(name); if cf then
				local pe = cf:FindFirstChild("Color") or cf:FindFirstChildOfClass("ParticleEmitter")
				if pe then color = pe.Color end
			end end
			local cfg = Instance.new("Configuration"); cfg.Name = name
			cfg:SetAttribute("Time", time); cfg:SetAttribute("Transparency", trans); cfg:SetAttribute("Color", color)
			cfg.Parent = gb
			cumulative = cumulative + durations[name]
		end
		-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
		if tg then tg.Parent = nil end; if cg then cg.Parent = nil end
		converted = true
	end
	-- Every state gets the attributes it lacks.
	local configs = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(gb:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("Configuration") then table.insert(configs, child) end end
	table.sort(configs, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a.Name) or 0) < (tonumber(b.Name) or 0) end)
	for i, cfg in ipairs(configs) do
		if cfg:GetAttribute("Time") == nil then
			cfg:SetAttribute("Time", #configs == 1 and 0 or (i-1)/(#configs-1))
			cfg:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true) -- a default: Add State may respace it
			converted = true
		end
		if cfg:GetAttribute("Transparency") == nil then cfg:SetAttribute("Transparency", NumberSequence.new(0)); converted = true end
		if cfg:GetAttribute("Color") == nil then cfg:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1))); converted = true end
	end
	return converted
end

return GraphBlender

-- MotionPreview  -  draws the paths the selected emitters' particles take, as LineHandleAdornments.
-- Transformed items use PreSimulateForward, native PEs Part/NativeMotion. Refreshes live, debounced.

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Part.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Part.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.Part.AxisLinks)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.Part.LinkCF)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.Part.VisualHost)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Part.PartConstants)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Part.Log)
local NativeMotion = require(script.Parent.Part.NativeMotion)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local shapeFunctions = Constants.shapeFunctions

local SEGMENT_COUNT = 30
local MAX_ITEMS = 100
local DEBOUNCE = 0.08
-- Steps are capped whatever TotalKeyFrames is: the cost grows with selection x variants, and only
-- SEGMENT_COUNT points are drawn.
local PREVIEW_MAX_STEPS = 60

-- About 20 paths in all: 20 for one item, falling to 1 each past 20 items.
local function variantCount(selectionCount)
	local n = math.max(1, selectionCount or 1)
	return math.max(1, math.min(20, math.floor(20 / n)))
end

-- The largest value plus envelope at any keypoint.
local function maxSpeedOf(seq)
	if not seq or not seq.Keypoints then return 0 end
	local m = 0
	for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do local v = math.abs(kp.Value) + (kp.Envelope or 0); if v > m then m = v end end
	return m
end

return function(ctx)
	local Particle = ctx.Part
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry

	local M = {}
	local _enabled = false
	local _folder = nil
	local _pool = {}
	local _poolUsed = 0
	local _arrowPool = {}
	local _arrowPoolUsed = 0
	local _arrows = {}             -- per-arrow data {tip, dir}; lines are at _arrowPool[i*2-1] and [i*2]
	local _arrowsUsed = 0
	local _cameraConn = nil        -- RenderStepped connection that re-aims arrows at the camera
	local _conns = {}
	local _debounce = nil

	local ARROW_SPACING, ARROW_HEAD_LEN, ARROW_HEAD_WIDTH = 5, 0.35, 0.22
	local LINE_COLOR, ARROW_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)

	-- A folder left by a plugin that ended without cleanup is removed by Modules/Leftovers, by this name.
	local function ensureFolder()
		if _folder then return _folder end
		_folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		_folder.Name = "MotionPreview"; _folder.Archivable = false
		_folder.Parent = VisualHost.root()
		return _folder
	end

	local function newLine(thickness, color, transparency)
		local line = Instance.new("LineHandleAdornment")
		line.Adornee = workspace.Terrain; line.Archivable = false; line.AlwaysOnTop = false
		line.Thickness = thickness; line.Color3 = color; line.Transparency = transparency
		line.Parent = ensureFolder()
		return line
	end

	local function getLine(idx)
		local line = _pool[idx]
		if not line then line = newLine(3, LINE_COLOR, 0.5); _pool[idx] = line end
		return line
	end

	local function getArrowLine(idx)
		local line = _arrowPool[idx]
		if not line then line = newLine(2, ARROW_COLOR, 0.4); _arrowPool[idx] = line end
		return line
	end

	local function hideExtra()
		for i = _poolUsed + 1, #_pool do _pool[i].Visible = false end
		for i = _arrowPoolUsed + 1, #_arrowPool do _arrowPool[i].Visible = false end
	end

	local function setSegment(fromPos, toPos)
		local mag = (toPos - fromPos).Magnitude
		if mag < 0.001 then return end
		_poolUsed += 1
		local line = getLine(_poolUsed)
		line.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(fromPos, toPos)
		line.Length = mag; line.Visible = true
	end

	local function setArrow(fromPos, toPos)
		local delta = toPos - fromPos
		local mag = delta.Magnitude
		if mag < 0.001 then return end
		_arrowsUsed += 1
		_arrows[_arrowsUsed] = { fromPos + delta * 0.5, delta / mag }
	end

	local function updateArrows()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; if not cam then return end
		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		for i = 1, _arrowsUsed do
			local a = _arrows[i]; local tip, dir = a[1], a[2]
			local toCam = camPos - tip
			if toCam.Magnitude < 0.001 then continue end
			local right = dir:Cross(toCam)
			if right.Magnitude < 0.001 then right = dir:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) end
			if right.Magnitude < 0.001 then right = dir:Cross(Vector3.xAxis) end
			right = right.Unit
			local back = tip - dir * ARROW_HEAD_LEN
			local e1 = back + right * ARROW_HEAD_WIDTH
			local e2 = back - right * ARROW_HEAD_WIDTH
			local la = getArrowLine(i*2 - 1); la.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(tip, e1); la.Length = (e1-tip).Magnitude; la.Visible = true
			local lb = getArrowLine(i*2);     lb.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(tip, e2); lb.Length = (e2-tip).Magnitude; lb.Visible = true
		end
		_arrowPoolUsed = _arrowsUsed * 2
	end

	local function clearConns()
		for _, c in ipairs(_conns) do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
		_conns = {}
	end

	local function addConn(conn) if conn then table.insert(_conns, conn) end end

	local function getItemOrigin(item)
		if item:IsA("Attachment") then return item.WorldCFrame end
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then return item.CFrame end
		if item:IsA("Model") then return item:GetPivot() end
		return CFrame.new()
	end

	-- Nearest BasePart ancestor: the frame Attachment visuals compose in (EmitAttachment walk-up).
	local function findBasePartAncestor(inst)
		local node = inst.Parent
		while node do
			if node:IsA("BasePart") then return node end
			node = node.Parent
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- Spread exactly as the live emit paths build it (same lookAt, no up hint).
	local function applySpread(baseDirection, spreadAngle)
		local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
		if spreadAngle.X > 0 or spreadAngle.Y > 0 then
			randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spreadAngle.X
			randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spreadAngle.Y
		end
		local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)
		local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection) * spreadRotation
		return cf.LookVector, spreadRotation
	end

	-- Kept alike by hand: buildPartSetup mirrors EmitPart (Emit.luau) and EmitModel, with their Animate
	-- twins; buildAttachmentSetup mirrors EmitAttachment. A change there (link spawn frame, shape
	-- offset, DirMode, RotXYZ / PosOffset order, spread) is made here too, or the preview drifts.
	local function buildPartSetup(item, data, link, previewCtx)
		local itemCF = getItemOrigin(item)
		local unrotatedCF = link and LinkCF.spawnFrame(data.LinkMode, link, item, itemCF, nil, nil, data.LinkAxes) or itemCF
		local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
		local rawWorldDirection = unrotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		local initialCF = unrotatedCF
		local shapeDir = nil

		-- Shape offset (Parts only); ShapePart override samples in that part's frame.
		if item:IsA("BasePart") and data.UseShape and data.ParticleData.Shape then
			local shapeFunc = shapeFunctions[data.ParticleData.Shape]
			if shapeFunc then
				local shapeSrc = data.ShapePart or item
				local shapeCF = data.ShapePart and data.ShapePart.CFrame or unrotatedCF
				local sOffset, sRotation, sDirVec = shapeFunc(shapeSrc, data.ParticleData)
				local sio = data.ParticleData.ShapeInOut
				if sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward then
					sDirVec = -sDirVec
				elseif sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut then
					if math.random() < 0.5 then sDirVec = -sDirVec end
				end
				shapeDir = (shapeCF - shapeCF.Position):VectorToWorldSpace(sDirVec)
				if data.ParticleData.LookAtInitially then
					local rx, ry, rz = initialCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
					initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(sOffset)).Position) * sRotation * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
				else
					initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(sOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
				end
			end
		end

		local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
		local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, previewCtx)
		local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ)
		initialCF = initialCF * rotXYZ
		initialCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(initialCF, data, link, item, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, previewCtx)
		if dirMode == "Global" then
			initialCF = CFrame.new(initialCF.Position) * rotXYZ
		end

		local baseDirection
		if shapeDir then
			baseDirection = shapeDir
		elseif dirMode == "Local" then
			baseDirection = initialCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		elseif dirMode == "Global" then
			baseDirection = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		else
			baseDirection = rawWorldDirection
		end
		local direction, spreadRotation = applySpread(baseDirection, data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle)
		return initialCF, direction, spreadRotation, rotXYZ
	end

	-- Attachment: sim runs in the nearest BasePart ancestor's space (identity when none).
	local function buildAttachmentSetup(item, data, link, previewCtx)
		local sourceWorldCF = item.WorldCFrame
		local worldCF = link and LinkCF.spawnFrame(data.LinkMode, link, item, sourceWorldCF, nil, nil, data.LinkAxes) or sourceWorldCF
		local anchor = findBasePartAncestor(item)
		local anchorCF = anchor and anchor.CFrame or CFrame.new()
		local localCF = anchorCF:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
		local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]

		local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
		local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, previewCtx)
		local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ)
		local rotatedLocalCF = localCF * rotXYZ

		local baseDirection
		if dirMode == "Local" then
			baseDirection = rotatedLocalCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		elseif dirMode == "Global" then
			local worldAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			baseDirection = anchor and anchorCF:VectorToObjectSpace(worldAxis) or worldAxis
		else
			baseDirection = localCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		end

		localCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(rotatedLocalCF, data, link, item, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, previewCtx, anchorCF)
		if dirMode == "Global" then
			localCF = CFrame.new(localCF.Position) * anchorCF.Rotation:Inverse() * rotXYZ
		end
		local direction, spreadRotation = applySpread(baseDirection, data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle)
		return localCF, direction, spreadRotation, rotXYZ, anchorCF
	end

	local function trackTransformed(item, data, link)
		local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		if cfg then addConn(cfg.AttributeChanged:Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end)) end
		if item:IsA("Attachment") then
			addConn(item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WorldCFrame"):Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end))
		elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then
			addConn(item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end))
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then
			addConn(item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WorldPivot"):Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end))
		end
		if link then
			local sig = link:IsA("Attachment") and "WorldCFrame" or "CFrame"
			local ok, conn = pcall(function()
				return link:GetPropertyChangedSignal(sig):Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end)
			end)
			if ok then addConn(conn) end
		end
	end

	local function trackPE(pe)
		local props = {"Speed","Acceleration","Drag","SpreadAngle","Lifetime","Rotation","EmissionDirection",
			"Shape","ShapeInOut","ShapePartial","ShapeStyle"}
		for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
			local ok, conn = pcall(function()
				return pe:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end)
			end)
			if ok then addConn(conn) end
		end
		if pe.Parent and pe.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			addConn(pe.Parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end))
			addConn(pe.Parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function() M.refreshDebounced() end))
		end
	end

	local function drawForTransformed(item, variants)
		if not item:GetAttribute("IsEmitter") then return end
		local data = Particle:GetData(item)
		if not data then return end
		-- Skipped when nothing moves: max Speed under 1 stud/s, no acceleration and no PosOffset graph
		-- (PosOffset moves particles without Speed).
		local accelMag = data.ParticleData and data.ParticleData.Acceleration and data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude or 0
		local speedMax = data.Speed and maxSpeedOf(data.Speed) or 0
		local hasPosOffset = (data.PosOffsetX and maxSpeedOf(data.PosOffsetX) > 0)
			or (data.PosOffsetY and maxSpeedOf(data.PosOffsetY) > 0)
			or (data.PosOffsetZ and maxSpeedOf(data.PosOffsetZ) > 0)
		if speedMax < 1 and accelMag == 0 and not hasPosOffset then return end
		local link = data.Link
		trackTransformed(item, data, link)

		local isAttachment = item:IsA("Attachment")

		for variantIdx = 1, variants do
			local time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
			if not time or time <= 0 then continue end

			local previewCtx = { EmitIndex = variantIdx, EmitCount = variants }
			local initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, rotXYZ, anchorCF
			if isAttachment then
				initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, rotXYZ, anchorCF = buildAttachmentSetup(item, data, link, previewCtx)
			else
				initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, rotXYZ = buildPartSetup(item, data, link, previewCtx)
			end
			local seeds = {
				Speed = data.Speed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed) or {},
				RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX) or {},
				RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY) or {},
				RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ) or {},
				PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX) or {},
				PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY) or {},
				PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ) or {},
				AccelStrength = data.AccelStrength and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.AccelStrength) or {},
			}
			if AxisLinksMod and data.AxisLinks then
				AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)
			end

			-- With a step cap, PreSimulate{,Attachment}Forward returns (localCFrames, effectiveTkf); the stride
			-- comes from that tkf. spawnEmitterRotation keeps RigidLocal displacement in the emitter frame.
			local spawnEmitterRotation = initialCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse()
			local localCFrames, effectiveTkf
			if isAttachment then
				localCFrames, effectiveTkf = Particle:PreSimulateAttachmentForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, time, PREVIEW_MAX_STEPS, spawnEmitterRotation)
			else
				localCFrames, effectiveTkf = Particle:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, time, PREVIEW_MAX_STEPS, spawnEmitterRotation, nil, data.LinkAxes and getItemOrigin(item) or nil)
			end
			if not localCFrames then continue end
			local tkf = effectiveTkf or (data.TotalKeyFrames or 100)
			local stride = math.max(1, math.floor(tkf / SEGMENT_COUNT))

			local parentCF = isAttachment and anchorCF or LinkCF.emitParentFrame(data.LinkMode, link, nil, data.LinkAxes, getItemOrigin(item))
			local start = localCFrames[0]
			local prev = start and (parentCF * start).Position or initialCF.Position
			local lastStepDrawn = 0
			local accumDist = 0
			local nextArrowAt = ARROW_SPACING
			for step = stride, tkf, stride do
				local lcf = localCFrames[step]
				if lcf then
					local worldPos = (parentCF * lcf).Position
					setSegment(prev, worldPos)
					accumDist += (worldPos - prev).Magnitude
					if accumDist >= nextArrowAt then setArrow(prev, worldPos); nextArrowAt += ARROW_SPACING end
					prev = worldPos; lastStepDrawn = step
				end
			end
			if lastStepDrawn < tkf and localCFrames[tkf] then
				local endPos = (parentCF * localCFrames[tkf]).Position
				setSegment(prev, endPos)
			end
		end
	end

	-- A native PE's spawn point and base direction. Box: +/- EmissionDirection (the face normal).
	-- Sphere / Cylinder / Disc: radial for Outward / Inward. InAndOut keeps EmissionDirection.
	local function sampleNativePEShape(pe, parent, parentCF, defaultBaseDir)
		if not parent:IsA("BasePart") then return parentCF.Position, defaultBaseDir end
		local shape = pe.Shape
		local style = pe.ShapeStyle
		local inOut = pe.ShapeInOut
		local size = parent.Size

		if shape == Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box then
			local hx, hy, hz = size.X / 2, size.Y / 2, size.Z / 2
			local x = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * hx
			local y = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * hy
			local z = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * hz
			if style == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface then
				local ed = pe.EmissionDirection
				if ed == Enum.NormalId.Top then y = hy
				elseif ed == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then y = -hy
				elseif ed == Enum.NormalId.Front then z = -hz
				elseif ed == Enum.NormalId.Back then z = hz
				elseif ed == Enum.NormalId.Right then x = hx
				elseif ed == Enum.NormalId.Left then x = -hx end
			end
			local origin = (parentCF * CFrame.new(x, y, z)).Position
			local baseDir = (inOut == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward) and -defaultBaseDir or defaultBaseDir
			return origin, baseDir
		end

		local shapeFunc = shapeFunctions[shape]
		if not shapeFunc then return parentCF.Position, defaultBaseDir end
		local localOffset
		-- Surface mode: shell-only sampling for Sphere / Cylinder / Disc.
		if style == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface then
			local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
			if shape == Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere then
				local r = size.X / 2
				local theta = angle
				local phi = math.acos((math.random() * 2) - 1)
				localOffset = Vector3.new(
					math.sin(phi) * math.cos(theta) * r,
					math.sin(phi) * math.sin(theta) * r,
					math.cos(phi) * r
				)
			elseif shape == Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Cylinder then
				local r = size.X / 2
				local h = size.Y
				localOffset = Vector3.new(
					r * math.cos(angle),
					(math.random() * 2 - 1) * (h / 2),
					r * math.sin(angle)
				)
			elseif shape == Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Disc then
				local r = size.X / 2
				localOffset = Vector3.new(r * math.cos(angle), 0, r * math.sin(angle))
			else
				localOffset = shapeFunc(parent, pe)
			end
		else
			localOffset = shapeFunc(parent, pe)
		end
		local origin = (parentCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position
		local baseDir = defaultBaseDir
		if inOut == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward then
			local radial = origin - parentCF.Position
			if radial.Magnitude > 0.0001 then baseDir = radial.Unit end
		elseif inOut == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward then
			local radial = parentCF.Position - origin
			if radial.Magnitude > 0.0001 then baseDir = radial.Unit end
		end
		return origin, baseDir
	end

	-- A native PE's path in closed form (Part/NativeMotion: Drag is a half-life, on Acceleration's
	-- share too). Not modelled: VelocityInheritance, wind, LockedToPart.
	local function drawForPE(pe, variants)
		local parent = pe.Parent
		local parentCF
		local parentIsPart = parent and parent:IsA("BasePart")
		if parentIsPart then parentCF = parent.CFrame
		elseif parent and parent:IsA("Attachment") then parentCF = parent.WorldCFrame
		else return end
		local accelMag = (pe.Acceleration and pe.Acceleration.Magnitude) or 0
		if (pe.Speed.Max or 0) < 1 and accelMag == 0 then return end
		trackPE(pe)

		local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pe.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
		local defaultBaseDir = parentCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		local drag = pe.Drag or 0
		local accel = pe.Acceleration or Vector3.new()
		local spread = pe.SpreadAngle
		local lf = pe.Lifetime; local sp = pe.Speed

		for _ = 1, variants do
			local time = lf.Min + (lf.Max - lf.Min) * math.random()
			if time <= 0 then continue end
			local speed = sp.Min + (sp.Max - sp.Min) * math.random()

			local origin, baseDir = sampleNativePEShape(pe, parent, parentCF, defaultBaseDir)

			local rx = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X
			local ry = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y
			-- Explicit upHint avoids CFrame.lookAt's degenerate frame when baseDir is near-vertical.
			local upHint = (math.abs(baseDir.Y) > 0.999) and Vector3.xAxis or Vector3.yAxis
			-- Random spin around baseDir so the spread fans out, as a native PE's does.
			local azimuth = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			local frameCF = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDir, upHint) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, azimuth)
			local dir = (frameCF * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx), math.rad(ry), 0)).LookVector

			local stepDT = time / SEGMENT_COUNT
			local pos, prev = origin, origin
			local accumDist = 0
			local nextArrowAt = ARROW_SPACING
			local velocity = dir * speed
			for step = 1, SEGMENT_COUNT do
				local velocityShare, accelerationShare = NativeMotion.shares(drag, step * stepDT)
				pos = origin + velocity * velocityShare + accel * accelerationShare
				setSegment(prev, pos)
				accumDist += (pos - prev).Magnitude
				if accumDist >= nextArrowAt then setArrow(prev, pos); nextArrowAt += ARROW_SPACING end
				prev = pos
			end
		end
	end

	function M.refresh()
		-- A folder removed from outside (Studio replaced the camera) took its lines with it.
		if _folder and not _folder.Parent then
			_folder = nil
			_pool = {}
			_arrowPool = {}
		end
		_poolUsed = 0
		_arrowsUsed = 0
		clearConns()
		if not _enabled then _arrowPoolUsed = 0; hideExtra(); return end

		local eligibleTransformed = {}
		-- Types that do not move (Beam, PointLight, Trail, screen types) are skipped.
		for _, item in ipairs(ctx.currentTransformed or {}) do
			if not (item:IsA("Beam") or item:IsA("Light") or item:IsA("Sound") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Highlight") or item:IsA("PostProcessEffect") or item:IsA("Atmosphere") or item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") or item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") or item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") or item:GetAttribute("IsRope") or item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") or item:GetAttribute("IsContainer") or item:GetAttribute("IsMatte") or item:GetAttribute("IsForce") or item:GetAttribute("IsReactor")) then
				table.insert(eligibleTransformed, item)
			end
		end
		local selectionCount = #eligibleTransformed + #(ctx.selectedPEs or {})
		local variants = variantCount(selectionCount)
		local count = 0
		for _, item in ipairs(eligibleTransformed) do
			if count >= MAX_ITEMS then break end
			count += 1
			local ok, err = pcall(drawForTransformed, item, variants)
			if not ok then Log.warn("[MotionPreview] " .. tostring(item:GetFullName()) .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
		end
		for _, pe in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs or {}) do
			if count >= MAX_ITEMS then break end
			count += 1
			local ok, err = pcall(drawForPE, pe, variants)
			if not ok then Log.warn("[MotionPreview] PE " .. tostring(pe:GetFullName()) .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
		end
		updateArrows()
		hideExtra()
	end

	function M.refreshDebounced()
		if _debounce then task.cancel(_debounce); _debounce = nil end
		_debounce = task.delay(DEBOUNCE, function() _debounce = nil; M.refresh() end)
	end

	function M.setEnabled(on)
		_enabled = on
		if on and not _cameraConn then
			_cameraConn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(updateArrows)
		elseif not on and _cameraConn then
			_cameraConn:Disconnect(); _cameraConn = nil
		end
		M.refresh()
	end

	function M.isEnabled() return _enabled end

	function M.cleanup()
		_enabled = false
		clearConns()
		if _cameraConn then _cameraConn:Disconnect(); _cameraConn = nil end
		if _debounce then task.cancel(_debounce); _debounce = nil end
		if _folder then pcall(_folder.Destroy, _folder); _folder = nil end
		_pool = {}; _poolUsed = 0
		_arrowPool = {}; _arrowPoolUsed = 0
		_arrows = {}; _arrowsUsed = 0
	end

	return M
end

--[[
	The selection's optimization score, 0 (ideal) to 100 (very heavy): the cost of every instance
	alive at once, summed, over MAX_COST.
	Each item has a base cost per live instance (getBaseCost: a native PE 2.0 plus 0.02 a particle,
	a mesh 0.5, a light 0.8 and x2.5 with Shadows, a Highlight 1.5, ...) times its multipliers
	(getItemMult: CastShadow x2, transparency x1.3, flipbook frames, un-pooled continuous emits
	x1.25). Nested part-icles multiply through their parents. Enabled emits Rate x average life at
	once, a burst EmitCount; EmitDuration caps the window and PartLife lengthens it.
	MAX_COST = 600: 40 meshes and 150 light PEs score about 25-35 (green), 250 PEs at Rate 20 and
	Life 2 about 85-100 (red).
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry)

local OptCalc = {}

local MAX_COST = 600
local GREEN  = Color3.fromRGB(139, 195, 74)
local YELLOW = Color3.fromRGB(255, 193, 7)
local RED    = Color3.fromRGB(244, 67, 54)

function OptCalc.getColor(score)
	if score <= 30 then return GREEN
	elseif score <= 60 then return YELLOW
	else return RED end
end

local function maxOf(v, default)
	if typeof(v) == "NumberRange" then return v.Max end
	if typeof(v) == "string" then
		local best = nil
		for token in v:gmatch("[%d%.]+") do
			local n = tonumber(token)
			if n and (not best or n > best) then best = n end
		end
		if best then return best end
	end
	return typeof(v) == "number" and v or default
end

-- Raw ParticleEmitter: 2.0 per instance + 0.02 per particle (burst + continuous window).
local function peCost(pe)
	local avgLife = (pe.Lifetime.Min + pe.Lifetime.Max) / 2
	local burst = math.max(0, pe:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 1)
	local duration = maxOf(pe:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"), 0)
	local continuous = 0
	if pe.Enabled then
		continuous = pe.Rate * avgLife
	elseif duration > 0 then
		continuous = pe.Rate * math.min(avgLife, duration)
	end
	return 2.0 + (burst + continuous) * 0.02
end

-- Raw Trail: segment shader + per-frame draw, weighted by Lifetime (strip retention) and the active window.
local function trailCost(trail)
	local life = (typeof(trail.Lifetime) == "number" and trail.Lifetime) or 0.5
	local duration = maxOf(trail:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"), 0)
	local activeFactor = (duration > 0) and math.min(duration, 5) or 1
	return 1.5 + life * activeFactor * 0.4
end

-- Raw Beam: 0.5 + segments/20.
local function beamCost(beam)
	return 0.5 + (beam.Segments or 10) / 20
end

local function getBaseCost(item, config, rt)
	-- A Force is a few sums per frame; a Reactor costs nothing until it is pushed.
	if item:GetAttribute("IsForce") or item:GetAttribute("IsReactor") then
		return 0.05
	elseif item:IsA("Model") then
		local partCount = 0
		if rt then for _, d in ipairs(rt:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then partCount += 1 end end end
		return 0.5 * math.max(1, partCount)
	elseif item:GetAttribute("IsMatte") then
		-- One more picture of its shapes each frame; the shapes are costed as the meshes they are.
		return 0.5
	elseif item:GetAttribute("IsContainer") then
		-- A few property writes per driven emitter per frame; the emitters' particles are the engine's.
		local emitterCount = 0
		if rt then for _, d in ipairs(rt:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then emitterCount += 1 end end end
		return 0.1 * math.max(1, emitterCount)
	elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
		return 0.3
	elseif item:IsA("Beam") then
		local segs = config:GetAttribute("Segments"); local avgSeg = 10
		if typeof(segs) == "NumberSequence" and #segs.Keypoints > 0 then avgSeg = segs.Keypoints[1].Value end
		return 0.5 + avgSeg / 20
	elseif item:IsA("Light") then
		-- Per-light rendering cost; shadow-casting lights render their own maps.
		local shadows = (rt and rt:IsA("Light") and rt.Shadows) or item.Shadows
		return 0.8 * (shadows and 2.5 or 1)
	elseif item:IsA("Highlight") then
		-- Post-process outline pass; the engine hard-caps 31 concurrent Highlights.
		return 1.5
	elseif item:IsA("Sound") then
		-- One Sound instance per emit; mixing cost only.
		return 0.1
	elseif item:IsA("BlurEffect") or item:IsA("BloomEffect") or item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		return 1.0
	elseif item:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		return 0.5
	elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		return 0.3
	elseif item:IsA("Trail") then
		-- TrailEmitter: strip retention scales with trail Lifetime.
		local life = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("TEmitTrailLife") or config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or item.Lifetime, 0.5)
		return 1.2 + life * 0.4
	elseif item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") then
		-- One anchored copy per segment, plus forks. Geometry re-rolls at JitterRate Hz dominate
		-- (normalized at the 15 Hz default); scroll modes also rewrite every frame.
		local segs = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("SegmentCount"), 12)
		local fc = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("ForkChance"), 0)
		local fd = math.min(maxOf(config:GetAttribute("ForkDepth"), 0), 2)
		local fs = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("ForkLengthScale"), 0.4)
		local effSegs = segs + segs * fc * fs * fd * 4
		local jitterHz = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("JitterRate"), 15)
		local jitterMult = 0.6 + math.min(jitterHz, 60) / 15 * 0.4
		local scrollMult = (config:GetAttribute("ShapeMode") or "Jitter") ~= "Jitter" and 1.3 or 1
		return 0.4 * math.max(1, effSegs) * jitterMult * scrollMult
	elseif item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") then
		-- Six noise samples + one shared camera write per frame; no instances.
		return 0.2
	elseif item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") then
		-- Edit: set trajectories, idle once rested. Running: native rigid bodies that sleep when settled.
		local maxChunks = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("ChunkCount"), 10)
		return 0.4 * math.max(1, maxChunks)
	elseif item:GetAttribute("IsRope") then
		-- Verlet substeps + Stiffness relaxation iterations over SegmentCount points.
		local maxSegs = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("SegmentCount"), 12)
		local stiffness = config:GetAttribute("Stiffness") or 4
		return 0.4 * math.max(1, maxSegs) * (1 + stiffness / 10)
	elseif item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") then
		-- One shared screen canvas, its vertex grid rewritten per frame: Resolution^2 against the 24 default.
		local resolution = config:GetAttribute("Resolution") or 24
		local gridScale = math.clamp((resolution / 24) ^ 2, 0.25, 16)
		return 1.2 * gridScale
	end
	return 0.5
end

-- Instances alive at once, capped by EmitDuration. At least 1 for an active item; 0 for an idle
-- one (EmitCount 0, not Enabled, no duration), so an idle place raises no warning.
local function getSimultaneous(item, config)
	local rawEmitCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 0
	local rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
	local lifetime
	if item:IsA("Beam") then lifetime = config:GetAttribute("BeamLifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
	else lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1) end
	local avgLife = if typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then (lifetime.Min + lifetime.Max) / 2 else 1
	-- Linger (PartLife) keeps the visual alive past its sim life.
	local partLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife")
	if typeof(partLife) == "number" and partLife > 0 then
		avgLife = avgLife + partLife
	end

	local enabled = config:GetAttribute("Enabled")
	local emitDuration = item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration") or 0
	if typeof(emitDuration) == "string" then emitDuration = tonumber(emitDuration:match("[%d%.]+")) or 0 end

	-- Animate mode uses AnimateLoop attribute, not config.Enabled.
	local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode")
	local animateActive = emissionMode == "Animate" and item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == true
	if animateActive then return 1 end

	if rawEmitCount == 0 and not enabled and emitDuration == 0 then return 0 end

	-- EmitCount is the first burst only: the continuous part is Rate x average life, not times EmitCount.
	local emitCount = math.max(0, rawEmitCount)
	if enabled then
		return emitCount + rate * avgLife
	elseif emitDuration > 0 then
		local effectiveLife = math.min(avgLife, emitDuration)
		return emitCount + rate * effectiveLife
	else
		return math.max(1, emitCount)
	end
end

-- TotalKeyFrames x CastShadow x Transparency x Flipbook x churn, for top-level and nested items
-- alike (a nested shadow-casting light is costed on its own).
local function getItemMult(item, config, rt)
	local tkf = config:GetAttribute("TotalKeyFrames") or 100
	-- Beams update continuously, so TotalKeyFrames does not multiply their cost.
	local tkfMult
	if item:IsA("Beam") or item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") or item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") or item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") or item:GetAttribute("IsRope") or item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") or item:GetAttribute("IsContainer") or item:GetAttribute("IsMatte") or item:GetAttribute("IsForce") or item:GetAttribute("IsReactor") then
		-- Simulated per frame, not per keyframe.
		tkfMult = 1
	else
		-- The closed-form Part path skips per-step work; the per-step branches (VelocityVectored, RotMode
		-- Speed, Drag, Rotating displacement, Model) scale with TotalKeyFrames. The attributes guess which runs.
		local perStep = item:IsA("Model")
		if not perStep then
			local drag = config:GetAttribute("Drag")
			if typeof(drag) == "number" and drag > 0 then perStep = true end
		end
		if not perStep and config:GetAttribute("RotMode") == "Speed" then perStep = true end
		if not perStep and config:GetAttribute("DirMode") == "Local" then perStep = true end
		-- PartConstants.TURNING_DISPLACEMENT: a displacement that turns is stepped keyframe by keyframe.
		if not perStep and config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") == "Rotating" then perStep = true end
		if perStep then
			tkfMult = math.max(1, tkf / 100)
		else
			tkfMult = math.max(1, math.sqrt(tkf / 100))
		end
	end
	local shadowMult = (rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") and rt.CastShadow) and 2.0 or 1
	-- Any keypoint under 0.95 transparency makes the engine depth-sort.
	local transMult = 1
	local trans = config:GetAttribute("Transparency")
	if typeof(trans) == "NumberSequence" then
		for _, kp in ipairs(trans.Keypoints) do
			if kp.Value < 0.95 then transMult = 1.3; break end
		end
	end
	-- Flipbook cost: scaled by frame count (MeshFlipbooks, MeshFrames + BeamFlipbooks)
	local flipFrames = 0
	local mf = item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
	local bf = item:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks")
	if mf then
		-- Decal layers keep one sub-folder per flipbook; every frame in the tree costs the same.
		local frameCount = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(mf:GetDescendants()) do
			if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then frameCount += 1 end
		end
		flipFrames = math.max(flipFrames, frameCount)
	end
	local meshFramesFolder = item:FindFirstChild("MeshFrames")
	if meshFramesFolder then
		local frameCount = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(meshFramesFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("MeshPart") then frameCount += 1 end
		end
		flipFrames = math.max(flipFrames, frameCount)
	end
	if bf then flipFrames = math.max(flipFrames, #bf:GetChildren()) end
	local flipMult = (flipFrames > 0) and (1 + math.min(flipFrames, 64) * 0.01) or 1
	-- Continuous un-pooled emitters pay a clone and destroy per emit. Pool is read from the attribute
	-- alone, so a type whose Pool is on without it (Rocks) counts as un-pooled.
	local churnMult = 1
	local emitDur = item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration") or 0
	if typeof(emitDur) == "string" then emitDur = tonumber(emitDur:match("[%d%.]+")) or 0 end
	if (config:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true or emitDur > 0) and config:GetAttribute("Pool") ~= true then
		churnMult = 1.25
	end
	return tkfMult * shadowMult * transMult * flipMult * churnMult
end

-- Native PEs / Trails / Beams authored inside a RenderTemplate render once per emitted instance.
-- Natives under a nested Transformed item belong to that item (its own nestedCostFor pass).
local function nativeCostFor(rt)
	local cost = 0
	if not rt then return cost end
	for _, d in ipairs(rt:GetDescendants()) do
		local owned = true
		local cur = d.Parent
		while cur and cur ~= rt do
			if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then owned = false break end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
		if owned and not d:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then cost += peCost(d)
			elseif d:IsA("Trail") then cost += trailCost(d)
			elseif d:IsA("Beam") then cost += beamCost(d) end
		end
	end
	return cost
end

-- True only when no other Transformed item sits between `d` and `parentRT`.
local function isDirectNestedChild(d, parentRT)
	local p = d.Parent
	while p and p ~= parentRT do
		if p:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return false end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return p == parentRT
end

-- Nested cost multiplies through each level (parent x child x grandchild). lightFanOut: Lightning
-- and Rope copy a nested PointLight onto every segment, so it multiplies by the segment count.
local function nestedCostFor(rt, visited, lightFanOut)
	local cost = 0
	if not rt then return cost end
	for _, d in ipairs(rt:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:GetAttribute("Transformed") and not visited[d] and isDirectNestedChild(d, rt) then
			visited[d] = true
			local childConfig = TypeRegistry.getConfig(d)
			if childConfig then
				local childRt = d:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
				local childSimul = getSimultaneous(d, childConfig)
				local childBase = getBaseCost(d, childConfig, childRt)
				local childMult = getItemMult(d, childConfig, childRt)
				local fan = (lightFanOut and d:IsA("Light")) and lightFanOut or 1
				local childFanOut
				if d:GetAttribute("IsLightning") or d:GetAttribute("IsRope") then
					childFanOut = maxOf(childConfig:GetAttribute("SegmentCount"), 12)
				end
				cost += childSimul * fan * (childBase * childMult + nestedCostFor(childRt, visited, childFanOut))
			end
		end
	end
	return cost
end

function OptCalc.computeScore(transformed, pes, trails, beamNatives)
	local totalCost = 0
	local highlightSimul = 0

	-- Items nested in another's RenderTemplate are counted in its nestCost, not again.
	local nestedSet = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(transformed) do
		local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		if rt then for _, d in ipairs(rt:GetDescendants()) do if d:GetAttribute("Transformed") then nestedSet[d] = true end end end
	end

	for _, item in ipairs(transformed) do
		if nestedSet[item] then continue end
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		if not config then continue end

		local simultaneous = getSimultaneous(item, config)
		local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		local baseCost = getBaseCost(item, config, rt)

		local lightFanOut
		if item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") or item:GetAttribute("IsRope") then
			lightFanOut = maxOf(config:GetAttribute("SegmentCount"), 12)
		end
		local nestCost = nestedCostFor(rt, {}, lightFanOut)
		local nativeCost = nativeCostFor(rt)

		if item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") then
			-- One shared glass plane (baseCost) plus a per-contribution field evaluation; the plane's own
			-- Transparency graph is strength, not alpha sorting, so no item multipliers apply.
			totalCost += baseCost + math.min(simultaneous, 64) * 0.6
		else
			-- Parent multipliers apply to its own baseCost; nestCost is already pre-multiplied above.
			local itemMult = getItemMult(item, config, rt)
			totalCost += simultaneous * (baseCost * itemMult + nestCost + nativeCost)
		end
		if item:IsA("Highlight") then highlightSimul += simultaneous end
	end
	-- The engine renders at most 31 Highlights; anything past that is dropped, so it is a hard cliff.
	if highlightSimul > 31 then totalCost += (highlightSimul - 31) * 5 end

	-- Native ParticleEmitters: disabled one-shots emit just `EmitCount` particles;
	-- only the duration window or `pe.Enabled` continuous mode adds Rate × Lifetime.
	for _, pe in ipairs(pes) do
		totalCost += peCost(pe)
	end

	-- Native Trails: a strip while Enabled, weighted by Lifetime and EmitDuration.
	if trails then
		for _, trail in ipairs(trails) do
			totalCost += trailCost(trail)
		end
	end
	-- Native Beams selected directly (BeamNative).
	for _, beam in ipairs(beamNatives or {}) do
		totalCost += beamCost(beam)
	end

	if totalCost == 0 then return -1 end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(totalCost / MAX_COST * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100)
end

return OptCalc

--[[
	PanelPersistence  -  keeps the panels' layout across sessions (plugin settings) and across a
	rebuild of the UI in place (a theme mode or text size change).
	  attach(UI, plugin, editors): puts the saved layout into a new UI and keeps saving it. The
	    editors (graph editor, colour picker, gradient editor) keep their place once moved by hand,
	    and their size when ResizesByHand().
	  settingKeys() -> { key, ... }: the settings named after a panel or deck (Panel_, Tab_, Split_)
	    this module keeps; SettingsHandoff carries them.
	  restart(teardown, setup, current): rebuilds the UI hidden (ctx.UIBuilder.buildHidden) and swaps
	    it in one frame, keeping the Properties toggle and the selection's panels. current() -> UI, ctx.
	Plugin settings:
	  Panel_<name>    true, "folded" (a chip in the HUD tray) or false; a tool autoTidy folded counts
	                  as open (Studio usually closes with nothing selected). Tab_ / Split_<deck>: decks.
	  PanelPositions  { [name] = { xScale, xOffset, yScale, yOffset } }, SAVE_DELAY_SECONDS after a
	                  move and at once on destroy; a panel parked on another workspace is not saved.
	  PanelSizes      { [name] = { width, height } }: offsets ADDED to the default size, written per
	                  dragged axis, so a resize carries across modes.
	Reset Layout moves the panels (saving the defaults) and drops the sizes it reset.
	Cross-file: Widgets.makeResizable calls Widgets.onPanelResized(panel, axis), set here. Sizes are
	restored before PropertiesTabs.bindStore, which reads the Properties panel's height.
	WidgetDeck.collapsePanel records a fold before hiding the panel, so W.foldState is right when
	Visible fires here. restart reads ctx.propsToggleEnabled, ctx.togglePropsVisible (QOLWiring),
	ctx.SelectionHandler and ctx._refreshOpt (init.server.lua).
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

local W = require(script.Parent.UIBuilder.Widgets)
local DeckPages = require(script.Parent.UIBuilder.DeckPages)

local SAVE_DELAY_SECONDS = 1
local POSITIONS_SETTING = "PanelPositions"
local SIZES_SETTING = "PanelSizes"
local OPEN_KEYS = { "HuePanel", "EmitCodePanel", "SettingsPanel", "ReDeck", "PropertyToolsDeck", "QMenu" }
local FOLDED = "folded"
local DECK_KEYS = { "ReDeck", "PropertyToolsDeck" }
local POSITION_KEYS = { "HUD", "PropsPanel", "SettingsPanel", "QMenu", "ReDeck", "PropertyToolsDeck", "HuePanel", "EmitCodePanel", "InventoryPanel" }
-- Resizable panels whose size is the user's alone. A deck keeps a height per page and is left out.
local SIZE_KEYS = { "PropsPanel", "InventoryPanel", "HuePanel", "EmitCodePanel" }
-- A restored size keeps at least this share of the default, so one from a smaller text size fits.
local LEAST_SIZE_SHARE = 0.6

local PanelPersistence = {}

-- Writes the positions still waiting out their delay. Set by attach; restart calls it.
local flushPositions = nil

local function readTable(pluginRef, settingName)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return pluginRef:GetSetting(settingName)
	end)
	if ok and type(saved) == "table" then
		return saved
	end
	return {}
end

local function openState(panel)
	if panel.Visible then
		return true
	end
	local fold = W.foldState(panel)
	if fold == "auto" then
		return true
	end
	if fold == "hand" then
		return FOLDED
	end
	return false
end

-- Records `panel`'s open state and applies last session's now. `show` opens it (nil: not this
-- module's to show); `hide` is for a panel built showing.
local function persistOpen(pluginRef, panel, settingName, show, hide)
	local saved = pluginRef:GetSetting(settingName)
	if saved == true and show then
		show()
	elseif saved == FOLDED and show then
		W.foldPanel(panel)
	elseif saved == false and hide then
		hide()
	end
	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		pluginRef:SetSetting(settingName, openState(panel))
	end)
end

-- editorOf: panel -> editor. Returns the editors' part of Reset Layout and the pending-position
-- flush. Mutates the LIVE panels' Position at build and on that reset.
local function persistPositions(pluginRef, panels, editorOf)
	local positions = readTable(pluginRef, POSITIONS_SETTING)
	local pending = {}
	local homes = {}

	-- A pushed panel (PanelPush) is saved where it belongs, not where the push holds it.
	local function record(panel)
		local position = W.restingPosition(panel)
		positions[panel.Name] = { position.X.Scale, position.X.Offset, position.Y.Scale, position.Y.Offset }
	end
	local function write()
		pcall(function() pluginRef:SetSetting(POSITIONS_SETTING, positions) end)
	end

	local function flush()
		local any = false
		for panel in pairs(pending) do
			if panel.Parent and not panel:GetAttribute("_workspaceParked") then
				record(panel)
				any = true
			end
		end
		table.clear(pending)
		if any then
			write()
		end
	end
	flushPositions = flush

	-- Positions are set outright below: a pushed panel goes back to its own place first (PanelPush).
	W.releasePushes()
	for _, panel in ipairs(panels) do
		local editor = editorOf[panel]
		local placesItself = editor ~= nil and editor.IsPlacedByHand ~= nil
		if editor then
			homes[panel] = panel.Position
			-- Hidden as built: a saved place off a smaller screen is pulled in when it shows.
			panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				if panel.Visible then
					task.defer(W.resolveOverlap, panel)
				end
			end)
		end

		local place = positions[panel.Name]
		if type(place) == "table" and #place == 4 then
			panel.Position = UDim2.new(place[1], place[2], place[3], place[4])
			if placesItself then
				editor:SetPlacedByHand(true)
			end
			task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
		end
		panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
			if panel:GetAttribute("_workspaceParked") then return end
			if placesItself and not editor:IsPlacedByHand() then return end
			local stamp = os.clock()
			pending[panel] = stamp
			task.delay(SAVE_DELAY_SECONDS, function()
				if pending[panel] ~= stamp or panel:GetAttribute("_workspaceParked") then return end
				pending[panel] = nil
				record(panel)
				write()
			end)
		end)
	end

	return function()
		for panel, home in pairs(homes) do
			local editor = editorOf[panel]
			if editor.SetPlacedByHand then
				editor:SetPlacedByHand(false)
			end
			pending[panel] = nil
			positions[panel.Name] = nil
			panel.Position = home
		end
		write()
	end, flush
end

-- Mutates the LIVE panels' Size once at build. Returns the sizes' part of Reset Layout, run after UIBuilder's.
local function persistSizes(pluginRef, panels)
	local changes = readTable(pluginRef, SIZES_SETTING)
	local defaults = {}

	local function write()
		pcall(function() pluginRef:SetSetting(SIZES_SETTING, changes) end)
	end

	for _, panel in ipairs(panels) do
		local default = panel.Size
		defaults[panel] = default
		local change = changes[panel.Name]
		local added = type(change) == "table" and tonumber(change[1]) and tonumber(change[2])
		if added and (change[1] ~= 0 or change[2] ~= 0) then
			local width = math.max(default.X.Offset + change[1], default.X.Offset * LEAST_SIZE_SHARE)
			local height = math.max(default.Y.Offset + change[2], default.Y.Offset * LEAST_SIZE_SHARE)
			panel.Size = UDim2.new(default.X.Scale, math.floor(width), default.Y.Scale, math.floor(height))
		end
	end

	-- A pushed panel (PanelPush) counts at the size it has when nothing holds it.
	W.onPanelResized = function(panel, axis)
		local default = defaults[panel]
		if not default then return end
		local size = W.restingSize(panel)
		local change = changes[panel.Name]
		if type(change) ~= "table" then
			change = { 0, 0 }
		end
		if axis == "x" then
			change[1] = size.X.Offset - default.X.Offset
		else
			change[2] = size.Y.Offset - default.Y.Offset
		end
		changes[panel.Name] = change
		write()
	end

	return function()
		for panel, default in pairs(defaults) do
			if W.restingSize(panel) == default then
				changes[panel.Name] = nil
			end
		end
		write()
	end
end

function PanelPersistence.attach(UI, pluginRef, editors)
	local solosByDeck = { ReDeck = UI.ReDeckSolos, PropertyToolsDeck = UI.PropertyToolsDeckSolos }

	-- Split state first, so the open-panel pass below shows page panels rather than the deck.
	for _, key in ipairs(DECK_KEYS) do
		local panel = UI[key]
		local api = UI[key .. "Api"]
		if panel and api and api.setSplit then
			if pluginRef:GetSetting("Split_" .. key) == true then api.setSplit(true) end
			panel:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Split"):Connect(function()
				pluginRef:SetSetting("Split_" .. key, panel:GetAttribute("Split") == true)
			end)
		end
	end

	for _, key in ipairs(DECK_KEYS) do
		local panel = UI[key]
		local api = UI[key .. "Api"]
		if panel and api then
			local saved = pluginRef:GetSetting("Tab_" .. key)
			if type(saved) == "string" then api.setTab(saved, false) end
			panel:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ActiveTab"):Connect(function()
				pluginRef:SetSetting("Tab_" .. key, panel:GetAttribute("ActiveTab"))
			end)
		end
	end

	local positioned = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(POSITION_KEYS) do
		if UI[key] then table.insert(positioned, UI[key]) end
	end
	for _, solos in pairs(solosByDeck) do
		for _, solo in pairs(solos) do table.insert(positioned, solo) end
	end
	local editorOf = {}
	for _, editor in ipairs(editors or {}) do
		local panel = editor:GetPanel()
		if panel then
			editorOf[panel] = editor
			table.insert(positioned, panel)
		end
	end
	local resetEditors, flush = persistPositions(pluginRef, positioned, editorOf)
	-- A panel moved within the save delay of Studio closing or the plugin being switched off.
	UI.ScreenGui.Destroying:Connect(flush)

	local sized = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(SIZE_KEYS) do
		if UI[key] then table.insert(sized, UI[key]) end
	end
	-- An editor resized by hand keeps its size too; Reset Layout knows only the UI's panels, so it is reset here.
	local editorSizes = {}
	for _, editor in ipairs(editors or {}) do
		if editor.ResizesByHand and editor:ResizesByHand() then
			local panel = editor:GetPanel()
			editorSizes[panel] = panel.Size
			table.insert(sized, panel)
		end
	end
	local dropResetSizes = persistSizes(pluginRef, sized)

	local resetLayout = UI.ResetLayout
	if resetLayout then
		UI.ResetLayout = function()
			resetLayout()
			for panel, size in pairs(editorSizes) do
				panel.Size = size
			end
			dropResetSizes()
			resetEditors()
		end
	end

	for _, key in ipairs(OPEN_KEYS) do
		local panel = UI[key]
		if panel then
			local api = UI[key .. "Api"]
			local isSplit = api and api.isSplit and api.isSplit()
			-- A split deck's own frame stays hidden; its page panels are restored below.
			local show = nil
			if not isSplit then
				show = function()
					if api then api.show() else panel.Visible = true end
				end
			end
			persistOpen(pluginRef, panel, "Panel_" .. key, show)
		end
	end
	for deckKey, solos in pairs(solosByDeck) do
		local api = UI[deckKey .. "Api"]
		local isSplit = api and api.isSplit and api.isSplit()
		for _, solo in pairs(solos) do
			-- Page panels hold their page only while the deck is split.
			local show = nil
			if isSplit then show = function() solo.Visible = true end end
			persistOpen(pluginRef, solo, "Panel_" .. solo.Name, show)
		end
	end
	-- The bottom bar's strip of toggles is built closed and the counter showing.
	local strip = UI.Toggles and UI.Toggles.strip
	if strip then
		persistOpen(pluginRef, strip, "Panel_ToggleStrip", function()
			strip.Visible = true
		end)
	end
	local counter = UI.Counter
	if counter then
		persistOpen(pluginRef, counter, "Panel_Counter", nil, function()
			counter.Visible = false
		end)
	end

	if UI.PropsTabs then UI.PropsTabs.bindStore(pluginRef) end
end

function PanelPersistence.settingKeys()
	local keys = { "Panel_ToggleStrip", "Panel_Counter" }
	for _, key in ipairs(OPEN_KEYS) do
		table.insert(keys, "Panel_" .. key)
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(DECK_KEYS) do
		table.insert(keys, "Tab_" .. key)
		table.insert(keys, "Split_" .. key)
		for _, page in ipairs(DeckPages[key] or {}) do
			table.insert(keys, "Panel_" .. key .. page)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

-- What a session holds that no setting does.
local function capture(ctx)
	return {
		propsOff = ctx.propsToggleEnabled == false,
	}
end

-- Mutates the LIVE panels of the rebuilt UI. The selection handler shows the Properties panel,
-- the HUD's rows and the selection tools for what is selected, as a selection change would.
local function putBack(ctx, kept)
	if kept.propsOff and ctx.propsToggleEnabled and ctx.togglePropsVisible then
		ctx.togglePropsVisible()
	end
	if ctx.SelectionHandler then
		ctx.SelectionHandler(Selection:Get())
	end
	if ctx._refreshOpt then
		ctx._refreshOpt()
	end
end

function PanelPersistence.restart(teardown, setup, current)
	task.defer(function()
		local UI, ctx = current()
		local kept = (UI and ctx) and capture(ctx) or nil
		-- A panel moved within the save delay is written now: the new UI reads the setting.
		if flushPositions then
			flushPositions()
		end
		-- teardown leaves a ScreenGui it is not handed: the UI being replaced stays drawn until the swap.
		local builder = ctx and ctx.UIBuilder
		local old = UI and UI.ScreenGui
		if old and builder then
			old.Name = builder.RETIRED_UI_NAME
			UI.ScreenGui = nil
			builder.buildHidden = true
		end
		teardown()
		-- A failed setup still ends the swap: no old UI is left on screen and no later build stays hidden.
		local built, problem = pcall(setup)
		-- setup also stops short of a UI behind the licence gate or when the plugin is switched
		-- off, before any build has read the flag.
		if builder then
			builder.buildHidden = nil
		end
		UI, ctx = current()
		if built and kept and UI and ctx then
			putBack(ctx, kept)
		end
		if UI and UI.ScreenGui then
			UI.ScreenGui.Enabled = true
		end
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
		if not built then
			error(problem, 0)
		end
	end)
end

return PanelPersistence
